chapters.title: Chapter 201 201: The Unified Breathing Technique That Can Break Through Limits
paragraphs: Ding Ling's breathing rhythm gradually returned to normal.
The white Vigorous Qi gushing out also automatically retracted into his body.
Ding Ling suddenly opened his tightly shut eyes.
The brilliance in his eyes shone brightly, seeming to electrify the void, making the whole room appear much brighter at this moment!
"How do you feel?"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji asked eagerly.
"I feel..."
Ding Ling carefully sensed his own body.
After reaching Full Level of the Taiqing Breathing Technique, physique and defense did not increase, but charisma increased by 0.9.
Even so, this is quite extraordinary.
One must know that Ding Ling's strength is vastly different from before.
Whereas the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique and Sword God Breathing Technique only provide +1 charisma.
Now at Ding Ling's level, Taiqing Breathing Technique can even increase charisma by +0.9.
This demonstrates its excellence.
Besides this.
Ding Ling's three Breathing Techniques have already fused into one!
Reaching a true State of Great Perfection!
It can be said.
Now, with every breath Ding Ling takes, he can refine endless medicinal power, which will automatically increase Ding Ling's Four-dimensional Attributes.
And it absolutely won't be wasted as it was with the External Refining Breathing Technique.
To put it directly:
The Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique and Sword God Breathing Technique are External Refining Breathing Techniques, focusing on power and defense growth.
While Taiqing Breathing Technique focuses on agility and physique growth!
Unity of Inner and Outer.
When consuming Great Medicine, it simultaneously increases Four-dimensional Attributes! And ensures not even a fraction of the Great Medicine is wasted.
Especially for a cultivator like Ding Ling, who has reached mastery in breathing technique, he enhances the utilization rate of Great Medicine to the utmost!
"Is this the true meaning of Unity of Inner and Outer and being Unrivaled?"
Ding Ling instinctively felt it shouldn't be this simple.
For he felt some kind of constraint on his body was broken at this moment.
As if the limits of power and defense could increase again!
"If this is indeed the case. Then this Unity of Inner and Outer breathing technique is truly Unrivaled and Invincible in the world!"
Even the top-tier External Refining Breathing Techniques have limits!
The limit for power is 30 and defense is 30.
The average breathing technique doesn't even need to be mentioned.
Perhaps the limit can only reach around 20!
Imagine those geniuses who cultivate ordinary breathing techniques, no matter how excellent their natural talent and understanding, it's impossible for them to reach power and defense of 30.
But now, the Unity of Inner Refining Breathing Technique and External Refining Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling felt this kind of shackle seemed to be broken.
As if power and defense could increase once again.
"Incredible. If this is really possible. Then wouldn't it be explosive?
Ding Ling expected secretly.
After sensing all these,
he briefly shared his feelings with Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji, upon hearing, was moved:
"So, this is where the secret of Unity of Inner and Outer, and being Invincible lies?"
Without waiting for Ding Ling's response.
He stroked his beard and said:
"It should be correct."
His eyes stared at Ding Ling spiritedly, as if looking at an Immortal Flower:
"You are truly remarkable. I cannot find words to express my feelings towards you. In short, I am not qualified to be your master. From now on, we shall interact as equals."
"Senior, this..."
"I don't deserve it."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji waved his hand, embarrassed:

"I have only lived slightly longer than you. In terms of understanding and cultivation in Taiqing Breathing Technique, I most likely don't surpass you. Perhaps I still need to consult you on how to further incorporate Taiqing Breathing Technique into innate instincts."
"Senior."
Ding Ling activated his acting skills, earnestly saying:
"Respect must not be discarded. No matter what, you will always be my senior!"
"You are very commendable."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji looked at Ding Ling more and more favorably:
"Not arrogant, not anxious, not overbearing, not aggressive, this is too rare. Such an extraordinary genius, yet so respectful, humble, and virtuous. It seems this world has hope."
He looked towards Ding Ling:
"What do you plan to do after leaving the Daoist Temple this time?"
"Naturally, to fulfill my promise."
Ding Ling did not hesitate, saying:

"I promised senior Zhang Zhongjing that if I ever become invincible in the world, I will definitely find a heroic ruler to assist in restoring harmony, clearing obstacles, and bringing peace and prosperity to this world!"
"Hmm."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji nodded with a smile, looking at Ding Ling:
"Originally, I thought you might become arrogant. Now it seems I was overthinking. With heroes and geniuses like you, those people suffering from plagues and wars finally have a chance to live."
"Speaking truthful words to respectable seniors is basic moral duty."
"Hmm."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji nodded and said:

"Correct. The world has both good and bad people. There's no need to observe much etiquette and morality with bad people; it easily results in suffering. It seems you are not rigid or inflexible. This is excellent."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji smiled and said:
"Alright, next I will teach you the Talisman Making Technique."
He spoke in detail as always.
After one round.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book quickly materialized on a shelf in the library:
"Initial Tier Taiqing Talisman!"
In an instant.
[Initial Tier Taiqing Talisman Full Level]
[Charisma +0.2]
The various methods and techniques of Taiqing Talisman making became instinctively engraved into Ding Ling's entire body.
Ding Ling quickly grasped how to make talismans.
He just needed to prepare pen, ink, paper, and inkstone.
Then practice Inner Refining Breathing Technique, injecting Inner Strength into the pen tip to paint talismans.
These painted talismans would not only possess the charm of Taiqing Breathing Technique, but also imperceptibly collect and absorb some special Spiritual Mechanism in the air!
These Spiritual Mechanisms are of great use to the human body!
Therefore, the painted talismans, if used to make Talisman Water,
could make ordinary people become vibrant and energetic again.
Moreover, talismans come in various types.
There are talismans specifically for treating plagues, those for treating ordinary illnesses, and even those for treating major diseases.
They are basically all healing and curing related talismans.
Ding Ling was speechless.
He thought it would be something amazing.
Turns out it was just like this.
This is truly difficult for those who haven't mastered it, easy for those who have!
"How's it going?"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji asked eagerly.
"It's done."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji's mouth twitched, wanting to question a few times, but thinking of Ding Ling's phenomenal talent, he sighed and said:
"Comparing myself to you, I feel I've wasted decades of my life."
Seeing Ding Ling seemed to want to comfort him.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji waved his hand and said:
"Alright, I am not that fragile; I am just temporarily unbalanced, unable to accept this reality. Fortunately, what comforts me greatly is.
Ding Ling, you are my successor, part of my own clan!"
He felt rather fortunate:
"If you were my enemy, or the enemy of the people, I can't imagine how terrifying it would be!"
Ding Ling was silent.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji chuckled, seeming quite delighted:
"Remember to demonstrate your talisman-making skills to me later. I really want to see how far you've come."
Ding Ling did not hesitate.
He demonstrated immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 202: Initial Tier Taiqing Talisman (13/21)
paragraphs: Ding Ling stirred the Breathing Technique and began painting talismans. The brush danced across the paper, bringing the talismans to life.
It just took a moment.
Ding Ling completed three talismans.
These were talismans for treating plagues, minor illnesses, and major illnesses.
The difficulty of each talisman varied.
The complexity and the vigorous qi required for each was naturally different.
The plague talisman was the most difficult, followed by the major illness talisman, and the simplest was the minor illness talisman.
Even so.
Such talismans need years, seven or eight at least, of hard work to replicate perfectly by ordinary people.
Even someone as talented as Daoist Yhiuu Ji took a long time to replicate them.
It's imaginable that the time he spent mastering the Talisman Making Technique was extremely long.
This was indeed the case.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji specialized in just two things throughout his martial dao journey: refining the Inner Refining Breathing Technique and the Talisman Making Technique.
However, even so.
Upon seeing the talismans Ding Ling created.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji couldn't hide his shock!
He was moved and lost his composure:
"He actually has mastered the Talisman Making Technique to the level of mastery. How is this possible?!"
His face was full of confusion, astonishment, and bewilderment.
A perfect state he had worked all his life for but never achieved.
Ding Ling reached it in just a moment.
Such a blow.
Made Daoist Yhiuu Ji feel both dejected and amazed, while inside he was thrilled and joyous for witnessing a miracle, the rise of a legend!
"Though it feels unbelievable and baffling, I must say, you are truly exceptional, too perfect."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji was generous in his praise:

"Earlier I worried that learning an additional Inner Refining Breathing Technique might ruin you. Now it seems my worries were unfounded. You have achieved unity of inner and outer, becoming unrivaled in the path of the Breathing Technique.
With effort and practicing for a while, you will surely advance by leaps and bounds and reach the Celestial Human Realm!"
He looked forward with great anticipation:
"If you reach the Celestial Human Realm, I wonder if you could attain Ascension."
His eyes sparkled as he looked at Ding Ling:
"All my hopes are pinned on you. If you feel that you are about to attain Ascension, make sure to take me along to witness it! I want to see with my own eyes what Ascension truly is like!"
Ding Ling was also very curious about whether Ascension was real.
Thus he agreed.
"Haha, let's go."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji personally took Ding Ling to the front yard:
"Now you have mastered all my skills. Zhang Zhongjing would be amazed if he knew."
Ding Ling smiled without saying a word.
Soon.
The two arrived in the front yard one after the other.
Zhang Zhongjing and the others immediately gathered around, eagerly asking:
"How did it go?"
"Is it done already? So quickly? Or do we continue the teaching tomorrow?"
Da and Xiao Qiao also looked curiously at Ding Ling and Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji didn't hide anything and laughed, stroking his beard, as he said:
"Ding Ling's talent is indeed rare throughout the ages. It's incredibly impressive. I'm still struggling to calm my excitement."
"You mean Ding Ling has already mastered your technique?"
Zhang Zhongjing turned his head slightly.
"Yes indeed."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji nodded and said:
"Not only has he mastered it, but he's also refined it to a level of mastery. In terms of the depth and extent of mastery, Ding Ling is even better than I am!"
Da and Xiao Qiao were wide-eyed, tongue-tied:
"How long has it been? It feels like it was only a few teas ago."
"Indeed, not much time has passed."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji laughed and said:
"In fact, it was me spending more time explaining and demonstrating. Ding Ling only studied briefly. I was also stunned at the time."
He glanced at everyone and said:
"Honestly. Initially, I firmly believed that Ding Ling couldn't have the talent in Talisman Making and the Inner Refining Breathing Technique comparable to the Medical Dao."
"And now?"
Zhang Zhongjing stroked his beard, appearing proud.
"Naturally, I believe it now."
"Haha..."
Zhang Zhongjing grew even prouder, for this was a legend, a myth he had discovered!
And he personally brought him to Yhiuu Ji, which meant that he was Ding Ling's guide!
As a guide, he was naturally proud of the achievements Ding Ling had made!
The stronger Ding Ling became, the more honored Zhang Zhongjing felt, the greater his sense of accomplishment!
It was like watching someone he considered family climb to the highest peak.
The feeling of nurturing a genius into a legend is indescribable.
While others nurture talents at great expense of time and effort.
For Zhang Zhongjing to 'nurture Ding Ling.
He essentially hit the fast-forward button.
Moving swiftly, Ding Ling became a myth, a legend.
The sudden rush of a great sense of nurturing success was even more sudden, rapid, and filled Zhang Zhongjing with even more excitement, joy, and pride!
Such was he.

Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng were even more so without needing to say much. Being part of Ding Ling's small group meant that the stronger Ding Ling got, the more they felt basked in glory, with an indescribable sense of lightness, freedom, and honor!
"Don't forget your previous promise to me,"
Zhang Zhongjing said.
"I won't forget."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji nodded, looking at Ding Ling:
"Would you like to demonstrate your Talisman Making Technique? And the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique?"
Zhao Yun and the others immediately turned their heads, expressing curiosity.
Since they were all close colleagues.
Ding Ling didn't act modestly and promptly fulfilled their curiosity.
With pen and ink in hand.
He painted freely.
The talismans were drawn with divine and artistic precision one by one.
They looked magnificent, full of divine charm and mystery.
As if mysticism was being born right before their eyes.
"Indeed, he has mastered it. Moreover, the level of this Talisman Making Technique has reached my dream realm."
Zhang Zhongjing felt his heart tremble, hearing and seeing were two completely different experiences.
Recalling his once relentless pursuit of the Talisman Making Technique, which he gave up on due to its difficulty or incompatible aptitude.
Now seeing a genius mastering it so easily.
In comparison.
Zhang Zhongjing suddenly felt like he was a nobody!
Without comparing, it didn't feel like much.
The more he compared,
The more dazzling Ding Ling became, the smaller he felt!
"Come on, take a few each."
Ding Ling distributed the talismans to Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhao Yun, and others, saying:

"These talismans are for treating major illnesses. The longer they are stored, the more Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism they absorb, which enhances their effectiveness. If you ever encounter untreatable ailments, try placing a talisman in water. Once the talisman softens, drink the Talisman Water."
"Is this the legendary talisman?"
Xiao Qiao examined the talisman with curiosity:
"The writing on it looks like a heavenly script. I don't understand it. But it's beautiful, like a painting. Can it really treat major illnesses?"
"If Ding Ling says it can, then it surely can."
Da Qiao gently pulled Xiao Qiao and hinted not to doubt Ding Ling:

chapters.title: Chapter 203 203: The Principle Behind Talisman Water Healing
paragraphs: "How could someone so skilled, talented, and courteous deceive us?"
At this moment, Da Qiao's feelings towards Ding Ling were extremely delicate.
Her admiration was mixed with reverence, and a hint of self-doubt.
Indeed, Ding Ling was too radiant and dazzling.
He was like the sun in the sky, shining so brightly that it was hard to look at directly.
And she was just an ordinary woman.
She felt it was difficult to be worthy of someone like Ding Ling, which naturally led to feelings of inferiority.
Ding Ling was unaware of this, but if he knew, he would certainly be astonished: 'How could a woman so beautiful feel inferior!'
"Hehe."
Ding Ling smiled faintly and said:
"To know if it's effective, just try the talisman. You know, this Daoist Temple has many patients coming and going every day."
The crowd understood.
Curiously, they took the talisman to test it.
Ding Ling actually wanted to see the effect too.
After all, these were talismans!
Just hearing about it felt so mystical! It seemed to defy common worldly views.
Fortunately, Ding Ling's worldview had been shattered the moment he crossed over, allowing him to quickly accept new things.
He just wanted to see with his own eyes how the talisman could heal.
Moments later.
A Daoist Child immersed several talismans in water.
After the talismans softened.
The patient drank the Talisman Water.
In no time, they truly recovered from a sickly state to a vibrant condition.
"Incredible."
Da and Xiao Qiao were shocked.
"It's even better than my Talisman Water."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji felt moved, gratified, yet slightly ashamed.
His heart suddenly felt: The Yangtze River pushing forward, with the waves ahead dying on the beach.
"No wonder it's Ding Ling."
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun took it for granted.
Because on this journey, Ding Ling had created too many miracles.
"Let me take a look."
Ding Ling stepped forward, checked the pulse, and studied the cause keenly.
After a while.
With subtle insight, he thought:

"As I expected. It's the Spiritual Mechanism and the Divine Essence of the Taiqing Breathing Technique that are providing the effect. Moreover, with the enhancement and conversion through the talisman, this Spiritual Mechanism becomes easier for the weak to absorb, making it more effective than regular medicine."
Medicinal herbs also contain plenty of Spiritual Mechanism.
The older the Great Medicine, the more Spiritual Mechanism it contains.
Therefore, the use of Spiritual Mechanism is evident.
And this Talisman Water directly drives Spiritual Mechanism into the ailment, achieving a cure!
It sounds very mystical!
But that's how mystical it is!
What could be more mystical than crossing over, or having Divine Skills automatically reach Full Level as if using Cheats?
Ding Ling quickly accepted it and felt relieved.
He even wondered if he could drink Talisman Water to enhance his agility, physique, strength, and defense - these Four-dimensional Attributes!
But after drinking a sip.
Ding Ling gave up.
This Spiritual Mechanism, converted by the talisman, is purely for healing!
Ding Ling was not sick.
When Spiritual Mechanism entered the abdomen, it automatically disintegrated and dissipated.
It couldn't be absorbed by the body at all.
Because this Spiritual Mechanism is like a 'tool', used to 'remove' the 'lesion' within the body!
To put it colloquially, it's akin to the Divine Weapon in a person's hand.
How could one convert a Divine Weapon?
At least for now, Ding Ling didn't have that means.
Or maybe, there might be a talisman that directly absorbs Spiritual Mechanism, then feeds it to the body!
But Daoist Yhiuu Ji's Initial Tier Taiqing Talisman doesn't seem to have that effect.
A period later.
Many of the patients cured by Talisman Water thanked Ding Ling profusely and left.
After drinking several bowls of Talisman Water, Da Qiao became even more radiant and glowing.
Driven by curiosity, Xiao Qiao also drank a bowl and instantly felt her body lighten, as if some chronic ailment had been removed from her organs.
She was overjoyed and hurriedly shared this with Diao Chan and the others.
Diao Chan and the others also drank, and indeed, their bodies felt much lighter.
Especially Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng.
Due to many hardships, they had quite a few minor health issues within their bodies.
After several bowls of Talisman Water.
They felt refreshed and revitalized, as if the shackles they carried had been broken.
Ding Ling marveled.
Although he was the one who painted the talisman, the mystical healing effect of Talisman Water still surprised and intrigued him.
The group returned to the inner courtyard.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji spoke directly:
"If the Nanhua Old Immortal were here, witnessing a genius like you, Ding Ling, he would surely be moved and delighted, and impart you with a wealth of skills. Alas, alas, I don't know where he is."
"What about Zuo Ci?"
Ding Ling recalled Wang Yue's words and quickly asked.
"I don't know."
Daoist Yhiuu Ji said:
"Zuo Ci's whereabouts are unpredictable, as if he's one with the spirits, without a fixed residence. No one knows where he might be. He could be in Yangzhou today, and in Youzhou tomorrow."
"Is he really that fast?"
Zhao Yun caught the key point.
"Hehe. The Escape Armor Skill is magical and beyond mortal imagination.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji spoke with longing:
"To travel a thousand miles overnight is not difficult for those proficient in the Escape Armor Skill. Of course, I've only heard about it, and I don't know the specifics."
Ding Ling was also amazed and yearned for it.
If he really learned the Escape Armor Skill.
He would be no different from an Earth Immortal.
With such skills.
Who could capture or stop him?
Another day passed.
Ding Ling proposed his departure.

Daoist Yhiuu Ji didn't insist on keeping him, only said: "Don't forget your original intentions. Remember your promises to us. Only one who serves the nation and its people can be considered a peerless hero!"
Ding Ling solemnly agreed.
Daoist Yhiuu Ji and Zhang Zhongjing personally escorted Ding Ling five or six miles away before bidding farewell with reluctance.
Zhang Zhongjing did not accompany Ding Ling.
According to him, he had completed his mission here and would continue treating some patients at the Daoist Temple with Daoist Yhiuu Ji for a while.
Then he would return to Changsha County.
Ding Ling felt a bit of regret but didn't say much or do much. After bidding farewell.
Ding Ling rode off, guided by Da and Xiao Qiao, towards Lujiang County, Wan County.
On the way.
Excitedly, Xiao Qiao chirped, sharing stories and sights of Wan County with Ding Ling, Diao Chan, and the others.
Da Qiao, however, was slightly shy and anxious. She wondered how Ding Ling would interact with her father after returning home.
And how her father would perceive them staying at the Daoist Temple for so long for a man?
Clip-clop!
Rumble rumble!
Amidst the rumble of the carriage wheels and the iron hooves of the mount.
The group arrived at Wan County at noon.
The gatekeepers, seeing Da and Xiao Qiao's convoy, immediately made way without charging any fees.
This showed that Da and Xiao Qiao had quite a reputation locally.
Or perhaps their father, Elder Qiao, held significant status in the area?
Ding Ling inquired briefly.
And it was confirmed.
Elder Qiao was indeed a prominent clan! A noble family!
Calling Da and Xiao Qiao top-class white-rich beauties of ancient times was no exaggeration.
Clip-clop!
Amidst the sound of iron hooves, the group twisted and turned, arriving at a luxurious mansion in the north of the city.
There was a plaque above the mansion.
Inscribed with two characters: Qiao Mansion!
People at the entrance, upon seeing Da and Xiao Qiao, immediately rushed forward joyfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 204 204: Warning from the Players (15/21)
paragraphs: "Young Master, you folks have finally returned. The master was just mentioning you yesterday."
The two servants bowed deeply to Da and Xiao Qiao.
At a glance, it was evident they were servants sold to the Qiao Family.
In such chaotic times.
There were many who sold themselves like this.
"Then I'll go see him with my sister now."
Although Xiao Qiao was somewhat naive, she was lively too. She grabbed Da Qiao, ready to leave, but suddenly remembered Ding Ling and them, and quickly said to the servant:
"These guests here are our most honored invitees. You must treat them well and not neglect them!"
For Da and Xiao Qiao to say such words.
The servant was very surprised.
Because even Zhou Yu hadn't received such warm treatment!
What made these people deserve it?
Though surprised, they were merely servants and dared not question or inquire.
They just timidly nodded in agreement.
"Then I'll go see my father first. We'll meet in the hall at my house afterward."
Xiao Qiao said to Ding Ling.
Upon seeing Ding Ling agree.
She then eagerly dragged Da Qiao inside, whispering as they walked:
"I must show my father what a top genius looks like, what a creator of legends is. If he meets Ding Ling, he'll be utterly surprised and delighted."
Da Qiao smiled gently but did not comment.
Clearly, she also agreed with Xiao Qiao's words, believing Ding Ling had such capability.
Da and Xiao Qiao headed straight for the study.
They knew their father often enjoyed staying alone in the study to read, practice calligraphy, and martial arts.
But when they reached the study, a stench of blood suddenly hit them.
They couldn't help but tremble in their chests.
Exchanged a glance.
Nonetheless, Da Qiao, more courageous, stepped forward and pushed open the door.
What met their eyes was a floor covered in blood and their father's face, dead and unwilling to die peacefully.
"Father!"
Da and Xiao Qiao were struck like lightning; Da Qiao, just recovered from illness, staggered and fell to the ground.
Xiao Qiao's mind went blank, but seeing Da Qiao's state, she immediately stepped forward to support her.
"How could this happen?"
Da Qiao, with tears like pear blossoms in the rain, her eyes swollen, couldn't believe it:
"Wasn't everything fine yesterday?"
The study was quite spacious.
There were five or six bookshelves, originally filled with books, now scattered all over, several shelves overturned, mixing with the pool of blood, a complete mess.
"Someone must have murdered father."
Though Da Qiao was frail, at this moment, she showed her extraordinary insight, determination, and responsibility.
A strong wave of sadness surged into her mind.
She forcibly suppressed it, steadied her trembling body, and quickly surveyed the entire scene with her almond-shaped eyes:
"Judging by the scene, the murder likely happened two hours ago. The murderer is either still in the Qiao Mansion or has fled far away."
She looked at Xiao Qiao:
"You now go find Ding Ling and them. Otherwise, even if we find the murderer, we wouldn't be able to deal with them."
Xiao Qiao, with tear-stained eyes, obediently ran to find Ding Ling and them upon hearing this.
A while later.
Ding Ling and his group arrived.
Diao Chan saw Da Qiao kneeling before a corpse, looking utterly defeated, and sighed in her heart, immediately stepping forward to comfort her.
As for Du Qingcheng, he was comforting Xiao Qiao.
Ding Ling glanced around the scene, finding it too brutal and melodramatic!
Did it have to be like this?
As soon as they arrived at the Qiao Family, such a bloody event happened?!
He originally intended to stay at the Qiao Family for a day or two, and see if there were any Great Medicine to purchase and enhance his four-dimensional attributes.
After all, his Breathing Technique had reached Unity of Inner and Outer, capable of breaking new limits!
But unexpectedly, this happened.
Wasn't Elder Qiao a significant figure in Lujiang County, Wan County? How could he be assassinated in his own study?
Ding Ling observed closely, puzzled.
Aside from a few missing books from the organized shelves, it didn't seem like much else was missing.
"I found this."
Da Qiao, tears in her eyes, wiped the corner of her eye and handed a slightly crumpled piece of paper to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling took it, unfolded, looked closely, and an overwhelming fury surged into his mind.
It clearly said:
"Ding Ling, I never expected you to come to Lujiang County, Wan County. Truly, human calculations are inferior to Celestial Calculation. You're too greedy. You want everything.
Do you know your actions have disrupted our perfect plan?
Our painstakingly prepared plan was ruined by you!
Almost there, but failed at the last step!
Can you imagine that feeling of despair and collapse?
Since the first plan has no effect, we can only initiate the second plan.
Everything you see now is what we want you to see. You must understand and clarify your identity. Don't get too entangled with NPCs!
This is our first warning to you, and hopefully, the last.
We don't want you randomly plunging into various Three Kingdoms plots, disrupting our plans!
Otherwise, the reality for you will be precarious.
Don't doubt it.
We have the capability.

Oh, to be precise, this shouldn't be the first warning; it's the second. The first warning letter was taken by a Daoist Child. It seems he didn't give it to you. Otherwise, your response wouldn't be this slow, haha..."
Huff, huff!
The more Ding Ling read, the angrier he became.
He clenched his fist suddenly, crackling!
With Vigorous Qi tearing, the paper was shredded into pieces.
This was a letter written in a foreign language!
And it was even in a minor language!
Had Ding Ling not been proficient in various foreign languages, he might not have understood it!
The other party was clearly showing off!
And from this, it was obvious that anyone who could use a minor language to such an extent could not be ordinary.
It must be a High Tier player.
But the other party dared to warn him so openly.
Did they see him as clay to be molded at will?
Ding Ling snorted coldly.
Just let him find out who's behind this trickery.
Otherwise, he'd level them to zero!
As for reality?
Ding Ling felt that as long as he was strong enough, even if the enemy deployed a vast army, he wouldn't be afraid.
If not for fear of guns and artillery in reality, Ding Ling would have long moved openly to the downtown area, who would dare come and try him!
Snatching a general's head from amidst thousands of troops is no joke.
Moreover, his Hacker Skills Full Level.
He had already concluded that this supposed High Tier player was just trying to confuse him, waiting for him to mess up on his own.
He had recently checked online and confirmed that no one could locate him in a short time!
This show-off likely just wanted to intimidate and threaten him!
What he didn't know was, he had provoked an All-Powerful King!
Ding Ling frowned, called Zhao Yun over, and directed him to go to the Daoist Temple to find a Daoist child and retrieve the letter from him.
Fortunately, the Daoist Temple was just a dozen miles away in Wan County, not far.

chapters.title: Chapter 205 205: The Renowned General Xu Sheng
paragraphs: Riding on horseback, it won't take long.
Zhao Yun nodded, turned around, and sprinted away.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng continued comforting the Qiao sisters, whose eyes were swollen from crying.
Ding Ling sighed.
It was quite a thorny situation.
If it weren't for him.
Elder Qiao might not have been killed by the players.
But the event had already happened.
Ding Ling could only think of a way to wrap things up.
He immediately ordered the anxious young servant who accompanied him to call all the people from the Qiao Mansion to gather at the martial arts training ground.
Indeed.
The Qiao Family was a prominent clan in the area.
Naturally, they had no shortage of martial arts venues.
The young servant responded and ran off quickly.
Da Qiao, enduring her grief, explained the situation at the scene to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling nodded, comforted the Qiao sisters with a few words, and said:
"Rest assured, once I catch the murderer, I will kill him to avenge you!"
"Thank you, Ding Ling."
Da Qiao was very grateful, but when she thought of her father's death, she couldn't help shedding tears again.
Yesterday, he was fine, and today he was murdered.
No one can accept this reality.
After some time.
Ding Ling and his party arrived at the martial arts training ground.
Da Qiao handed over a roster.
Ding Ling called the roll.
After a while.
"Xu Sheng!"
Ding Ling instinctively called out, but there was no response.
He called twice more, still the same.
It was the gatekeeper who said:
"Xu Sheng hurriedly ran out from the back door not long ago. His whereabouts are unknown."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling examined the roster closely.

Xu Sheng: Courtesy name Wenxiang. A Langya person. Drifted to Yangzhou due to war and finally sold himself to the Qiao Family, becoming a guard due to his agility and high martial arts skills, and even became a small leader.
After reading the brief introduction.
Ding Ling's eyebrows slightly twitched, not surprisingly, this Xu Sheng Xu Wenxiang was likely to become the famous general of Wuu Kingdom, one of the Twelve Tiger Generals of Jiangbiao later on.
How could such a famous general fall to selling himself to the Qiao Family?
It must be due to players conspiring secretly.
"Ning Zhen!"
No response.
'Ning Yi!'
Similarly, no response.
He called five or six people in succession. All were unresponsive.
No doubt.
Among these five or six people, there must be players, and more than one.
Ding Ling locked onto those who had left and asked someone to report when they were last seen.
Most replied it was not long ago.
Ding Ling understood.
No doubt these people had run away.
He sent someone to report to the authorities. To ensure the successful arrest of these people, Ding Ling personally went to the Shangguan Prefecture Government Office.
His martial power was extremely high.
With just one move, he intimidated the County Magistrate and the County Captain of Wan County!
With a clear shout.
The County Magistrate and others were so frightened they nearly collapsed, not daring to resist further and obediently sent people out to search for Ning Yi, Xu Sheng, and others.
In contrast to Ding Ling's few people.
The military force of Wan County was in the thousands.
Dispersed to search for people, it was much more efficient than Ding Ling searching blindly.
They dared not target Ding Ling either.
Because Ding Ling's reputation had already spread to Wan County.
Knowing that this Ding Ling was indeed the Ding Ling.
The County Magistrate's face changed dramatically, as if he had seen a ghost, how dare he anger Ding Ling?
A super-warrior capable of breaking through Jii Ling's army in Wan City, the Runan Yellow Turban Army, and other forces, who would dare provoke him?
At the very least.
The County Magistrate wouldn't dare.
When Ding Ling returned to the Qiao Mansion.
Zhao Yun also came back.
Brought a letter.
Ding Ling opened and glanced through it.
It was still in a minor language.
A few thousand words densely packed, quoted texts and orderly articles, with extremely harsh wording.
The general meaning was:
Everyone minds their own business! Their aim was Zhou Yu and Daoist Yhiuu Ji's Breathing Technique, martial arts, and Talismanic Technique. Therefore, they set up many intricate traps.
Da Qiao was seriously injured, with no one to cure her, could only visit Daoist Yhiuu Ji at the Daoist Temple, this was just the first step.
There were more setups to come.
They hoped Ding Ling would wisely not heal Da Qiao, nor deeply engage with Daoist Yhiuu Ji, or learn his martial arts and Talismanic Technique. Because that was their target.
Or face the consequences yourself!
"Arrogant."
Ding Ling exhaled Vigorous Qi, easily destroying the letter:
"Dare to tell me not to learn Daoist Yhiuu Ji's martial arts Talismanic Technique, just because they have ways to obtain it? Haha..."
Ding Ling sneered:
"What kind of logic is this?"
Now he understood.
These so-called high-tier players hiding in the shadows, scheming against Da Qiao and Daoist Yhiuu Ji.
Were likely just some overly presumptuous rich kids or similar characters.
Flowers in the greenhouse.
Having not endured too many setbacks.
Used to being arrogant and presumptuous, they didn't take others seriously, or care about the lives of people like Da Qiao, because in their view, this was just a game!
Da Qiao and the others were just NPCs!
But after experiencing so much, Ding Ling had already confirmed.
It was indeed a game.
But Diao Chan, Zhao Yun and the others were definitely not as simple as NPCs. Each one of them was most likely a living person!
This Three Kingdoms World could very well be a real world.
As for why it was a high-tier Three Kingdoms comparable to the Martial World?
That remains unknown.
"And Da Qiao's illness was also caused by them?"
Ding Ling frowned:
"Able to make moves under Zhou Yu's nose and succeed! No wonder these guys are so arrogant and overbearing? They might be so overly confident?"
These rich kids may be greenhouse flowers.
But their means and intelligence seem to be intact.
It's easy to understand.
Like a high-ranking person telling a near-starving refugee 'why not eat meat porridge', it's the same logic. Some people, standing at a high position, cannot see other places clearly.
Vision determines speech.
Just like Yuan Yin.
Too presumptuous.
In the end, did something foolish and lost their life.
But in essence, they weren't foolish.
Tap tap!
Footsteps sounded.
It was a soldier from the County Government Office.
"Reporting to the General, Xu Sheng has been found."
That Ding Ling was the Tiger Valor General had already been spread by the County Magistrate, so the soldiers showed some respect for Ding Ling.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"Where is he?"
"We've trapped him in a dense forest with hundreds of people."
"Zhao Yun, you go and bring Xu Sheng back."
Ding Ling ordered.
"Yes."
Zhao Yun immediately followed the soldier away.
Ding Ling then returned to the Qiao Mansion.
Listening to Da Qiao's report.
Ding Ling became more certain that the culprits were players.
Because the Qiao Family lacked nothing else.
Only the ancestral Breathing Technique, Martial Arts Secret Manual, and the family's Great Medicine disappeared without a trace.
Other treasures like gold and silver were only slightly taken.
Evidently, the other party was decisive and swift, targeting precisely the Breathing Technique, martial arts, and Great Medicine.
Initially, their goal was definitely Zhou Yu and Daoist Yhiuu Ji's Breathing Technique and martial arts.
Later on, Ding Ling unintentionally disrupted their plans.
So they targeted the Qiao Family.
Achieved their goal and escaped.
And they timed it perfectly before Ding Ling arrived at the Qiao Mansion.
This was a silent provocation to Ding Ling!

Ding Ling sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 206: Skill Cracking and Target Locking
paragraphs: This group of guys.
"Ning Yi, Ning Zhen? I'll remember them."
Ding Ling has decided to take some time to investigate Ning Yi and his group's background in reality.
Once everything is clear.
Then check their online IDs, pinpoint their post content, and analyze their location.
Then strike with a capture.
If he can't deal with this group of people this time.
They'd really think Ding Ling is easy to bully!
Zhao Yun took Xu Sheng back to the Qiao Family.
Thud!
He threw Xu Sheng onto the training ground floor.
Ding Ling assessed Xu Sheng.
Delicate and pretty features, looks like he's thirteen or fourteen.
Yet with a strong and powerful build, he's undoubtedly material for a fierce general!
No wonder he's young yet has become the Qiao Family's small commander of the guards.
But no matter how strong.
As a youth, Xu Sheng still wouldn't be a match for Zhao Yun now, would he?
Not an opponent for Zhao Yun, easily captured and brought here.
At this moment, he pursed his lips, stubbornly raised his head to look at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was startled, then chuckled:
"Xu Sheng, do you know what kind of nonsense you've done, still so obstinate now?!"
"I didn't do anything wrong."
Xu Sheng said firmly:
"I was just repaying a favor."
"Repaying a favor means killing your own master?"
Ding Ling sneered:
"What kind of favor is this you're repaying?"
Xu Sheng's face flushed:
"I didn't kill anyone. I just led the guards a bit farther, pretending not to know what happened in the study."
"In essence, it's still you indirectly causing the death of Lord Qiao!"
Ding Ling scolded:

"You're the commander of the inner courtyard! Fully responsible for Lord Qiao's safety, yet what did you do? Letting murderers go by boldly is one thing, but even allowing them to escape from the Qiao's place. You can't escape responsibility!"
Xu Sheng was speechless, dejected, hanging his head without refuting.
"If you still have some conscience, just reveal those murderers' origins, whereabouts, and everything they've done to the Qiao's."
Ding Ling didn't hold back with Xu Sheng:
"Otherwise, you'll either rot in jail or lose your life."
"I'm not afraid of death."
Xu Sheng stiffened his neck:
"The winner is king, the loser is bandit. Falling into your hands now, do as you please!"
"You!
Da Qiao's eyes reddened, tearfully said:
"Xu Sheng, we believe we've treated you well. How can you do this to us?"
Xu Sheng blushed, ashamed, his just-raised head hung down as if frostbitten, merely argued:
"I didn't kill anyone. I didn't kill anyone!"
"Will you say it or not?"
Ding Ling frowned and asked.
"I will not betray my benefactor!"
Xu Sheng said firmly:
"As for the master's death, I am responsible too."
He glanced at Da and Xiao Qiao, bit his lips, then suddenly crashed his head into the side steps:
"I'm sorry to you, Young Master. I will exchange one life for another."
Bang!
The sound hadn't finished when a heavy bang accompanied it.
Ding Ling and the others couldn't stop him in time.
Xu Sheng had already crashed heavily into the steps, head bleeding, flipped onto the ground, his life unknown.
The place fell into a dead silence.
Ding Ling didn't expect Xu Sheng, being so young, to be this fierce.
This was somewhat unexpected.
"Forget it."
Ding Ling, losing interest, waved his hand:
"If Xu Sheng hasn't died, take him for treatment; if he has died, bury him well. As for those murderers, I will find a way to dig them out."
Da and Xiao Qiao had long lost their backbone.
Whatever Ding Ling says essentially happens.
Ding Ling sent Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng to accompany Da and Xiao Qiao.
He himself found a single room in the Qiao Family's inner courtyard, locked the door.
Chose to return to reality.
After some time.
Reality.
Swoosh!
Ding Ling, holding a laptop, rushed through the mountains and wilderness, sometimes like a flying crane spreading its wings, a leap spanning dozens of meters;
Sometimes like a Feiyan skimming water, with toes lightly flicking on one tree after another, maneuvering and dodging among tall trees, nothing impeded.
Along the way, he sped wildly.
Like the windstorm, like lightning.
Not slower than a galloping horse.
Upon reaching a small town dozens of miles from his residence.
Ding Ling immediately opened his laptop.
Started hacking nearby WiFi.
After breaking and connecting to the network.

Ding Ling first checked the laptop, ensuring no personal information was present, then began using hacking skills to search 'Ning Zhen,' 'Ning Yi,' 'Xu Sheng,' 'Zhou Yu,' 'Da Qiao' and other keywords in the Mythology Game Forum.
After a while.
Under a post by Da Qiao.
Locked onto a person.
This person's ID is 'I am Human Emperor'!
The words were extremely sharp and arrogant.
Claiming they've already dealt with Da Qiao, as long as everything goes smoothly, Da Qiao will be in his bag.
Below naturally are many comments.
With praise, doubt, more are disdain.
This person got angry.
Let these people wait, soon, he would prove to everyone.
Recalling what happened with Da Qiao, Ding Ling immediately locked the ID 'I am Human Emperor,' began using hacking technology to search his post records.
Thus pinpointing his approximate location, following the internet line hacked into his personal computer, quickly browsing various data on his computer.
After half a day.
Ding Ling got the information he wanted, immediately began 'destroying evidence' on the network.
Finished with that.
Closing the computer.
Turned around and ran back home, ate to replenish energy, put on the game helmet, entered the Game World.
Game World.
Qiao Family.
Inner courtyard.
Ding Ling pushed open the door, called Zhao Yun, along with three squads of troops from the County Government Office, totaling three hundred people.
Headed straight to a farm a dozen miles outside Wan County Town!
Ding Ling just logged in online, hacked into Ning Yi and their online chat group, already confirmed that Ning Zhen, Ning Yi, and their players would divide loot here at the Zhang Family Farm!
They ran separately.
And still acting in several groups together.
Even some have been covert operatives at Zhou Yu's place.
Now these operatives will return for the loot division.
After all, Breathing Technique, Great Medicine, High Tier Martial Arts are too rare.
No one would give them up.
Main group members are gathering, discussing how best to divide the 'items' evenly, it's a very normal matter.
"Luckily these people were too arrogant, thought the most dangerous place is the safest place, hid not far from Wan County. This is seeking death."
That's secondary.
More importantly.
They probably looked down on Ding Ling.
Assuming Ding Ling on his own couldn't possibly find them.
Even if Ding Ling truly used the troops, they were particularly hidden, just in the Zhang Family Farm cellar.
Moreover, Zhang Family Farm's owner is their benefactor, loyal to them!
Under such circumstances!
Who can find them?
Only Ding Ling, cheating and hacking, using full level skills, directly invaded their computer.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 207: Players Targeting Ding Ling
paragraphs: For others.
Perhaps there's really nothing they could do about these people.
After all, not everyone possesses full level skills like Ding Ling, and not everyone is an All-Powerful King!
But who told them to run into Ding Ling and then provoke and intimidate him!
How could Ding Ling endure this?
In the real world, there's nothing he can do, so he has to endure.
But in the game world, does he still have to endure?
He wouldn't be Ding Ling then!
Clatter clatter!
Thunderous horse hooves echoed through the heavens and the earth.
Quickly arriving at the Zhang Family Farm.
At Ding Ling's command.
Three hundred troops surrounded the farm completely, everyone drew bows and nocked arrows, directly pointing into the farm.
The manor master of the Zhang Family Farm was a middle-aged man who looked about thirty-five or thirty-six.
He appeared extremely simple.
Seeing the soldiers and horses surrounding the farm, he couldn't help but panic, opened the door, and shouted loudly to Ding Ling:
"General, have I committed any crimes? Why are you treating me like this?"
He could immediately tell that Ding Ling was the leader.
He had the keen judgment.
Ding Ling gave Zhao Yun a glance, and Zhao Yun immediately rode into the farm, the manor master couldn't stop him.
Shortly after.
From the location of the farm's cellar came shouts, screams, and roarings.
Accompanied by the clang of metal piercing the air.
Thud thud!
As if someone's forehead was pierced.
Everything quieted down.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow and looked at the manor master.
His face was white as a sheet, extremely unpleasant.
Ding Ling ignored him.
Aiding the villain.
Or perhaps repaying a favor?
No matter, the manor master wasn't on his side. But that Ning Yi, Ning Zhen and their group being able to subdue people like Xu Sheng and others, was quite something.
Clatter clatter!
Zhao Yun rode back, now holding a blood-stained package:
"General, I've fulfilled my mission!"
In front of strangers, Zhao Yun still showed great respect to Ding Ling, often using formal language.
In front of insiders.
Ding Ling wouldn't let Zhao Yun call him General, it felt awkward to hear.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling took the package Zhao Yun handed over, opened it, and inside there were indeed a few Great Medicines, several Secret Manuals, some Gold, and a Divine Sword.
As expected.
These should all belong to the Qiao Family.
Ding Ling resisted the urge to look through the Secret Manuals.
He said to the troops beside him:

"You guys take shifts. One squad at night, one in the morning, and one in the afternoon. You must keep a tight watch on the location of the cellar. Every time they appear, kill them once. Kill them until they never appear again!"
Regarding how hard it was to kill an Alien.
Many local Natives gradually came to understand.
Moreover, because the player community tended to fight amongst themselves, many players even chose to reveal player secrets to gain favor from some Natives.
Such as how to kill players;
How to render players incapacitated, and so on.
All sorts of tricks existed!
Focusing on one location to kill players, reducing their skills to level zero. Reducing their level to 0.
That player would basically be useless!
Very hard to get back up.
Ding Ling's plan now is to do this to Ning Yi, Ning Zhen and their group.
Kill them until they're terrified!
Turn them into true wastrels!
Ding Ling had a vague feeling, that if a person's level truly dropped to 0.
That maybe even if they don't die, they wouldn't live long.
After all, this world is no different from the real one.
Conservation of energy!
Where does the energy for players to revive after dying come from?
Probably at the cost of their own life and soul?
After all, that's probably all players have to offer.
That's what Ding Ling speculated.
The truth of the matter still needs confirmation. But he absolutely won't allow himself to die even once.
After all, risks can't be taken lightly.
Who knows what strange things might happen after dying and reviving?
In the next few days.
Ning Zhen, Ning Yi, and a few other players were killed to the point of collapse by the stationed troops!
After their skills dropped to zero.
They were so scared that they didn't dare to log in.
They were bewildered, not knowing where things went wrong.
Eventually, they found out the reason through a bounty on a forum.
"It was Ding Ling who was behind this!"
There were quite a few players in Lujiang County, Wan County, and once the bounty was out, some players who knew the whole story immediately ratted out Ding Ling.
Ding Ling had no plans to hide.
Because this matter couldn't be concealed at all!
After all, players are everywhere, trying to truly hide from them would only be possible in sparsely populated areas.
In Lujiang County, Wan County, because of Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhou Yu, and others.
There were especially many players.
Ding Ling couldn't possibly hide from them. So he acted openly and directly, hitting them with a blitzkrieg!
After Ning Yi and his group realized it, they were furious:
"That guy, he stole our opportunity! Hurt our people! And even attempts to completely lock us down! Reduce us to level 0! It's intolerable, we have to find a way to eliminate him!"

"Right. Mobilize the family's power, find out Ding Ling's real-world location, and issue a high-price bounty on the outside web targeting Ding Ling! I'm sure many foreign mercenaries would be very interested."

"But I'm afraid the old man at home won't agree. After all, Ding Ling's real identity has never been fully investigated. The old man is afraid of provoking some big figure, so we must stay low-key and cautious, not provoke Ding Ling casually."

"Hmph. Ding Ling is just an ordinary person! Look how scared you are! I have repeatedly reviewed Ding Ling's information, and I'm very sure he has no background! As for why he's so strong, he probably just got lucky!"
Ning Yi and his group argued.
Some believed Ding Ling had extraordinary talent and background, and were unwilling to target him in reality.
Some insisted on killing Ding Ling;
Each had their own opinion and reasonable arguments. Finally, the group parted ways, unhappy.
"Cowards!"
Ning Yi sneered at the departing Luo Kun and his group:

"So afraid of death and timid, what big things can you accomplish! Previously in the game, it was them that held us back! If it weren't for them, maybe directly confronting Ding Ling would have been more effective!"
"Let's not talk about this anymore."
Ning Zhen couldn't agree with Ning Yi, as Ding Ling really had a ferocious nature in the game world, provoking him could likely get one stabbed to death directly, he wouldn't take that risk:
"Let's discuss how much bounty money is suitable? And which country's mercenaries should we hire?"
Ding Ling didn't know he was about to be put on an outside web bounty.
Time flows back a few days.
After delivering a thunderous blow to the players, Ding Ling returned to the Qiao Family and gave the seized package to Da and Xiao Qiao.
Da and Xiao Qiao opened the package to see the sword inside, instantly tearing up.
"This is father's cherished Mo Ye Sword."
Da Qiao picked up the Divine Sword, grasped the hilt, and pulled it out with a clang! In the ringing of the sword, the dazzling gleam appeared under the sunlight!
Ding Ling clearly saw the two characters engraved on the blade:
Mo Ye!
His pupils slightly contracted.
Feeling a sense of wonder in his heart.
How could it be such a coincidence?
To encounter another ancient Divine Sword here!
The Gan Jiang and Mo Ye Sword, both are true ancient Divine Swords!

After all, not everyone possesses full level skills like Ding Ling, and not everyone is an All-Powerful King!
But who told them to run into Ding Ling and then provoke and intimidate him!

chapters.title: Chapter 208 208: Mo Ye Sword! Qing Frost Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: The legend of the Gan Jiang and Mo Ye Sword is one that has been told for thousands of years, familiar to many.
Ding Ling was naturally no exception.
"Indeed, it's my father's treasured sword."
Xiao Qiao sobbed:
"It seems those thieves were truly captured by Ding Ling."
She and Da Qiao greeted Ding Ling with gratitude and respect.
Ding Ling waved his hand, suggesting that they were all friends, and there was no need for such formality.
Da Qiao was even more grateful and without hesitation handed the Secret Manual and Great Medicine to Ding Ling:

"At the Daoist Temple, Daoist Yhiuu Ji mentioned your unification of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique and urgent need for Great Medicine. Take these first. I'll check the Medicine Warehouse later with my sister, and if there are more, we will pass them to you."
She apologized:
"Previously, I was so distraught over my father's situation that I lost my mind and forgot about this. I hope you'll forgive me."
She blushed and pushed the Secret Manual and Great Medicine into Ding Ling's arms:
"It should be yours according to the spoils of victory, and we should return them to you. By no means should you refuse, otherwise, I would truly be ashamed."
Da Qiao was so polite and sensible.
Ding Ling couldn't be more courteous or pretentious, so he nodded and accepted them.
Da Qiao breathed a sigh of relief and gently caressed the body of the Mo Ye Sword, speaking softly:
"This sword is a family heirloom treasure. Father once told us, where the home is, the sword is! Unless absolutely necessary, this blade should not be wielded. But now..."
At this point.
Her voice trembled slightly, and her complexion instantly dimmed.
Ding Ling then signaled Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng to help arrange Lord Qiao's funeral affairs.
Ding Ling returned directly to the inner courtyard room.
Took out the Secret Manual.
Carefully inspected it.
After some time.
A virtual book appeared on the bookshelf, and it was precisely the "Feibai Breathing Technique"!
This was the ancestral Breathing Technique of the Da and Xiao Qiao family.
It is indeed remarkable!
Practicing to the Transformation Realm, Ding Ling estimated that his agility would reach 30 points.
This was evidently a Breathing Technique focused on agility and strength.
Very mysterious.
It's known that External Refining Breathing Techniques generally focus on defense and strength,
while Inner Refining Breathing Techniques focus on agility and constitution.
The Feibai Breathing Technique focuses on agility and strength.
It is clearly extraordinary.
Unfortunately, Ding Ling has now practiced three Breathing Techniques, reaching his limit, and cannot practice another one.
Unless it is an Inner Refining Breathing Technique?
Perhaps he could still practice another?
The truth of this, Ding Ling is not sure.

But he knows he absolutely cannot practice three External Refining Breathing Techniques, as the Vigorous Qi of External Refining Breathing Techniques permeates the skin membranes and meridians, and if practiced further, the skin membranes and meridians might burst under the stress.
And the reason he can withstand an Inner Refining Breathing Technique.

Is because the focus of the Taiqing Breathing Technique's Vigorous Qi is spread throughout the internal organs, while the skin membranes and meridians, although containing the Vigorous Qi of Inner Refining Breathing Techniques, are not the focal areas, much like how External Refining does not focus on the internal organs.
Because of this.
When Inner and Outer are united.
The Vigorous Qi blends seamlessly!
Achieving a state with no weaknesses, no flaws.
Every part of the body can be thoroughly cared for, enhanced, and strengthened!
Thus realizing a truly unrivaled prowess!
"Next book."
Ding Ling flipped through the second Secret Manual.
After a quick browsing.
A book immediately appeared on the library bookshelf.
In an instant.
[Qing Frost Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
The essence of Qing Frost Swordsmanship surged and flowed within the sea of consciousness for just a moment before swiftly darting into the limbs and bones, transforming into an instinct.
Whoosh!
A sharp Sword Intent with a cold frost aura emanated from Ding Ling!
His practice of this Sword Technique had evidently reached the Transformation Realm!

Ding Ling, using his hand as a sword, casually waved, and it seemed as if a sword light appeared and disappeared in the void, resembling the flying snow of winter, the ice beads of dawn, delivering a chill, beautifully to the most extreme coldness!
"This Flying Frost Swordsmanship is indeed extraordinary."
Ding Ling was greatly amazed.
Originally thinking that the family Methods of Lord Qiao would just be a bit superior compared to lower-tier Martial Arts.
He did not expect to directly obtain something not inferior to Ghost Prison Spear Technique or Shadow Arrow Skill, such high-level Martial Arts!
"Most importantly, the strength indeed broke through the shackles!"
Ding Ling rejoiced.
The strength only increased by 0.1.
But it gave him hope of becoming a Celestial Human Realm powerhouse!
Boom!
Ding Ling slightly clenched his fist, as if the void at this moment was gripped by him to emit electric light!
His strength seemed to have already broken through this world's shackles and constraints, reaching a transcendent level.
With a casual strike.
It seemed he could possess powerful strength.
Compared to before when his power was at 30 points.
Though it appears only stronger by 0.1.
But the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method makes this strength more concentrated, with no waste, the Vigorous Qi emitted is as solid as a steel spear, extremely terrifying.
To put it bluntly.
The previous Vigorous Qi seemed as fragile as tofu or eggs.
Now it seems like wood.
Completely not on the same level!
Especially as the power breaks through the shackle of 30.
This feeling becomes more apparent.
Ding Ling understands this is not an illusion, it is an incredibly powerful transformation brought about by continually breaking free from the world's constraints.

"If the transformation continues further. Perhaps the Vigorous Qi can truly undergo a completely earth-shattering transformation, at that time a casual strike akin to a steel spear explosion, ordinary Super-Elite Generals would probably die upon touching it, perish if they brush against it!"
Ding Ling was enchanted beyond measure.
He just tried it.
The transformation of Vigorous Qi is indeed occurring, and it seems far from over.
When he completes the transformation.
The energy burst from a casual strike will definitely be terrifyingly explosive!
"Can't wait."
Ding Ling took out the Great Medicine and took a bite.
Crunch!
The medicinal power surged into his belly.
Quickly being refined and absorbed.
But there was no notification.
Ding Ling simply crunched up a whole stalk.
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
Ding Ling's eyes slightly brightened.
"It really is possible. After the Unity of Inner and Outer, consuming Great Medicine simultaneously enhances four dimensions! Truly surprising!"
Ding Ling was delighted.
He was sure the Great Medicine he just consumed definitely did not exceed 600 years.
Yet still had such results.
Clearly, the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Techniques had completely refined and absorbed the medicinal power of this Great Medicine thoroughly.
"Continue."
After consuming the remaining five stalks of Great Medicine.
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
[Defense +0.3]
The growth in four-dimensional attributes is extremely balanced!
And the utilization of Great Medicine is at its peak, far surpassing the two External Refining Breathing Techniques in instinct.
"No wonder Wang Yue and others said that after the Unity of Breathing Techniques, one would be unparalleled."
After eating several stalks of Great Medicine, Ding Ling felt this very vividly.
"The utilization rate is not only high, but the quality of the refined and back-fed Vigorous Qi is also high! The forging and hammering of skin membranes, meridians, etc., far surpasses the past."
This is just a few stalks of Great Medicine.
What if he could consume more Great Medicine?

chapters.title: Chapter 209 209: Da and Xiao Qiao Follow Ding Ling
paragraphs: Ding Ling's gaze turned towards the Northern Lands.
He remembered the bounty the Yuan Family had placed on him.
Now it's time to settle the score with them.
He glanced at the Character Panel.
Strength: [Root Bone 1 (1 point for a normal person), Intelligence 2.1, Power 30.5, Agility 25, Constitution (26.4), Defense (30.4), Charm (7).]
Several instances of strength increase.
Now Ding Ling's power and defense have risen again, breaking the limit values of the External Refining Breathing Technique!
Agility and constitution have also steadily increased, and it's probably not far from reaching their peak.
Most importantly, his Vigorous Qi has become more condensed and fierce! Far surpassing the past!
"I just don't know to what level I can break the limit values?"
"When the time comes, can the Vigorous Qi be condensed to rival a steel spear?"
Ding Ling was quite looking forward to it.
He stood up tall, pushed the door open, and went out, taking Zhao Yun with him to help arrange Lord Qiao's affairs.
Da and Xiao Qiao's mother passed away early due to war and plague.
It was Lord Qiao who raised them single-handedly.
Their feelings, attachment, and admiration for Lord Qiao were extraordinary,
now that Lord Qiao is dead.
The vast Qiao Mansion now only had Da and Xiao Qiao as the ones in charge.

Although Da Qiao was more responsible, bold, and resilient than Xiao Qiao, she too was raised with Lord Qiao's love; suddenly losing the 'backbone' made her panic and helplessness overflow onto her face!
She was sad, despairing, regretful...
Every day she was in a daze.
If it weren't for Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng accompanying her, she might have already collapsed. Though now she was nearly broken, at least she still held onto her sanity.
Ding Ling stayed in Wan County for a few days.
And thoroughly dealt with Lord Qiao's affairs.
Only then did he propose to say goodbye.
Da and Xiao Qiao looked at Ding Ling, completely lost.
During this time, because Ding Ling, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun lived and ate with them, helping with Lord Qiao's burial, etc.
They developed a feeling that Ding Ling and the others were their reliance, their confidants.
For them, who admired, were grateful, and idolized Ding Ling, they had unconsciously taken him as their mainstay, an indispensable presence.
One could only say, Ding Ling and his group's appearance was timely, entering Da and Xiao Qiao's hearts like a warm sun when they were most empty, collapsed, and fragile. How could they forget?
Now that the warm sun was leaving.
Da and Xiao Qiao suddenly panicked and instinctively voiced their wish to stay.
But as they spoke, their voices grew quieter.
Because they suddenly realized they couldn't possibly keep Ding Ling in Wan County to accompany them forever.

Da Qiao's almond-shaped eyes, as gentle as water, glanced around, then looked at Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan. She suddenly bit her lip, stepped forward, grabbed Diao Chan's hand, but fixed her gaze on Ding Ling:
"I want to follow you to venture into the world!"
"What?!"
Ding Ling was taken aback:
"This..."
He had really never thought of taking Da and Xiao Qiao away.
After all, he didn't need burdens.
Although he liked beautiful women,
he wasn't so obsessed as to be mad with lust.
He wouldn't take every woman home to marry.
Even if Da and Xiao Qiao were stunning beauties, with Da Qiao being gentle, dignified, understanding, and resilient, with courage and insight;
Xiao Qiao being lively, adorable, and charming in her naivety.
But Ding Ling only regarded them as friends.
Thus, Da Qiao's sudden words caught him off guard.
"I want to follow you too."
Seeing Da Qiao being like this, Xiao Qiao stepped forward and hugged Du Qingcheng's waist, saying bashfully:
"Sister Du, don't leave me behind. I can't live without you!"
Du Qingcheng took good care of Xiao Qiao.
The two had already become best friends!
"This..."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng exchanged looks and couldn't help but look at Ding Ling.
Clearly, they wanted Ding Ling to make a decision.
Da and Xiao Qiao also knew it was Ding Ling who called the shots, and their almond eyes, filled with emotion, eagerly looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was in a headache.
He thought for a moment.
Then said:

"Venturing into the world involves life-threatening risks. Are you sure you want to follow? Moreover, I might be charging onto the battlefield at any moment. Your martial skills are so lacking that I can't bear the responsibility if anything happens to you."
"Though our martial arts are lacking, our progress in practicing the Breathing Technique isn't weak."
Da Qiao seemed to have made up her mind, saying resolutely:

"Previously, we felt learning martial arts wasn't necessary, which led to neglect. But from today, we'll dedicate ourselves to learning from Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng. Become heroine warriors! You see, my sister and I aren't poor in terms of root bone. I believe we can achieve it!"
This was indeed true.
When Ding Ling treated Da Qiao, he felt her bones.
You could only say her bone structure was extraordinary, quite unusual!
It must be acknowledged that such unparalleled beauties renowned in later generations rarely had poor root bone talent. At least one aspect would be extremely outstanding.
Clearly.
Da and Xiao Qiao had impressive martial arts talent; with proper cultivation, they wouldn't be inferior to Diao Chan!
Most importantly.

Because of their affluent family background, Da and Xiao Qiao didn't lack medicinal baths, and the Feibai Breathing Technique was a top-tier External Refining Breathing Technique; their attainments in the Breathing Technique were also exceptional.
If given time to practice martial arts earnestly, they could make rapid progress, transforming their previous foundations into strength.
Becoming second-rate Military Generals would probably be just a matter of time.

"Yes. Ding Ling. Da and Xiao Qiao don't like wielding weapons; they prefer needlework and reading. That's why their martial skills are poor. If they work hard in the future, they'll surely learn well."
Having spent considerable time with Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan also felt softened by their persistence and added a few words on their behalf.
Ding Ling looked at Zhao Yun.
Zhao Yun had a look that said, 'the decision is yours.'
Ding Ling was silent for a while, then nodded, agreeing.
Da and Xiao Qiao were overjoyed.
Immediately, Da Qiao decided:
"Then I'll go and dismiss the servants now. Sell off the family property and leave with you."
"Is it really necessary to sell off the family property?"
Ding Ling hesitated.
"From now on, I'll follow you, Brother Ding Ling. Wherever you go, my sister and I will follow. Why keep such a large mansion?"
Da Qiao was undeterred:
"Besides, now that Father is gone, keeping the mansion only makes one feel sentimental and sad. I believe Father in heaven will understand us."
Her body trembled slightly, as if she remembered something unpleasant.
Ding Ling, seeing this, had no choice but to nod and let Diao Chan and the others help settle things.
After a day.
Da and Xiao Qiao traveled lightly.
With Ding Ling's deterrence and Diao Chan's voluntary help.
Da and Xiao Qiao's actions were quite smooth.
They sold off all their family's property.
Turning it into several parcels in the carriage.
One parcel contained dozens of Great Medicines.
A few contained gold;
The rest were various valuable herbs.
Filling up two carriages.
Da and Xiao Qiao immediately stated the Great Medicines were for Ding Ling to use.
The other herbs were for Diao Chan and the others to use in medicinal baths.
The gold would be shared.
Obviously out of a lack of security, hoping to earn Ding Ling and their acceptance.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 210: Celestial Human Realm (21/21)
paragraphs: Ding Ling smiled wryly.
Da and Xiao Qiao lost their father and their home.
Moreover, they were not very old.
Gambling everything on Ding Ling and his team for recognition was quite understandable.
Seeing Da and Xiao Qiao's eager expressions.
Ding Ling couldn't refuse their goodwill, and thus agreed.
"Whew."
Only then did Da and Xiao Qiao seem to let out a heavy sigh of relief.
Clearly.
Earlier, their hearts were all clenched.
The future was uncertain, without knowing where to go!
They could only follow Ding Ling and wander the world, feeling uneasy, seeking stability, seeking recognition from Ding Ling and his team, which was entirely understandable.
Moreover, Ding Ling and his team's martial skills were all formidable, not to mention Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Diao Chan's attacks to kill enemies were crisp, decisive, and extremely fierce.
Made Da and Xiao Qiao dumbfounded and increasingly anxious, with a growing desire for strength in their hearts.
After all, killing was too bloody.
Like lambs, they were bullied by anyone. Isn't this dragging Ding Ling and his team's progress?
They didn't want to become burdens either.
Therefore, after gaining Ding Ling's recognition.
They started to seek martial arts guidance.

When they discovered that Ding Ling was extremely familiar with their family martial arts, they were shocked and instantly recalled Ding Ling's deeds at the Daoist temple and Diao Chan's description of him.
Da and Xiao Qiao felt relieved and relieved.
Though the family supreme skill was not mastered as deeply as Ding Ling, they were still blushed and embarrassed.
Practiced diligently every day, asking Ding Ling for what they didn't understand or consulting Diao Chan and others on skills like Flying Swallow Technique.
After Diao Chan and others taught Ding Ling the Flying Swallow Technique.
They then taught Zhao Yun.
Now that Da and Xiao Qiao received their recognition, they passed it on without hesitation, thinking there's no need for favoritism since they're all in the same team.
Having an extra lightweight body technique greatly increases the chances of survival!
Clip-clop!
The group rode on horseback.
Traveling by day.
Resting by night.
Da and Xiao Qiao practiced the Breathing Technique and Sword Skill diligently in the carriage day and night.
At night.
Ding Ling would start preparing a medicinal bath for them.
In towns, they stayed at inns.
In the wild, they found places with springs, creeks, and so on. This also facilitated preparing the medicinal bath.
The skills of Da and Xiao Qiao, Diao Chan, and others steadily improved.
One day.
In the wild.
At night.
The bright moon hung high.
After the medicinal bath, Diao Chan and others were studying martial arts.
Ding Ling then started consuming Great Medicine.
Hundreds of Great Medicine.
Da and Xiao Qiao all indicated they were for Ding Ling.
Thus, while Diao Chan and others took medicinal baths, they firmly avoided using Great Medicine.
In their words: "As long as Ding Ling becomes strong enough, they would feel more secure!"
To this.
Ding Ling could only secretly decide: Once he truly achieves the Celestial Human Realm! He must spare no effort to cultivate Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and others into Super-Elite Peak experts!
As for whether they can break through the established barriers and reach the Celestial Human Realm?
That depends on their individual fate.
After all, not everyone can cheat like Ding Ling.
Crack!
Crack!
One Great Medicine after another was swallowed by Ding Ling.
The Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique swiftly operated.
A powerful warmth streaked through four limbs and bones, vital organs everywhere!
Surging medicinal power seemed to turn into heavy hammers striking, forcefully opening meridians, tempering the skin membrane to turn it into steel armor!
Moreover, the medicinal power stretched the muscles and bones!
A tendon rising like flying dragons, constantly swelling and contracting, becoming more resilient and thicker!
Between breaths, as the waterfall-like medicinal power rushed in, the organs' vitality and endurance were continuously activated and enhanced.
Ding Ling's agility and constitution also grew and improved in return.
When Ding Ling had swallowed a total of forty-nine Great Medicines.
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.7]
[Constitution +0.7]
[Defense +0.6]
The growth in four-dimensional attributes is no longer balanced!
Strength change:
[Root bone 1 (ordinary people 1 point), Wisdom 2.1, Strength 31, Agility 25.7, Constitution 27.1, Defense 31, Charm 7.]
When Strength and Defense reached 31.
Ding Ling realized he had reached the ultimate limit!
Swallowing more Great Medicine, Strength and Defense will not increase anymore, only increasing Agility and Constitution!
However, what surprised Ding Ling was.
When Strength reached 31 points.
He found that any casual strike would cause the void to erupt with infinite air waves.
With a sword in hand.
Any casual sword slash, the vigorous Qi seemed to materialize in the void, transformed into strands of Sword Qi sweeping across the front!
"Qing Frost Swordsmanship!"
Ding Ling wielded the Giant Que Sword, icy and frost-like Qi shot out, condensing into flying snow, spinning into the grass and trees ahead.
Snap-crackle-pop!
Clang!
Thud!
A chaotic sound broke through the skies.
In front, the thorny plants and a tall tree were all cut down completely!
Zhao Yun was shocked.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng turned to look, horrified:
"Such power?!"
"How's that possible?!"
They crowded around.
Especially Da and Xiao Qiao, incredulously looking at the destruction caused by Ding Ling:
"Is this my family's ancestral Qing Frost Swordsmanship?!"
They clicked their tongues, stunned:
"Why is it so different from our play?"
Feeling like Ding Ling wielded it as if the Sword God was splitting Heaven and Earth.
Whereas they were like kids playing house.
There's a world of difference.
"I seem to have reached the Celestial Human Realm."
Ding Ling comprehended and explained:
"After reaching this realm. The world can no longer bind me, any casual strike seems to have the might of Heaven and Earth!"
Boom!
Ding Ling slashed with Qing Frost Swordsmanship towards a large tree ten meters away.
Boom!
Vigorous Qi flew, turning into spinning snowflakes, which, in a series of snaps, sliced through a tree with a diameter of one meter!
Zhao Yun and others were dumbfounded, looking at Ding Ling as though he were a Celestial God:
"This is unbelievable! Such ability. Such strength!"
"Yeah."
Ding Ling was also deeply shocked:
"I really did not expect enhancing Strength by one point could lead to such revolutionary changes!"
"It's as if..."
Ding Ling pondered, coming to an understanding:

"My strength has transcended beyond this world. Hence, any casual strike could invoke the resonance of Heaven and Earth, augmenting its power! Think of this as the true Celestial Human Realm. In a sense, it's reaching a level comparable with the heavens, really a true Earth Immortal!"
Da and Xiao Qiao nodded vigorously.
This powerful.
It's really no different from an Immortal!
"Turns out this is the real Esoteric Truth of Unity of Inner and Outer."
Zhao Yun was envious and excited:
"I just don't know if I can learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"Before Daoist Yhiuu Ji left, he hinted. If I found someone destined, I could pass on the Taiqing Breathing Technique and Taiqing Talisman. I feel Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng are destined with me."
