chapters.title: Chapter 211 211: Invisible Aura Shield as Strong as Steel (1/12)
paragraphs: Ding Ling's greatest strength is the ability to go all out!
So if some martial arts heritage can aid Zhao Yun and the others in their growth, Ding Ling wouldn't hesitate to provide it.
After all, Ding Ling knows a lot of martial arts.
Others know them too.
For instance, Taiqing Breathing Technique, Daoist Yhiuu Ji knows it.
Ding Ling has no need to hold back.
This is secondary.
What matters most is that Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and the others, as his followers, are extremely loyal and protective of him!
Such friends, comrades, teammates.
What reason does Ding Ling have to abandon, to give up?
If he can abandon Zhao Yun and the others, what differentiates him from a beast?
What's more, he had already decided earlier that he must help them reach the pinnacle of Super-Elite Fierce Generals.
How could he go against his own word?
"Does that mean I can learn it too?"
Diao Chan was pleasantly surprised.
"Of course."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"As long as you can cultivate the External Refining Breathing Technique to Mastery, I will aid you in learning the Inner Refining Breathing Technique."
Cultivating the Inner Refining Breathing Technique is exceedingly difficult.
The resultant struggles of exploring the cultivation alone can be akin to Daoist Yhiuu Ji, spending a lifetime on the road of cultivation and exploration, groping in the dark, immensely challenging.
Yet if there's guidance and assistance.
Especially if Ding Ling, this 'all-powerful' who's Full Level in the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method, offers guidance and help.
It's like catching the wind, one can ascend straight to the Ninefold Heaven!
The effect is incomparable.
To speak of whose understanding of the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method is the deepest?
Who's better than Ding Ling?
With him overseeing, you at least won't 'lose control' resulting in being either crippled or dying violently.
Throughout history
How many have achieved Full Level in the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method?
Absolutely few!
Indeed, geniuses who successfully cultivate Unity of Inner and Outer are exceptionally rare.
How could they compare to Ding Ling in reaching Full Level Mastery?
Zhao Yun and their qualifications are extremely high; with Ding Ling's Full Level guidance, it's akin to walking by themselves then being rocketed, the progress will certainly soar.
They seem to realize this point too and are delighted and excited, thanking Ding Ling repeatedly.
Ding Ling waved his hand indicating no need for such formality, they're all part of the same team, all his own people!
Upon hearing 'his own people.'
Da and Xiao Qiao were momentarily stunned, then quite exhilarated.
They're not afraid of wandering homeless; they're afraid of not gaining Ding Ling's recognition.
Now Ding Ling can truly recognize them, their hearts, naturally, have found solace.
After all.
From now on, they're also people with a family!
As for where the home is?
Wherever Ding Ling and Diao Chan are. That's where home is!
They used to have their home with their father. But after he left, they were without a home. Fortunately, they met Ding Ling and the others in time, regaining the sense of home and warmth!
"You guys cultivate well. I'll continue consuming Great Medicine."
Ding Ling nodded towards Diao Chan and the others.
Then he walked to the side to continue consuming Great Medicine.
The Great Medicine he'd consumed before.
Most are less than four to three hundred years old.
Compared to those consumed earlier, they differ considerably.
Though the earlier few weren't more than six hundred years, they were still over five hundred years, extremely rare indeed.
The reason Ding Ling can determine the age of the Great Medicine.
Apart from his high cultivation and being in the Transformation Realm of Medical Dao.
It's also because he's consumed various Great Medicine from one hundred to one thousand years, comparing them is naturally crystal clear.
"The higher the age, the more pronounced the effect. The lower the age, the lesser its boost to me."
"Even with Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique, it's inevitable to develop resistance issues."
Ding Ling saw this quite clearly.
He now already has both strength and defense reaching the Celestial Human Realm!
He just tried out his strength.
When using High Tier martial arts, every move feels like a Deity clearing the way, with incredible power!
Compared to when it was at 30, it's at least ten times stronger?!
"It's only from boosting by a mere 1 point!"

Ding Ling, while crunching and swallowing the Great Medicine, feeling the breathing technique working to its limits, refining the medicine's power, turning into a heat sensation spreading throughout the body.
Thought:
"Just this much change! So strong!"
"Celestial Human Realm, indeed the power in every gesture is like that of a Celestial Being."
Ding Ling wasn't just surprised by this.
If previously he was uncertain to dominate the world, he now possesses absolute confidence.
Certainly, his defense is at 31 points.
He also wanted to test the effect.
While consuming Great Medicine, he used the Giant Que Sword to slice his skin.
Crunch! Crunch!
Similar to a saw cutting a steel plate, making a harsh sound.
"Huh?!"
Ding Ling was shocked:

"Once defense reached the Celestial Human Realm, it seems like there's an invisible membrane protecting me, as tough as iron armor, as hard as a steel plate, even if the Giant Que Sword isn't used forcefully, cannot cut through. Strong!"
Ding Ling was overjoyed.
"With this invisible membrane as protection, even if a thousand arrows are fired simultaneously, what harm can they do to me?"
Ding Ling's spirits soared!
Brimming with confidence!
Previously he thought if faced with Cao Mengde's Tiger and Leopard Cavalry and other top-tier troops;
Or if Lü Bu personally led the Wolf Cavalry, etc.
He himself facing arrow rain coverage;
Chances are, he'd have to retreat.
Couldn't escape, also might be shot dead.
But now?
There's no such possibility!
He no longer needs to take hostages. He's here to dictate Heaven and Earth!
All demonic creatures can't disturb his mind anymore.
"Just wonder how the real world will change?"
Ding Ling was eager to try.
But looking at the Great Medicine in his hand.
He temporarily suppressed this impulse.
Let's enhance further first.
Crunch!
Crunch!
The remaining fifty-one Great Medicines, most of them are less than three hundred years old!
Fortunately, they are all effective on Ding Ling.
Even towards the end, formidable resistance developed, the effect became negligible.
But ultimately, they still have an effect.
Ding Ling didn't stop devouring.
Consuming them cleanly in one go.
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.9]
[Physique +0.9]
[Defense +0]
Four-dimensional attribute growth in agility and physique remains balanced! Strength and defense halted growth.
Clearly.
31 points is already the limit of the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique.
Or perhaps...
Is it the limit value of this world?
Ding Ling pondered.
He glanced at the character panel.
Strength changes:
[Bone Structure 1 (Normal person is 1 point), Wisdom 2.1, Strength 31, Agility 26.6, Physique 28, Defense 31, Charm 7.]
Physique is also about to reach the limit value of External Refining Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling was quite anticipating.
If all four kinds of attribute values reach 31.
What astonishing changes might occur?
Will he become an Immortal? Directly shatter the void?
Ding Ling finished all Great Medicine.
His aura surged again.
Zhao Yun and others watched in envy.
The refining efficiency of the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique truly is outlandishly high.
They desire it too!
But they understand the path must be taken step by step, External Refining Breathing Technique hasn't yet reached the ultimate realm, how to cultivate the Inner Refining Breathing Technique?
Fortunately, since Zhao Yun followed Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 212: Encountering Hua Tuo Again! Entering Nanyang County (2/12)
paragraphs: Progress speed can be described as rapid.
The current External Refining Breathing Technique has reached the Mastery Realm.
However, the depth in Mastery is not profound.
Zhao Yun plans to delve deeper into Mastery, ensuring full confidence before attempting the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method.
Ding Ling agrees with this.
"Come, I'll continue to guide you."
Ding Ling finished his cultivation.
He walked to Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and others, beginning to guide them in martial arts practice.
She knows the kung fu of Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and others. They have reached a very deep Mastery Realm.
Therefore, guiding them is naturally no problem.
Moreover,
Although each External Refining Breathing Technique is different, they essentially lead to the same destination. Hence, Ding Ling guiding them in Cultivation Breathing Technique poses no issue.
Everything progresses methodically.
On this day.
In daylight.
The sun hangs high, it's midday.
Ding Ling and his party arrived in Runan, meeting Hua Tuo, their reunion was naturally joyful.
Hua Tuo couldn't help asking about Ding Ling's experiences in Yangzhou and his learning process.
Diao Chan vividly narrated all the events.
Hua Tuo listened, thoroughly shaken and astonished, sighing repeatedly:
"Unity of Inner and Outer, so powerful! Terrifying, terrifying! No wonder the ancient sages said, Unity of Inner and Outer is unparalleled and invincible, it seems quite reasonable!"
He glanced at Ding Ling:
"But Ding Ling, so young, reached this realm, unheard of through the ages. You've broken the record again."
He thought of Ding Ling learning Talismanic Technique so smoothly, even more amazed and admiring.
He immediately expressed his wish to see what this Talisman Water was all about.
Ding Ling naturally satisfied him.
Once the Talisman Water was produced.
Many patients who came to Hua Tuo for treatment were cured.
Patients and their families thanked him profusely and left.
Hua Tuo was extremely thrilled and envious:

"This Talisman Water is so useful. You only need brush, ink, paper, and some clear water. Compared to my Medical Dao, it seems stronger! My Medical Dao requires me to laboriously collect and brew herbs. The Talisman Water needs nothing. It's too convenient and powerful!"
He was eager to learn.
Ding Ling thought of Daoist Yhiuu Ji's words, felt he was destined with Hua Tuo, and taught everything without reservation.
After a day of learning, Hua Tuo decisively gave up, sighed dejectedly:
"Seems I'm like Zhang Zhongjing, talentless in this area."
In truth, Hua Tuo's talent isn't poor.
Knowing Daoist Yhiuu Ji spent his life researching and cultivating Talisman Technique.
Hua Tuo only learned it for a day.
Hua Tuo knew this too.
But without comparison, there's no self-harm. Knowing Ding Ling's learning process, then seeing his own.
Hua Tuo felt utterly defeated, naturally had a strong sense that he was a fool, undeserving to learn Talisman Technique.
But that's secondary.
Mainly still...
"I'm old. Can't handle this anymore. With Talisman Technique being so hard to learn, reaching Mastery seems endless. I have no need to continue learning."
He remembered Zhang Zhongjing lamenting the difficulty of Talisman Technique, deeply touched at that moment.
Naturally unwilling to waste more time learning.
In his view,
This Talisman Technique isn't for ordinary people, and even geniuses need at least a dozen years for any success!
Learning medicine is better.
More suitable for ordinary people!
Regarding Hua Tuo's decision.
As a junior, Ding Ling naturally couldn't forcefully command, only followed fate.
In Runan Shenyang City only stayed a day.
Ding Ling and his party continued their journey to Wan City in Nanyang County.
"What are we going to Wan City for?"
Zhao Yun turned side-eye:
"Didn't we agree to join a powerful leader, pacify the unrest?"
"I'm going to kill someone."
All were their own people.
Except for the matter of cheats which must remain hidden, most things in the Three Kingdoms World weren't heavily concealed from Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and them:
"The Yuan Family Wanted Order isn't revoked yet. I have to fulfill my promise, to take off the head of the Yuan Family's Patriarch."
Da and Xiao Qiao were moved:
"The Yuan Family of the Four Generations and Three Ministers?"
"Correct."
Diao Chan nodded, clearly explaining the truth.
After listening, Da and Xiao Qiao immediately sided with Ding Ling.
Righteous indignation, united in hatred:
"Too excessive! This kind of family has no reason to exist!"
"Indeed."
Zhao Yun, having seen many things in the world, naturally had many thoughts:

"The chaos in the world, ultimately because these families and clans monopolize most resources, causing the people to suffer, certainly not lacking plagues, wars, and natural disasters as causes. But family monopoly stirs public resentment indeed, absolutely not wrong."
"Families have both good and bad people, geniuses and fools. If a foolish and bad family controls local military power, one can imagine how miserable the people would live there!"
Ding Ling gazed toward Nanyang County:

"There are many foolish and bad ones in the Yuan Family. I don't care how many good people they have, but their Patriarch still hasn't revoked the bounty, clearly intending to kill me. He wants me dead, no reason for me to let him go."
Mainly,
The Yuan Family's Patriarch fled to Nanyang County with numerous treasures from Luoyang City!
The Yuan Family's influence in Runan and Nanyang is substantial.
But Yuan Shu's concealed Great Medicine and other treasures are few.
The real treasures are still with the Yuan Family's Patriarch.
This time Ding Ling aims to take all these.
If you don't take them, it's a waste!
The enemy's possessions, once they're slain, aren't they yours?
Previously lacked confidence.
Now the strength and defense both progressed to the Celestial Human Realm!
Every move like a Celestial God descending.
A casual strike can condense Vigorous Qi into tangible Sword Qi light and shadow effects!
Moreover, Vigorous Qi can fly dozens of meters out to kill the enemy!
More ferocious than Crossbow Arrow!
"We support you."
Diao Chan eager:
"Last time we could openly cut through Wan City, this time Ding Ling, you've become so mighty, surely easier!"
"That's certain."
Da and Xiao Qiao adored:
"Ding Ling is like a Celestial God. How can ordinary warriors be his match?"
"If we really enter Wan City. Remember to stay close for me to protect you."
Ding Ling nonchalantly smiled.
"Mm!"
Da and Xiao Qiao, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng nodded heavily.
This day.
At dusk.
The sunset fades, the setting sun like blood.
A group arrived at Wan City's eastern gate.
The group was just a few people.
But the soldiers guarding the gate, seeing the leader's face, instantly tensed their lazy and relaxed hearts.
Their expressions changed greatly, a loud shout:
"The God of Slaughter has come!"
"God of Slaughter? Where?"
"Over there! It's Ding Ling!"
"Damn, really is that guy Ding Ling!"
There were natives, there were players.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 213: Players Stunned! Confronting the Grand General
paragraphs: When Ding Ling and his party appeared, chaos erupted at the entrance of Wan City's city gate.
The first batch of players ran to the safest positions.
To them,
Ding Ling was already akin to a god-like existence.
Indeed, the deeds Ding Ling accomplished since entering the Three Kingdoms World were astonishing feats enough to shock ordinary players!
An average person achieving just one such feat,
would likely boast about it for a lifetime.
Yet Ding Ling accomplished them all!!
Recently, a story spread wildly across the land.
According to rumors, the famed Handsome Zhou Yu was crushed and so thoroughly defeated by Ding Ling that he nearly spat blood, lost all interest in Xiao Qiao, and fled back home.
Consequently, Ding Ling directly took Xiao Qiao away.
It's said that upon hearing this news, Zhou Yu trembled violently for some time before fainting instantly!
This demonstrates the severe blow to Zhou Yu.
At this moment, these players on the city wall, equipped with a 'telescope', saw the figures and appearances of Ding Ling's party from afar.
They were inevitably shocked:
"Holy... it really is Da and Xiao Qiao!

I've seen some player-posted portraits of Da and Xiao Qiao online, they're exactly the same, no no, they're even more beautiful in person, more absolutely stunning! It truly makes you envious, jealous, and bitter!
If I could have an unparalleled beauty by my side, I'd be content to die. Ding Ling has quite a few, one, two, three, four—altogether four!
Wandering the vast lands with four beauties!
This really is a man among men! He's too fierce! A role model for us all!"
The envy and jealousy were plainly written on the faces of these players:

"I've heard some players were completely fooled by Zhuge Liang's child's trickery. Ding Ling, however, crushed Zhou Yu to the brink of spitting blood, the disparity is just too vast. They are all players, how could there be such a huge gap?!"

"Well, it's normal, you were a dunce when studying. Why don't you say you and a top student were both raised by parents, why are your test scores worlds apart? Maybe Ding Ling has genius-like talent in martial arts and other areas?"

"Even for genius-level talent, it's too exaggerated. The talent of Lü Bu, Zhang Liao, and Dian Wei wasn't that overblown. Could Ding Ling's talent surpass these people? No one would believe that! Do you?"
Players were full of discussion, showing envy, jealousy, reverence, admiration, and doubt towards Ding Ling... All sorts of human sentiments, in myriad forms.
But without exception,
they collectively marveled and turned their gaze towards the arrival of Da and Xiao Qiao, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng.
After all, these four beauties are renowned as top-tier beauties from the Three Kingdoms!
Of course, they desired to behold them in person!
As to how they knew the names of Diao Chan and her companions,

truth is, Diao Chan and her companions didn't conceal their identities while traveling with Ding Ling across the north and south, allowing their names to be boldly disclosed, heard by some players, and naturally spread from one to ten, ten to a hundred.
Unfortunately, the charm value of Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng was so high that they wore face guards when facing strangers.
Only among themselves, in private gatherings, would they remove their guards.
Thus, players couldn't see the real faces of Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan.
Da and Xiao Qiao, however, had no such concerns.
Because the Feibai Breathing Technique doesn't directly increase charm to the extent where one couldn't resist after witnessing it.
Diao Chan's charm, up to now, couldn't be resisted even by Ding Ling, whose strength has soared and temperament has strengthened.
How could others resist? All men understand each other, don't they?
Even the most noble person,
deep down, they all appreciate beauty.
There are no exceptions!
After all, everyone possesses a love for beauty.

Of course, there might be exceptions like Liuxia Hui, but even if it were Liuxia Hui, seeing Diao Chan, he would surely like her, whether or not he harbors other thoughts, liking the unparalleled beauty Diao Chan isn't wrong.
After all, her charm value is extremely high, enchanting and stunning in a way that doesn't seem human.
Especially as Diao Chan's strength and technique continue to elevate, this sensation becomes more evident.
Who doesn't appreciate perfect objects?
Clip-clop! Clip-clop!
Ding Ling and his party rode to the entrance of Wan City.
Ding Ling led the way.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng flanked his sides, Zhao Zilong covered the rear.

Da and Xiao Qiao in the middle, nervously clutching a longsword, looking around tensely, preparing to enter battle—their life's first time! Though they had fought quite a few bandits under Ding Ling's deliberate training before, these couldn't compare with the present grand spectacle.
Standing straight, their eyes wide open, their hands gripping the sword began to sweat.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng noticed but didn't console them. This was a life journey that had to be undertaken, experiencing it, overcoming it, one naturally becomes accustomed and transformed.
Click, click!
As Ding Ling arrived at the city gate.
The heavy city gate closed with a loud clack under the Defender General's shout.
Swish, swish, swish!
Groups of troops quickly set out, forming ranks, each bending bows and readying arrows, some positioned on the city walls, others arranged before the gate.
In an instant.
Thousands of troops.
Swarmed together.
Faces either buoyant or anxious, all arrows pointed at Ding Ling!
They were archers!
Ding Ling understood.
Clearly, the Defender General had studied his martial power and knew that a rain of arrows posed the greatest threat to him!
"Ding Ling!"
The Defender General stood atop the tall city wall, gazing down at Ding Ling, shouting loudly:
"You're not welcome here. I advise you to leave immediately, or don't blame me for being ruthless!"
The Defender General stood eight feet tall, replete with charm, but at the moment, his face was filled with tension.
Instantly his aura and dignity plummeted from an elevated state to mundane levels.
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling, noticing the Defender General's extraordinary demeanor, turned his gaze and asked.

"My name is Zhang Xun! Currently serving as a Grand General. I oversee the military affairs of Nanyang County! For all matters here, I'm the one who calls the shots temporarily. If you leave, I won't trouble you."
The Defender General shouted.
Zhang Xun?
A flash of lightning streaked through Ding Ling's mind.
He remembered.
Zhang Xun was a significant general under Yuan Shu, and after Yuan Shu declared himself emperor, Zhang Xun was conferred the title of Grand General.
This indicates Zhang Xun's weight in Yuan Shu's eyes!
This man wasn't seen before,
indicating a high probability that he was taken by Yuan Shu to Hulao Pass to confront Dong Zhuo.
Now he's back.
Replacing Jii Ling to guard Nanyang County.
This shows he's doing quite well now.
"I don't want to trouble you either."
Ding Ling shouted loudly:
"If you're sensible later, don't attempt to attack me. Otherwise, your life won't be spared."
"What do you mean?"
Zhang Xun's expression changed slightly.
"The meaning is simple."
Ding Ling reached behind, grasping the Giant Que Sword's hilt, with a metallic clang the sword unsheathed:
"I will kill my way in!"
Zhang Xun was both shocked and furious, considering Ding Ling's track record, his body involuntarily trembled slightly, he quivered and said:
"You, you have such audacity, don't you realize your current situation!"

chapters.title: Chapter 214 214: Is This a Xuanhuan World or the Three Kingdoms?
paragraphs: "What makes you think just a few of you can deal with my army of thousands?"
Zhang Xun seemed unwilling to battle Ding Ling and continued to urge:
"You're no longer holding any Yuan family members as hostages. We won't hesitate to harm you! We'll rain arrows down and take you out!"
"In recognition of your kindness."
Ding Ling raised his head slightly to look at Zhang Xun:
"I sincerely advise you, do not anger me later. Otherwise, you'll die in a miserable and ugly way."
Ding Ling shook the Giant Que Sword in his hand, leaped down from his horse, and using the Flying Swallow Technique, shot like a cannonball towards the archers at the city gate.
"How dare you!"

While Zhang Xun was shocked, he couldn't believe it. This person refuses a toast only to drink a forfeit, does he truly believe he's invincible like iron, able to withstand a torrential onslaught of arrows?
Zhang Xun could not believe it!
He urged Ding Ling to retreat.

Because he had considered Ding Ling's supernatural Lightweight Body Technique. If provoked, Ding Ling might sneak into the city at night, much like slaughtering the Yellow Turban Army, and bypass defenses. One might even lose one's head while sleeping!
But now, in broad daylight,
Ding Ling chose to fight at such a time.
Was this overconfidence?
Or foolishness?
After his initial anger, Zhang Xun was thrilled. This was a perfect opportunity; his arrogance would be his downfall, allowing an easy kill.
As long as Ding Ling was killed.
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and others were of no concern.
"Fire arrows!"
Zhang Xun roared:
"Fire collectively! All of you, fire without holding back!"
The sound fell.
Bang bang!
Archers released their bowstrings, and in the sound of tension and release, arrows soared through the sky, whizzing! These seemed like Death God's arrows, chasing and claiming lives!
The arrow rain aimed straight at Ding Ling!
Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and others watched from behind, their faces changing with worry.
Ding Ling had already advised them.
If faced with such a situation, they must not follow too closely, keeping a distance so that even chaotic arrows can be avoided or deflected.
But once in the city,
They should stick close to Ding Ling. To protect him.
"Ding Ling is doomed."
The players asserted:
"Without hostages, the opponent won't hold back. This is walking into death!
Not only players felt this way.
Everyone at that moment believed Ding Ling was destined to die.

Except for Diao Chan and her group, though they had confidence in Ding Ling, facing the terrifying rain of arrows, even they couldn't help but tremble with fear—a natural response to impending disaster.
This arrow rain, as if the sky was collapsing, could make anyone's mind go blank, leaving no choice but to wait to die.
Everyone was watching Ding Ling.
Including Zhang Xun, whose face displayed excitement, already imagining the scene of slaying Ding Ling and gaining fame throughout Jiuzhou.
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
The arrow rain hit Ding Ling, exploding with deafening booms.
Arrows were dense, impossible to count.
Wave after wave!
Like crashing waves trying to shatter the sandy shore, producing a thunderous roar that shook the heavens and earth!
Everyone couldn't help but glance sideways, confused and uncertain.
Could arrows rain down on a person's body, creating a sound like thunder?!
How is this possible?!
When everyone saw clearly what had happened, they stood frozen in disbelief!
They doubted their senses, suspecting hallucinations!
"How is this possible?!"

Zhang Xun, a general guarding three armies, although not as skilled as Jii Ling, was still highly martial, not comparable to ordinary generals. He rubbed his eyes, confirming he hadn't been mistaken, and his expression changed in fear, stammering:
"This, this, Ding Ling, is he man or ghost?!"
Ding Ling's clothes were pierced like a sieve.
The armor was shattered.
Yet, his body seemed unharmed!
Not a single hair was out of place!
His face was smooth as jade, not even a scratch!
But Zhang Xun had clearly seen from the city head countless arrows hitting Ding Ling's head.
He was overjoyed.
Thinking he'd achieved great merit, would receive the Yuan family's reward, rise to great heights, not to mention, his fame would spread across Jiuzhou, becoming a top-tier general!
As he reveled in his dream, he witnessed this incredible scene.
No less than someone at their peak being kicked down to the valley!
That excruciating pain, soul-searching coldness felt like falling into an icy pond, chilling to the bones, freezing the very soul.
Zhang Xun shivered, goosebumps rising.
Especially when Ding Ling slightly raised his head, offering him a faint smile, Zhang Xun's soul seemed lost, and he could only scream hysterically:
"Fire arrows, FIRE ARROWS!"
Bang bang!
The archers were shocked and terrified.
Hearing these words, they instinctively drew their bows, arrows pointing at Ding Ling, with whizzing sounds, unleashing another wave of arrows.
Resulting without exception.
Ding Ling seemed to have a steel armor protecting him; the arrow rain was ineffective!
The players' eyes bulged:
"Is this really the Three Kingdoms?! Not a Xuanhuan world?!"
"I'm convinced now. Ding Ling definitely discovered a BUG in this game world. I'm reporting him for cheating as soon as I log off!"
"Too much! This is blatantly exploiting game loopholes! Ridiculing our effort and intellect! Ugh, I wanna cheat too, I wanna be invincible!"
The players were shocked beyond belief.
They were jealous and envious of Ding Ling; some accused him, while others retreated to observe from a distance;
As for Diao Chan and her group?
Their delight was boundless.
The admiration from Da and Xiao Qiao lit up their eyes, with a shining gleam!
Zhao Yun was utterly enthralled, considering Ding Ling his lifelong goal to chase!
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng silently cheered, seeing Zhang Xun and others' reactions, feeling honored and accomplished.
After all, Ding Ling was their leader, kin, family!
As for the archers facing him.
They were terrified out of their wits!
Each felt a looming threat, especially seeing Ding Ling wielding the Giant Que Sword into their midst, swinging it.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
It's like thousands of snowflakes cascading in the void, each snowflake resembling a small sharp blade, thousands of snowflakes spiraling with clangs, sweeping through with bloody rain!
Heads rolled!
Severed limbs soared!
No one could withstand a single snowflake!
Thousands of snowflakes pierced the air.
Like Death God's scythe descending upon the Mortal World, reaping all life effortlessly in its presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 215 215: Piercing the City Gate with a Single Sword (5/12)
paragraphs: "Run quickly!"
"He's not human!"
The archers were trembling with fear, their guts wrenching, each shedding armor and abandoning bows, fleeing for their lives, scrambling to escape!
At this moment they had lost every ounce of their earlier confidence!
Not only were those under the city wall affected.
Even those on the city wall went pale, their bodies shaking, pupils shrinking, scalp tingling, if it weren't for Ding Ling dominating below the wall.
By now they might have all abandoned their bows, knives, swords, and spears, fleeing disgracefully!
"Such combat strength?!"
Zhang Xun gasped in disbelief, his feet involuntarily starting to retreat, once again drastically underestimating Ding Ling's combat prowess!
Overestimating his own capabilities!
Facing such a figure like gods and demons.
How could he resist?!
Don't mention just a few thousand men, even if Wan City's tens of thousands of troops were here, they still couldn't possibly hold him off.
"Too terrifying!"
"Is this person really human?"
Zhang Xun's teeth were chattering, hand trembling in terror as he gripped his sword.
Zhang Xun's heart was crystal clear; he knew he was finished.
He simply could not possibly stop someone like Ding Ling, a divine being.
"Flee?"
Instinctively this thought popped into his mind, and he immediately abandoned the soldiers, discarded his armor, and blended into the group, running toward the Wan City area.
Seeing Zhang Xun run, the soldiers abandoned all thought of fighting to the death, already in utmost panic; seeing Ding Ling approach to kill, they scattered like beasts and birds.
Boom!
Ding Ling stomped the ground heavily, leaped several meters like a thunderclap, and landed heavily on the city wall with a clang! Waving casually!
The Qing Frost Swordsmanship displayed its might, streams of vigorous qi transformed into thousands of flying snowflakes, reaping lives, where the snowflakes passed, blood poured like a river!
Ding Ling advanced all the way.
Swinging his sword as he went.
Effortlessly, like a carefree deity!
His face was calm, movements unhurried, demeanor magnificent and elegant; he walked on the city wall like a deity patrolling the mortal world, punishing its inhabitants.
Casual attacks, scattered and without predictability.
But it seemed like immortal techniques sweeping the world, a deity manifesting among people!
"Run quickly!"
"He's not human!"
They fled in panic!
Discarding armor and fleeing!
A crushing defeat!
The Yuan Army's current state was just like this.
Especially the players who joined seemed to crumble upon contact, without any fighting spirit to speak of.
Players are like wolves, fiercely strong when there's profit;
without profit, they scatter like retail investors, lacking cohesion, fighting strength.
Confronted with Ding Ling, whose combat power defies the heavens, how could they muster the will to fight? Each turned and fled.
Their emotions and actions naturally influenced many natives.
This caused the army that was originally retreating to suddenly shatter like a dam breaking, and with a roar, collapsed collectively.
Clip-clop!
As if thousands of troops were running.
The sound of running shook heaven and earth, mixed occasionally with shouts of anger, fright, and panic from soldiers.
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: Intimidate Zhang Xun]

[Note: Zhang Xun, as the general of the three armies, had his pride and confidence. Once controlling the army, he thought his moment to shine had come, working diligently, but your arrival sliced into his heart like a sharp blade!
Instantly shattered his ideals and ambitions.
Further filled him with terror to the extreme! He dared not face you. He lost the courage to oppose you!
Because, in his eyes, you were no longer a person. You were a demon, a god, a synonym for supreme power!]
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: Intimidate thousands of elite soldiers returned from Luoyang!]
[Note: Yuan Shu returned to Nanyang County, bringing back these soldiers. They were the synonym for bravery. But with you, they turned into mere chickens and dogs!]
Ding Ling heard the prompting sound.
He halted his steps, ceased pursuing these soldiers anymore.
He jumped off the city wall, glanced around.
The city gate was already deserted, unguarded.
He directly approached to open the gate.
Opening the gate relying solely on oneself.
In the past, it might have been impossible.
But with his power breaking into the Celestial Human Realm, even a casual strike carried the might of heaven and earth, far exceeding his past self by tenfold!
How could mere city gates stop him?
Boom!
Ding Ling strode forward, choosing to slice open the city gate directly.

This time he employed a broad and open, extraordinarily concentrated sword technique; with one stroke, a vigorous qi transformed into a regal presence, as if a Human Emperor manifested halfway in the air, along with Ding Ling's strike, boom! Crashing straight into the city gate.
In many players' dazed eyes.
Snap!
Snap!
The solid city gate was abruptly and forcibly split through by Ding Ling's strike.
Snap!
Once more Ding Ling swung the Giant Que Sword, under the blessing of Human Emperor Swordsmanship, three to five times, breaking open a gap large enough for a steed to pass through in the gate.
The players collectively shivered, glancing at each other before collectively hiding in deeper, safer places.
Of course, there were those daring to stick close to the front lines, eyeing Ding Ling, intending to gather the latest intel.
To them, studying Ding Ling's significance was immense. Such combat power, horrendously terrifying to an extreme, is an unrivaled existence capable of defeating a nation single-handedly!
A true Land God!
"Crunch crunch!"
A Ferghana Horse galloped swiftly.
Arriving close.
Ding Ling mounted with a leap.
Just settling into the saddle.
"Ding Ling."
Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao also galloped over, each looking fervently at Ding Ling.
Zhao Yun was slightly more reserved, but his eyes on Ding Ling were filled with admiration. He genuinely took Ding Ling as his idol!
Ding Ling smiled gently, tightened the reins, and said:
"Let's go. This time, keep up closely."
"Mm!"
Diao Chan and the others nodded firmly.
Zhao Yun clasped his spear in silence.
Clip-clop!
The sound of hooves echoed rapidly!
Ding Ling and his companions galloped along the main road in Wan City, Nanyang County.
No one dared to obstruct!
Unaware soldiers attempted to approach.
Clang!
Ding Ling drew his sword, waved it from afar, accompanied by the clanging sound, vigorous qi erupted, blowing like a breeze toward the obstructing soldiers, bang bang bang!
Accompanied by a piercing sound slicing through Celestial Extreme, soldiers collapsed instantly!
They didn't even realize what had happened before collectively falling to the ground, dead!
Originally, soldiers who intended to run over saw this and made an 'emergency brake'!
For the first time, they truly understood why the warriors guarding the city gate fled in such panic.
Even Zhang Xun fled in terror, abandoning his armor, possibly hiding somewhere unknown!
How could they possibly block the way?
They exchanged glances.
Just as tacitly, they ran.
Some attempted to hide and shoot cold arrows.
Yet all were effortlessly thwarted by Ding Ling's casual strikes.
As long as it wasn't a torrential rain of arrows.

Ding Ling's sword could transform into a breeze to sweep away covert arrows, at times into flying snow to shatter cold arrows, at times into the grand and dignified Human Emperor Sword Map to crush the arrows!

The archers were trembling with fear, their guts wrenching, each shedding armor and abandoning bows, fleeing for their lives, scrambling to escape!
At this moment they had lost every ounce of their earlier confidence!
Not only were those under the city wall affected.
Even those on the city wall went pale, their bodies shaking, pupils shrinking, scalp tingling, if it weren't for Ding Ling dominating below the wall.
By now they might have all abandoned their bows, knives, swords, and spears, fleeing disgracefully!
"Such combat strength?!"
Zhang Xun gasped in disbelief, his feet involuntarily starting to retreat, once again drastically underestimating Ding Ling's combat prowess!
Overestimating his own capabilities!
Facing such a figure like gods and demons.
How could he resist?!
Don't mention just a few thousand men, even if Wan City's tens of thousands of troops were here, they still couldn't possibly hold him off.
"Too terrifying!"
"Is this person really human?"
Zhang Xun's teeth were chattering, hand trembling in terror as he gripped his sword.
Zhang Xun's heart was crystal clear; he knew he was finished.
He simply could not possibly stop someone like Ding Ling, a divine being.
"Flee?"
Instinctively this thought popped into his mind, and he immediately abandoned the soldiers, discarded his armor, and blended into the group, running toward the Wan City area.
Seeing Zhang Xun run, the soldiers abandoned all thought of fighting to the death, already in utmost panic; seeing Ding Ling approach to kill, they scattered like beasts and birds.
Boom!
Ding Ling stomped the ground heavily, leaped several meters like a thunderclap, and landed heavily on the city wall with a clang!

Ding Ling advanced all the way.

Effortlessly, like a carefree deity!
His face was calm, movements unhurried, demeanor magnificent and elegant; he walked on the city wall like a deity patrolling the mortal world, punishing its inhabitants.
Casual attacks, scattered and without predictability.
But it seemed like immortal techniques sweeping the world, a deity manifesting among people!
"Run quickly!"
"He's not human!"
They fled in panic!
Discarding armor and fleeing!
A crushing defeat!
The Yuan Army's current state was just like this.
Especially the players who joined seemed to crumble upon contact, without any fighting spirit to speak of.
Players are like wolves, fiercely strong when there's profit;
without profit, they scatter like retail investors, lacking cohesion, fighting strength.
Confronted with Ding Ling, whose combat power defies the heavens, how could they muster the will to fight?
Each turned and fled.
Their emotions and actions naturally influenced many natives.
This caused the army that was originally retreating to suddenly shatter like a dam breaking, and with a roar, collapsed collectively.
Clip-clop!
As if thousands of troops were running.
The sound of running shook heaven and earth, mixed occasionally with shouts of anger, fright, and panic from soldiers.
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: Intimidate Zhang Xun]

Instantly shattered his ideals and ambitions.
Further filled him with terror to the extreme!
He dared not face you.
He lost the courage to oppose you!
Because, in his eyes, you were no longer a person.
You were a demon, a god, a synonym for supreme power!]

They were the synonym for bravery.
But with you, they turned into mere chickens and dogs!]

He halted his steps, ceased pursuing these soldiers anymore.
He jumped off the city wall, glanced around.
The city gate was already deserted, unguarded.
He directly approached to open the gate.
Opening the gate relying solely on oneself.
In the past, it might have been impossible.
But with his power breaking into the Celestial Human Realm, even a casual strike carried the might of heaven and earth, far exceeding his past self by tenfold!
How could mere city gates stop him?
Boom!
Ding Ling strode forward, choosing to slice open the city gate directly.

Snap!
The solid city gate was abruptly and forcibly split through by Ding Ling's strike.
Snap!

chapters.title: Chapter 216 216: Run, My Lord! Ding Ling Is Here
paragraphs: Ding Ling's swordsmanship had long reached the Transformation Realm.

Double Flower Swordsmanship, Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, Dawn Swordsmanship, Sunset Swordsmanship, Human Emperor Swordsmanship, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Qing Frost Swordsmanship... various sword techniques and moves executed effortlessly!
Each casual strike of swordsmanship resonated with the chant of Heaven and was blessed by Celestial Might!
It was as if a Celestial God wielded Heaven and Earth, and the Heavenly Dao was roaring in fury!
Ding Ling's strength!
Had already transcended the realm of human understanding.
Both sides seemed as if they were no longer of a species on the same scale.
How to fight this?
Fleeing seemed to have become their only choice!
"General Zhang, what are you doing?"

On a long street over a hundred meters away from Ding Ling, Zhang Xun, dressed in simple attire, was sprinting wildly. He happened upon a grand seven-foot general, clad in armor and exuding an extraordinary aura.
He looked at Zhang Xun in disbelief and asked:
"You, what are you doing?"
He vaguely guessed something in his heart.
But still found it unbelievable.
"Qiao Rui."
Zhang Xun glanced up and saw Qiao Rui approaching on horseback, and he was taken aback. Lowering his head to look at his own attire, his face turned red with shame and embarrassment.
But thinking of the demon-like Ding Ling behind, he shivered slightly and hurriedly said:
"Qiao Rui, quickly inform our lord, tell him Ding Ling is coming, we are absolutely no match for him, he should flee quickly."
"What?!"
Qiao Rui was astonished. So shocked that his tongue was twisted for a moment:
"Do you realize what you're saying?!"
"I am very clear!"
Zhang Xun's expression was unprecedentedly serious and grave:

"Ding Ling is truly not human! Thousands of archers shot at him together, and other than some damage to his armor, from head to toe, there wasn't the slightest injury, not even a strand of hair was lost! He is terrifying."
When he said this.
Zhang Xun seemed to recall something, shuddering uncontrollably, with a handsome face turning pale as paper:

"He, he is truly scary. Qiao Rui, quickly go and inform our lord, I will not go, from now on, each on his own paths, seeking their own destiny and future. The Yuan Family provoked Ding Ling, it's really over, there's no hope!"
Having said that.
He turned around without looking back and dashed off in a frenzy.

Where he ran to was clearly the direction of his own Zhang Mansion, evidently his conscience wasn't dead, thinking of his own wife and children during the escape, he intended to take his family with him.
In Zhang Xun's view, Ding Ling's main targets were Yuan Shu, the patriarch of the Yuan Family, and others, unlikely to pursue a small figure like him relentlessly.
So long as he was decisive enough and quick enough in his escape.
He could definitely run out of Wan City's territory!
"General Zhang, General Zhang! General Zhang!!"
Qiao Rui shouted three times, but Zhang Xun ignored him, with Zhang Xun's figure disappearing at the corner behind him, listening to the faint cries of battle ahead.
Qiao Rui's sense of foreboding grew stronger.
He understood Zhang Xun.
High-spirited, possessing great martial power, confident and lofty.
Such a Zhang Xun.
Was actually frightened to the point of losing his wits and bravery, shedding his armor and weaponry just to escape!
Qiao Rui swallowed hard, resolutely turning his horse around and galloping towards the direction of the Yuan Mansion.
Regardless of anything.
As a general of the Yuan Family.
He couldn't just run away! The responsibilities and the courage that should be had must be there.
He must ensure the lord's safe exit from Wan City.
As for the patriarch of the Yuan Family?
Recalling how the patriarch's orders led to the death of the lord's only son.
Qiao Rui's heart turned cold.
A decision formed in his mind.
Yuan Shu was his lord and must escape.
As for the patriarch of the Yuan Family, let him stay behind to block Ding Ling. To buy some precious time for his lord's escape!
Clip-clop!
Qiao Rui's speed was swift.
On the way to the Yuan Mansion, he ordered a thousand soldiers who followed him to hold off Ding Ling.
He didn't expect the soldiers to truly hold him off, just hope they could delay a little while.
Most of the soldiers were natives, ignorant of the truth.

However, the players were sharp, noticing from time to time some players appearing from long streets and tall buildings. They were taken aback, especially noting the bewilderment, full of jealousy, envy, and shock in these players' eyes, they knew something unpredictable had happened ahead.
Some players decided to take a look first.
Immediately, they stepped forward and volunteered to play the role of a scout to explore the path ahead.
The Village Chief allowed it.
The players were overjoyed and ran off like mad.
Once they found out what happened, they quickly hid in relatively safe alleys or houses.
As for the native army? They were just NPCs, it wasn't their concern?
Among them, a small number were regretting.
Knowing they had managed to climb to officer positions with great difficulty, yet now seemed likely to return to square one.
How many days of hard work?
Getting thrown back to the start.
Looks like they can no longer take a stand against Ding Ling; otherwise, the result of a hundred days of toil being crushed into dust would be too much to bear!
Yuan Mansion.
Study.
A magnificent-looking man with a wild demeanor stared at Qiao Rui in disbelief:
"What did you say?!"
"My lord."
Qiao Rui said solemnly:
"That is the truth. There's no time to delay. If Ding Ling charges in, we absolutely cannot stop him. We must run for our lives first!"
"Zhang Xun actually fled? Abandoned the entire army!"
"Yes."
"Scoundrel!"
Yuan Shu burst into a rage, slamming the table, his beard trembling in anger:
"I entrusted the entire army to him. Made him a Great General! Is this how he repays me?!"
"My lord, let's go, Ding Ling is coming."
Qiao Rui urged desperately, reminding several times.
"Just a mere Ding Ling!!"
That's what he said.
But Yuan Shu still swiftly gathered some important items from the study and fled with Qiao Rui without looking back.
He understood Zhang Xun better than anyone!
And precisely because Zhang Xun fit his tastes and possessed quite extraordinary abilities.
That's why he appointed Zhang Xun as the Great General of the three armies.
But for Zhang Xun to be so scared that he fled directly, it was unexpected.
This also indirectly proved that Zhang Xun's internal fear must have reached an indescribable level, otherwise, he wouldn't have self-destructed his future prospects!
Zhang Xun must have believed that the Yuan Family would certainly fall completely in today's battle!
Yuan Shu, though arrogant and self-assured, was not a fool!

Turning it over in his mind, he inferred a bit, so while he was angry, ultimately his life was more important, so he left without even grabbing his wives and concubines from the inner yard, fleeing with Qiao Rui swiftly!
By the time Ding Ling arrived at the Yuan Mansion, he was faced with a scene of chaos.
Many servants and players were scurrying about in the Yuan Mansion, each carrying some materials, like bandits, hastily dashing around.
When they saw Ding Ling had arrived, they were taken aback, then awkwardly laughed and said:

chapters.title: Chapter 217 217: The Mighty Generals Chunyu Qiong and Lü Weihuang Fall in Battle
paragraphs: "We won't interfere with each other. We definitely don't mean to offend you. We'll change our route, change our route!"

The players, with a whoosh, ran to the side path, stretched their legs, and fled for their lives. When they had run far enough that Ding Ling and his group were out of sight, they finally took a few heavy breaths, each with lingering fear:
"Ding Ling is terrifying. Just a glance from him feels like being watched by a hundred thousand fierce beasts. I was nearly scared to death just now!"

"Me too. I was almost scared to wet myself! I don't know how Ding Ling practices, his aura is as vast as the sea, his presence as deep as an abyss, his gaze as profound as the galaxy. Just looking at him makes my skin crawl with terror, how can we fight?!"
"Exactly. He's too powerful! From a distance, it wasn't too bad, but up close, I was really intimidated!"
The players were not satisfied.
They're all players, but the difference between them and Ding Ling is like heaven and earth. The gap is too big to accept!
They've already decided to band together and report Ding Ling!
Ding Ling must be exploiting a game bug to cheat, otherwise, there's no way to explain all this!
Ding Ling didn't care about the players, he just rode straight into the Yuan Family's inner courtyard, stopping a middle-aged man who looked to be of no small status, preparing to flee.
Clang!
Ding Ling made a move like lightning, casually placing his sword at the man's neck:
"Speak. Where is Yuan Shu?"
"He, he fled."
The middle-aged man froze, not daring to move, only fawning over Ding Ling:
"Hero, please spare me. I'm just the Yuan Family's steward, this has nothing to do with me."
"Then where is the Yuan Family patriarch?"
"Still in the inner courtyard, packing valuables. Probably about to flee too."
"Lead the way."
Ding Ling coldly stared at the steward.
The steward dared not refuse and turned to walk deeper into the inner courtyard.
Ding Ling urged.
So he started to jog.
Ding Ling had been here once before and found many places familiar.
The steward had seen Ding Ling before and had a strong impression of him, but Ding Ling hadn't seen him and didn't know him.
The steward didn't know this.
He only ran faster and faster in agitation.
Afraid of being too slow and being cut down by Ding Ling's sword. He had seen Ding Ling in action before, decisive in killing, mowing down enemies! Fiercely unstoppable!
He could only regret it.
When he saw Qiao Rui taking Yuan Shu away in a hurry, he should have realized something big was happening.
But alas...

When some household servants and soldiers were leaving with Yuan Family's valuables and precious items, he finally realized it and started thinking of escaping with some wealth himself, but he was too slow and caught red-handed!
Clatter, clatter!
The Yuan Family's inner courtyard was very large.
But the steward ran fast, and Ding Ling and his group were even faster on horseback, arriving shortly at a splendid and magnificent courtyard.
Ding Ling saw groups of soldiers guarding the courtyard entrance.
"This is the place."
The steward said, bowing low.
"Mm. You can go now."
Ding Ling nodded.
"Thank you, sir!"
The steward was stunned, then ecstatically expressed his gratitude, turning and fleeing the scene even faster than before.
"Traitor!"
A dignified and robust-looking general saw this, was furious, and was ready to shoot the steward with a bow and arrow.
Ding Ling casually swung his sword, the Sunset Swordsmanship displayed its might!
A Setting Sun Diagram appeared radiantly in the void!
It actually condensed into a tangible Sword Map out of thin air!

The Sword Map spun in the air, clanging, directly striking the general's body, and with a scream, the general was blasted backward, crashing through and knocking down no fewer than dozens of soldiers along the way.
The once orderly ranks instantly turned into chaos.
"General Chunyu Qiong is dead!"
Someone shouted.
Chunyu Qiong?
Ding Ling was surprised.
He had just killed this guy?

Chunyu Qiong, styled Zhongjian, hailing from Yingchuan. During Emperor Ling of the Han, he was one of the Eight Captains of the Imperial Garden, serving as the Right Captain, alongside Yuan Shao, Cao Mengde, Xia Mou, and others. Later, he became Yuan Shao's great general, renowned alongside Zhang Hex and others.
A true great general, albeit known to be fond of heavy drinking.
But it cannot be denied that although flawed, his combat power must be considerable, otherwise, how could he be renowned alongside Zhang Hex and others?
"Kill him, avenge the general!"
A dashing, heroic general who seemed very close to Chunyu Qiong, was furious and saddened to extremity upon seeing Chunyu Qiong die on the spot, his spear flashed as he charged directly at Ding Ling:
"Follow me, attack!"
"Truly courting death."
The steward had run far and, seeing this scene, shook his head and didn't continue watching, burying his head as he ran away.
Clang!

Ding Ling casually wielded the Giant Que Sword, the Sword God Skill, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, and Qing Frost Swordsmanship constantly transforming in his hands, morphing the Vigorous Qi into a strand of breeze blowing towards the heroic general, poof!
Silently, the general's head was severed! A column of blood shot skyward.
His tall body ran forward two steps, then collapsed onto the ground.
"General Lü Weihuang is also down!"
Someone shouted again.
"Brothers, retreat!"
It was obvious they were players.
Ding Ling looked towards the voice, just catching the person winking and flattering.
He was stunned, but didn't pretend to be what he wasn't, just nodded and smiled at them.
The person was delighted, shouting with even more vigor.
Of course, to avoid hindering Ding Ling, he ran even faster.
"Another famous general indeed."
Ding Ling recalled Lü Weihuang's records.
Another historically renowned general, related to Lü Bu by family. Alas, unable to withstand the Celestial Might!
"Ding Ling is too powerful now. Never mind first-class generals, even super-elite ones might not withstand a single blow from him!"
Zhao Yun was filled with emotion.
Through the journey.
He watched with his heart pounding in awe.
So fierce!
He felt that facing that recent sword strike, he would likely end up with the same fate as Lü Weihuang!

Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng had the same feeling, each spirited, looking at Ding Ling with growing admiration. Especially seeing the enemy in disarray, fleeing all around because of Ding Ling alone, their sense of achievement and honor soared!
After all, Ding Ling was their leader, their family!
Clatter, clatter!
Ding Ling rode on.
No one could stop him.

He let his horse and sword go as they pleased, effortlessly sweeping away all attacks, whether hidden arrows or open spears. Even more, each counterattack of the Giant Que Sword inevitably caused significant casualties.
In front of Ding Ling.
First-class, super-elite generals were no different from ordinary soldiers.
All couldn't withstand a single blow!
Clang!
Another strike of the Sword God Skill.

Clusters of sword flowers condensed into a tangible Flowers in Bloom, unstoppable all the way through, crushing those in its path, and with a booming sound, directly shattered the tightly closed courtyard doors.
Revealing the appearance of Heaven and Earth within.
Ding Ling saw a group of 'big shots' trying to act calm but visibly panicked.

sentences.text: "We won't interfere with each other.
We definitely don't mean to offend you.
We'll change our route, change our route!"
The players, with a whoosh, ran to the side path, stretched their legs, and fled for their lives.
When they had run far enough that Ding Ling and his group were out of sight, they finally took a few heavy breaths, each with lingering fear:
"Ding Ling is terrifying.
Just a glance from him feels like being watched by a hundred thousand fierce beasts.
I was nearly scared to death just now!"
"Me too.
I was almost scared to wet myself!
I don't know how Ding Ling practices, his aura is as vast as the sea, his presence as deep as an abyss, his gaze as profound as the galaxy.
Just looking at him makes my skin crawl with terror, how can we fight?!"
"Exactly.
He's too powerful!
From a distance, it wasn't too bad, but up close, I was really intimidated!"
The players were not satisfied.
They're all players, but the difference between them and Ding Ling is like heaven and earth.
The gap is too big to accept!
They've already decided to band together and report Ding Ling!
Ding Ling must be exploiting a game bug to cheat, otherwise, there's no way to explain all this!
Ding Ling didn't care about the players, he just rode straight into the Yuan Family's inner courtyard, stopping a middle-aged man who looked to be of no small status, preparing to flee.
Clang!
Ding Ling made a move like lightning, casually placing his sword at the man's neck:
"Speak.
Where is Yuan Shu?"
"He, he fled."
The middle-aged man froze, not daring to move, only fawning over Ding Ling:
"Hero, please spare me.
I'm just the Yuan Family's steward, this has nothing to do with me."
"Then where is the Yuan Family patriarch?"
"Still in the inner courtyard, packing valuables.
Probably about to flee too."
"Lead the way."
Ding Ling coldly stared at the steward.
The steward dared not refuse and turned to walk deeper into the inner courtyard.
Ding Ling urged.
So he started to jog.
Ding Ling had been here once before and found many places familiar.
The steward had seen Ding Ling before and had a strong impression of him, but Ding Ling hadn't seen him and didn't know him.
The steward didn't know this.
He only ran faster and faster in agitation.
Afraid of being too slow and being cut down by Ding Ling's sword.
He had seen Ding Ling in action before, decisive in killing, mowing down enemies!
Fiercely unstoppable!
He could only regret it.
When he saw Qiao Rui taking Yuan Shu away in a hurry, he should have realized something big was happening.
But alas...

When some household servants and soldiers were leaving with Yuan Family's valuables and precious items, he finally realized it and started thinking of escaping with some wealth himself, but he was too slow and caught red-handed!
Clatter, clatter!
The Yuan Family's inner courtyard was very large.
But the steward ran fast, and Ding Ling and his group were even faster on horseback, arriving shortly at a splendid and magnificent courtyard.
Ding Ling saw groups of soldiers guarding the courtyard entrance.
"This is the place."
The steward said, bowing low.
"Mm.
You can go now."
Ding Ling nodded.
"Thank you, sir!"
The steward was stunned, then ecstatically expressed his gratitude, turning and fleeing the scene even faster than before.
"Traitor!"
A dignified and robust-looking general saw this, was furious, and was ready to shoot the steward with a bow and arrow.
Ding Ling casually swung his sword, the Sunset Swordsmanship displayed its might!
A Setting Sun Diagram appeared radiantly in the void!
It actually condensed into a tangible Sword Map out of thin air!

The Sword Map spun in the air, clanging, directly striking the general's body, and with a scream, the general was blasted backward, crashing through and knocking down no fewer than dozens of soldiers along the way.
The once orderly ranks instantly turned into chaos.
"General Chunyu Qiong is dead!"
Someone shouted.
Chunyu Qiong?
Ding Ling was surprised.
He had just killed this guy?
Chunyu Qiong, styled Zhongjian, hailing from Yingchuan.
During Emperor Ling of the Han, he was one of the Eight Captains of the Imperial Garden, serving as the Right Captain, alongside Yuan Shao, Cao Mengde, Xia Mou, and others.
Later, he became Yuan Shao's great general, renowned alongside Zhang Hex and others.
A true great general, albeit known to be fond of heavy drinking.
But it cannot be denied that although flawed, his combat power must be considerable, otherwise, how could he be renowned alongside Zhang Hex and others?
"Kill him, avenge the general!"
A dashing, heroic general who seemed very close to Chunyu Qiong, was furious and saddened to extremity upon seeing Chunyu Qiong die on the spot, his spear flashed as he charged directly at Ding Ling:
"Follow me, attack!"
"Truly courting death."
The steward had run far and, seeing this scene, shook his head and didn't continue watching, burying his head as he ran away.
Clang!

Ding Ling casually wielded the Giant Que Sword, the Sword God Skill, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, and Qing Frost Swordsmanship constantly transforming in his hands, morphing the Vigorous Qi into a strand of breeze blowing towards the heroic general, poof!
Silently, the general's head was severed!
A column of blood shot skyward.
His tall body ran forward two steps, then collapsed onto the ground.
"General Lü Weihuang is also down!"
Someone shouted again.
"Brothers, retreat!"
It was obvious they were players.
Ding Ling looked towards the voice, just catching the person winking and flattering.
He was stunned, but didn't pretend to be what he wasn't, just nodded and smiled at them.
The person was delighted, shouting with even more vigor.
Of course, to avoid hindering Ding Ling, he ran even faster.
"Another famous general indeed."
Ding Ling recalled Lü Weihuang's records.
Another historically renowned general, related to Lü Bu by family.
Alas, unable to withstand the Celestial Might!
"Ding Ling is too powerful now.
Never mind first-class generals, even super-elite ones might not withstand a single blow from him!"
Zhao Yun was filled with emotion.
Through the journey.
He watched with his heart pounding in awe.
So fierce!
He felt that facing that recent sword strike, he would likely end up with the same fate as Lü Weihuang!
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng had the same feeling, each spirited, looking at Ding Ling with growing admiration.
Especially seeing the enemy in disarray, fleeing all around because of Ding Ling alone, their sense of achievement and honor soared!
After all, Ding Ling was their leader, their family!
Clatter, clatter!
Ding Ling rode on.
No one could stop him.
He let his horse and sword go as they pleased, effortlessly sweeping away all attacks, whether hidden arrows or open spears.
Even more, each counterattack of the Giant Que Sword inevitably caused significant casualties.
In front of Ding Ling.
First-class, super-elite generals were no different from ordinary soldiers.
All couldn't withstand a single blow!
Clang!
Another strike of the Sword God Skill.

Clusters of sword flowers condensed into a tangible Flowers in Bloom, unstoppable all the way through, crushing those in its path, and with a booming sound, directly shattered the tightly closed courtyard doors.
Revealing the appearance of Heaven and Earth within.
Ding Ling saw a group of 'big shots' trying to act calm but visibly panicked.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 218: Strength Beyond Reason (8/12)
paragraphs: The reason it's confirmed they're important figures.
Is because they exude an aura of nobility, transcendence, and extraordinariness.
Coupled with their luxurious clothing, they are evidently high-ranking individuals, far removed from the ordinary world!
"Who is the patriarch of the Yuan Family?"
Ding Ling allowed the Ferghana Horse to stride to the front of this group of people.
He sat upright on the horse, holding the Giant Que Sword, and scanned this group of important figures with an extremely calm expression.
No one spoke.
Each one stared at Ding Ling with wide eyes.
In their eyes, there was anger, frustration, shock, fear, disbelief, and bewilderment... a truly complex mixture.
This was indeed the case.
Initially, someone reported to them that Ding Ling and his group had already killed their way through the city gate guards and entered Wan City.
They thought the reporter was joking, and in their rage, they nearly ordered him to be beaten to death on the spot!
But as more and more messages reached their ears,
they finally confirmed one thing: Ding Ling and his group had truly broken into the city.
Shocked and deeply shaken, many were outraged and began to blame Zhang Xun, Qiao Rui, and Yuan Shu for their inaction!
If they had taken immediate action,
a rain of arrows would have killed even ten Lü Bus!
How could a mere few like Ding Ling accomplish such a feat without being immortals, entering an ironclad city like Wan City?
The only possibility!
Was that Yuan Shu and his associates held a grudge against them for ordering the death of Yuan Yao!
It was for revenge!

Thinking of this, the Yuan Family patriarch and his entourage were filled with rage, with some even suggesting on the spot to expel Yuan Shu from the Yuan Family and remove him from the family records!
It was also at this moment,
someone reported that Ding Ling had reached the Yuan Mansion, and Yuan Shu and others had already fled.
To this,
the patriarch and his entourage became even more convinced that Yuan Shu was behind the mischief, otherwise, why would he flee without even putting up a fight?
In their anger, they ordered Chunyu Qiong and others, who had followed them to Nanyang County, to lead the Guard Team to resist outside.
But what was the result?
To their utter shock.
Even a first-class fierce general like Chunyu Qiong could not withstand a casual blow from the opponent and was slain outright.
A formidable warrior like Lü Weihuang was also killed with ease.
The other warriors were crushed by Ding Ling alone, like withered trees being swept away, and the heavy front gate of the courtyard was pierced and shattered by a single sword from Ding Ling.
Everything they witnessed was profoundly shocking, making them suspect they were dreaming.
Because all this was too unreal.
Not something a human could accomplish!
But upon taking action, sensing the pain, and confirming it was all real, they could only exchange fearful glances, gasping in disbelief.
Each clearly saw the fear and incredulity in the others' eyes.
"If no one speaks."
Ding Ling sighed, raising the Giant Que Sword high:
"Then I'll chop all your heads off."
"Wait!"
An elderly man with a dignified demeanor stepped forward, gazing directly at Ding Ling, his face calm, but his slightly trembling limbs betrayed his extreme fear:
"I am Yuan Kui, the contemporary patriarch of the Yuan Family!"
"Yuan Kui?"
Ding Ling looked down at the old man.
The name sounded very familiar to him.
With a slight thought, he remembered.

Yuan Kui, styled Ciyang. A native of Runan, Yuzhou. Grand Tutor of the Eastern Han Dynasty, younger brother of Yuan Feng, son of Yuan Tang, Marquis Kang of Anx Kingdom, and uncle of Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu.
Held a very high position! Greatly respected!
Later implicated due to Yuan Shao's rebellion against Dong Zhuo, he was killed by Dong Zhuo.
But now he hadn't died.
Needless to say, the involvement of players must have led them to receive news earlier, enabling them to escape smoothly to Nanyang County.
"Since it's you."
Ding Ling coldly eyed Yuan Kui, hefting the Giant Que Sword to strike.
"Hold on."
Yuan Kui, terrified, shouted hastily.
"What's the matter?"
Ding Ling, unhurried, said:
"Do you have anything else to say?"
"Are you human or ghost?"
Yuan Kui's first question was what everyone present, except for Diao Chan and a few others, wanted to know.
"I can assure you I am not a ghost."
Ding Ling replied coldly:
"But you will be a ghost soon."
"Don't kill me."
Yuan Kui stepped back two steps, speaking in fear:

"I am the current Grand Tutor, the patriarch of the Yuan Family. At my command, the members of the Yuan Family from all over the Four Seas will heed my orders. If you kill me, you won't have a good time."
The reason he stepped forward was that he felt if Ding Ling attacked indiscriminately, he would surely die.
So he came out to make a gamble.
Now, he was trying to intimidate Ding Ling.
It was an instinctual counterattack, using influence to oppress.
But would Ding Ling care?
He chuckled:

"You're as foolish as Yuan Yin, truly father and son! But as the saying goes, even a tiger doesn't eat its cub. You could even kill Yuan Yin. Shows how black your heart is. Both stupid and evil, no wonder your rise accelerated the collapse of the Great Han."
Ding Ling no longer wasted words with Yuan Kui.
He swung the raised Giant Que Sword downward.
"Hann Juzi!"
Yuan Kui roared.
A nine-foot-tall fierce general suddenly charged in from the side, raising a knife high, and slashed towards Ding Ling's head.
Trying to surround Wei and save Zhao!
This strike of his, executed with unprecedented might, created such turbulence in the void that it saw vigorous qi forming brilliant flames.
This was due to the great speed of the saber, causing vigorous qi and the void to violently rub, creating sparks.
With one slash.
It seemed as if everything could be shattered!
Bang!
This blow struck heavily on Ding Ling's head, producing a thunderous roar.
"What?!"
The fierce general lost color.
He truly didn't expect Ding Ling not to retract his sword for defense, let alone dodge! Without dodging, and after the blow, Ding Ling remained unscathed.
Instead, his hand was numbed by a counter-shock!
"How is this possible?!"
Everyone was taken aback.
"Puff!"
At the same time, Ding Ling's descending Giant Que Sword cleanly sliced off Yuan Kui's head.
Yuan Kui's face was still etched with shock, bewilderment, and regret.
His eyes seemed to reflect the scene of Ding Ling being struck with a blade, yet remaining unharmed.
The expression on his face froze in a mix of horror and confusion.
Gulp!
The head rolled to a spot not far in front of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn't look, merely glanced at Hann Juzi, who dared to slash at him.
Another historical renowned general.
What a pity...
Ding Ling flicked his wrist, the Giant Que Sword swept across, the Sword God Skill activated, Flowers in Bloom burst forth and bloomed, spinning like lightning, pierced into the void!
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!
Accompanied by a clanging sound, in just an instant, Hann Juzi's hand holding the knife was severed, and his entire body was crushed through by the Flowers in Bloom.
"Strong, strong, very strong."
Hann Juzi struggled to utter this, as his towering body toppled toward Ding Ling like a collapsing mountain.
Boom!
As the body hit the ground.
Even unto death, Hann Juzi couldn't believe such a ghostly figure like Ding Ling existed in this world!
Even ten Lü Bus might not be enough for Ding Ling to kill!
So strong, it defied reason!
