chapters.title: Chapter 219 219: The Destruction of the Yuan Family
paragraphs: Is this the Deity punishing the Yuan Family?
If it really is so.
Why is Hann Juzi getting involved in this mess?
Isn't this seeking death?
Hann Juzi regretted to the extreme before his death. Life only happens once, yet he foolishly tried to rebel against the Deity! If he doesn't die, who will?
[Achievement Medal earned: You intimidated Hann Juzi]

[Note: Hann Juzi served the Yuan Family his whole life and was highly valued by Yuan Kui and Yuan Shao. He was the hidden master within the Yuan Family! He even boasted he wouldn't lose to Chunyu Qiong! A person of great arrogance!
But your appearance shattered all his pride. For the first time, he realized what it means to be a Celestial God-like figure! That there is a world of difference between people!
He even once doubted if you were a Deity incarnate. Because in his instinctive awareness, he didn't believe a mortal could be so strong!]
[Achievement Medal earned: You intimidated Yuan Kui.]

[Note: Yuan Kui is the Patriarch of the Yuan Family. A typical figure who never looks below, and after being at the top for so long, he became accustomed to using his position to pressure others. A skill he honed for decades, which proved unfailing time and time again.
Unfortunately, he encountered a Celestial Human Realm expert like you who doesn't care about power or status!
Until death, Yuan Kui was filled with horror, amazement, disbelief, and sorrow!
He had a premonition. The Yuan Family might completely decline because of a single wanted order he issued! Just because your unmatched strength suppresses everything, truly unparalleled!]
Received two Achievement Medals back-to-back.
Previously, Chunyu Qiong, Lü Weihuang didn't offer any reminders, showing that their Achievement Medals were swiped by others.
And Yuan Kui survived, thanks to the players' reminders and assistance.
But the players didn't swipe away his Achievement Medal.
This shows Yuan Kui's cold heartedness!
The gratitude of saving his life couldn't swipe away the Achievement Medal either.
That leaves only one path. To directly use overwhelming Martial Power to intimidate him, suppress him, kill him, and make him thoroughly submit!
Very clearly.
Ding Ling's path was correct.
At this moment.
After killing Hann Juzi.
Ding Ling's eyes sparkled with sharp glints, as he looked at the remaining big figures:
"As for you all, there is no need for you to exist either."
As the voice fell.
The Giant Que Sword in Ding Ling's hand shook, unleashing the Qing Frost Swordsmanship, Vigorous Qi surged forth, transforming mid-air into swirling snowflakes and frosty pearls!
The flying snow, like a spinning Golden Wheel, tore through heads, as easily as a machine cutting grass;
The frosty pearls, like bullets from a gun, shot out rapidly, easily piercing through bodies and skulls.
Only the sounds of banging and thudding resounded fiercely.
A succession of wails rose up in sequence.
Amidst them, a couple of pleading and horrified screams could be heard.
But to no avail.
Ding Ling was ruthless and decisive.
Especially cold-blooded towards enemies!
Once a decision is made, he will not easily change it unless something really touches his heartstrings and softens him.
But obviously.
This group from the Yuan Family, not one could soften his heart.
In no time at all.
The courtyard was dyed in a scarlet color.
Corpses everywhere.
A scene of devastation.
Zhao Yun, watching with a complex expression, secretly lamented:

"The noble descendants of the Yuan Family of the four generations, Three Ministers, have probably directly lost seventy to eighty percent of their numbers this time! Perhaps on the verge of extinction!"
Zhao Yun became even more determined in his resolve and will to become a Martial God!
Just because this time Ding Ling, with a single sword, a single horse, easily annihilated the Yuan Family's actions.
It deeply shocked and moved him!
For the first time, he realized:
No matter how many soldiers there are, how great the power or prestige!
In front of a truly strong person, they're like mere dirt, crumbling when touched!
"Only a true strong person can dominate Heaven and Earth!"
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and Du Qingcheng all had similar thoughts rise in their hearts at this moment.
Each one resolved.
To train even harder!
[Achievement Medal earned: Annihilate a top-tier family: Yuan Family.]
[Note: Ninety percent of the main descendants of the Yuan Family gathered here. Annihilated in one battle. Equivalent to exterminating the clan.]
Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
Feeling slightly surprised.
He hadn't expected the main descendants of the Yuan Family to be this concentrated?
For what reason?
Unfortunately.
They've all been killed.
There's no one to ask about the reason.
Otherwise, finding one or two people to ask might have uncovered some of the factors.
Ding Ling waved his hand.
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng immediately dismounted and began to clean the battlefield, searching for Secret Manuals.
Da and Xiao Qiao hesitated for a moment, but remembering Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's teachings, imitated and joined in the efforts.
Ding Ling, on his part, stayed alert for lurking arrows.
With him present.
No one could harm Diao Chan and the others.
Soon after.
Diao Chan exclaimed joyfully:
"Ding Ling, Ding Ling, come quickly and see."
Following the sound, at first glance, Ding Ling saw Diao Chan already at the storeroom on the side of the courtyard.
The door of the storeroom was now open.
From standing in the courtyard, one could vaguely see the golden glow radiating out.
Needless to say.
There must be a treasure trove.
Ding Ling felt a surge of joy. Leaping off the horse, with a few agile maneuvers, he reached Diao Chan's side.
Upon closer inspection.
He saw a storeroom of about a hundred square meters.
Filled with various boxes.
A dozen boxes had already been opened by Da and Xiao Qiao, who continued opening more boxes.
Each box was pried and pushed open with a loud clatter.
Clearly visible were the boxes filled with gold.
Dozens of them.
While the subsequent boxes were filled with various precious Secret Manuals, medicinal herbs, jewels, treasures, Divine Weapons, Guqin, Chess Manuals, etc.
Everything one could wish for.
Even Ding Ling, having seen the world, couldn't help but draw a breath.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, as well as Zhao Yun and Du Qingcheng, who arrived upon hearing the sound, were completely dumbfounded.
This was wealth beyond imagination!
"Truly worthy of the Yuan Family!"
Ding Ling marveled:

"With ninety percent of the main descendants gathered here, they must have been plotting something big. This grand scheme might have required most of the Yuan Family's resources, so the resources gathered here too. Unfortunately, alas, they ended up benefiting me."
Ding Ling suddenly realized why these people didn't flee.
Apart from their confidence in their own warriors' Combat Power;
They were certainly reluctant to abandon such quantities of treasures and Secret Manuals, etc.
"What big scheme requires so many Secret Manuals, Great Medicine, gold and silver, and the cooperation of main descendants?"
Diao Chan pondered:

"Could it be they were preparing, with the chaos approaching, to nominate a new Patriarch for the Yuan Family? Or perhaps promote a figure capable of contending for the world. Supporting them with all their might?"
"It seems likely."
Ding Ling's eyes gleamed, thinking of Yuan Shu and Yuan Shao.
And now, both of them seemed absent here.
This shows the nomination was secretly arranged.
Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao surely hadn't been informed.
But alas.
The nomination hadn't even started.

sentences.text: Is this the Deity punishing the Yuan Family?
If it really is so.
Why is Hann Juzi getting involved in this mess?
Isn't this seeking death?
Hann Juzi regretted to the extreme before his death.
Life only happens once, yet he foolishly tried to rebel against the Deity!
If he doesn't die, who will?
[Achievement Medal earned: You intimidated Hann Juzi]
[Note: Hann Juzi served the Yuan Family his whole life and was highly valued by Yuan Kui and Yuan Shao.
He was the hidden master within the Yuan Family!
He even boasted he wouldn't lose to Chunyu Qiong!
A person of great arrogance!
But your appearance shattered all his pride.
For the first time, he realized what it means to be a Celestial God-like figure!
That there is a world of difference between people!
He even once doubted if you were a Deity incarnate.
Because in his instinctive awareness, he didn't believe a mortal could be so strong!]
[Achievement Medal earned: You intimidated Yuan Kui.]
[Note: Yuan Kui is the Patriarch of the Yuan Family.
A typical figure who never looks below, and after being at the top for so long, he became accustomed to using his position to pressure others.
A skill he honed for decades, which proved unfailing time and time again.
Unfortunately, he encountered a Celestial Human Realm expert like you who doesn't care about power or status!
Until death, Yuan Kui was filled with horror, amazement, disbelief, and sorrow!
He had a premonition.
The Yuan Family might completely decline because of a single wanted order he issued!
Just because your unmatched strength suppresses everything, truly unparalleled!]
Received two Achievement Medals back-to-back.
Previously, Chunyu Qiong, Lü Weihuang didn't offer any reminders, showing that their Achievement Medals were swiped by others.
And Yuan Kui survived, thanks to the players' reminders and assistance.
But the players didn't swipe away his Achievement Medal.
This shows Yuan Kui's cold heartedness!
The gratitude of saving his life couldn't swipe away the Achievement Medal either.
That leaves only one path.
To directly use overwhelming Martial Power to intimidate him, suppress him, kill him, and make him thoroughly submit!
Very clearly.
Ding Ling's path was correct.
At this moment.
After killing Hann Juzi.
Ding Ling's eyes sparkled with sharp glints, as he looked at the remaining big figures:
"As for you all, there is no need for you to exist either."
As the voice fell.
The Giant Que Sword in Ding Ling's hand shook, unleashing the Qing Frost Swordsmanship, Vigorous Qi surged forth, transforming mid-air into swirling snowflakes and frosty pearls!
The flying snow, like a spinning Golden Wheel, tore through heads, as easily as a machine cutting grass;
The frosty pearls, like bullets from a gun, shot out rapidly, easily piercing through bodies and skulls.
Only the sounds of banging and thudding resounded fiercely.
A succession of wails rose up in sequence.
Amidst them, a couple of pleading and horrified screams could be heard.
But to no avail.
Ding Ling was ruthless and decisive.
Especially cold-blooded towards enemies!
Once a decision is made, he will not easily change it unless something really touches his heartstrings and softens him.
But obviously.
This group from the Yuan Family, not one could soften his heart.
In no time at all.
The courtyard was dyed in a scarlet color.
Corpses everywhere.
A scene of devastation.
Zhao Yun, watching with a complex expression, secretly lamented:
"The noble descendants of the Yuan Family of the four generations, Three Ministers, have probably directly lost seventy to eighty percent of their numbers this time!
Perhaps on the verge of extinction!"
Zhao Yun became even more determined in his resolve and will to become a Martial God!
Just because this time Ding Ling, with a single sword, a single horse, easily annihilated the Yuan Family's actions.
It deeply shocked and moved him!
For the first time, he realized:
No matter how many soldiers there are, how great the power or prestige!
In front of a truly strong person, they're like mere dirt, crumbling when touched!
"Only a true strong person can dominate Heaven and Earth!"
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and Du Qingcheng all had similar thoughts rise in their hearts at this moment.
Each one resolved.
To train even harder!
[Achievement Medal earned: Annihilate a top-tier family: Yuan Family.]
[Note: Ninety percent of the main descendants of the Yuan Family gathered here.
Annihilated in one battle.
Equivalent to exterminating the clan.]
Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
Feeling slightly surprised.
He hadn't expected the main descendants of the Yuan Family to be this concentrated?
For what reason?
Unfortunately.
They've all been killed.
There's no one to ask about the reason.
Otherwise, finding one or two people to ask might have uncovered some of the factors.
Ding Ling waved his hand.
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng immediately dismounted and began to clean the battlefield, searching for Secret Manuals.
Da and Xiao Qiao hesitated for a moment, but remembering Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's teachings, imitated and joined in the efforts.
Ding Ling, on his part, stayed alert for lurking arrows.
With him present.
No one could harm Diao Chan and the others.
Soon after.
Diao Chan exclaimed joyfully:
"Ding Ling, Ding Ling, come quickly and see."
Following the sound, at first glance, Ding Ling saw Diao Chan already at the storeroom on the side of the courtyard.
The door of the storeroom was now open.
From standing in the courtyard, one could vaguely see the golden glow radiating out.
Needless to say.
There must be a treasure trove.
Ding Ling felt a surge of joy.
Leaping off the horse, with a few agile maneuvers, he reached Diao Chan's side.
Upon closer inspection.
He saw a storeroom of about a hundred square meters.
Filled with various boxes.
A dozen boxes had already been opened by Da and Xiao Qiao, who continued opening more boxes.
Each box was pried and pushed open with a loud clatter.
Clearly visible were the boxes filled with gold.
Dozens of them.
While the subsequent boxes were filled with various precious Secret Manuals, medicinal herbs, jewels, treasures, Divine Weapons, Guqin, Chess Manuals, etc.
Everything one could wish for.
Even Ding Ling, having seen the world, couldn't help but draw a breath.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, as well as Zhao Yun and Du Qingcheng, who arrived upon hearing the sound, were completely dumbfounded.
This was wealth beyond imagination!
"Truly worthy of the Yuan Family!"
Ding Ling marveled:
"With ninety percent of the main descendants gathered here, they must have been plotting something big.
This grand scheme might have required most of the Yuan Family's resources, so the resources gathered here too.
Unfortunately, alas, they ended up benefiting me."
Ding Ling suddenly realized why these people didn't flee.
Apart from their confidence in their own warriors' Combat Power;
They were certainly reluctant to abandon such quantities of treasures and Secret Manuals, etc.
"What big scheme requires so many Secret Manuals, Great Medicine, gold and silver, and the cooperation of main descendants?"
Diao Chan pondered:
"Could it be they were preparing, with the chaos approaching, to nominate a new Patriarch for the Yuan Family?
Or perhaps promote a figure capable of contending for the world.
Supporting them with all their might?"
"It seems likely."
Ding Ling's eyes gleamed, thinking of Yuan Shu and Yuan Shao.
And now, both of them seemed absent here.
This shows the nomination was secretly arranged.
Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao surely hadn't been informed.
But alas.
The nomination hadn't even started.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 220: Boundless Vitality
paragraphs: The unborn fetus has perished, leaving Ding Ling to benefit.
Ding Ling has gained such heaven-shattering benefits, naturally there's no reason to let outsiders benefit. He directly said:
"I think this Wan City is not bad. We'll live here from now on."
He turned around and looked outside:
"Why don't we take action together and first subdue the chaotic army in this city?"
"We'll follow your lead!"
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao exchanged glances and then said in unison, very harmoniously.
"Alright."
Ding Ling didn't bother to be courteous with them.
"I'll first consume some Great Medicine to enhance my strength, and then go subdue that chaotic army."
"Still enhancing strength..."
Diao Chan paused.
Zhao Yun was awestruck.
Da and Xiao Qiao were stunned.

Du Qingcheng's heart tightened, feeling more determined that she must strive hard. Even someone as strong as Ding Ling is not content with his current strength and continues to improve. Her level of strength, someone who would die instantly if touched by Ding Ling! What qualification or reason does she have not to strive hard?!
"Let's try this box of Great Medicine first."
Ding Ling glanced over the dozens of boxes of Great Medicine.
These Great Medicines are not comparable to ordinary herbs.
They are true Great Medicines that have aged and ripened.
The weakest are at least a hundred years old.
It's a pity.
A century-old is useless to him.
Ding Ling consumed a two-hundred-year-old one.
Found its effect was minimal as well.

He thought about the strength of Diao Chan and others, who also needed large quantities of Great Medicine to enhance their strength, and abandoned the idea of consuming plants two or three hundred years old.
He directly started consuming six hundred years old ones.
Crunch, crunch!
Bite by bite, he ate.
Quickly finished one plant.
Breathing Technique achieves Unity of Inner and Outer.
Operates perfectly.
The medicinal power was refined at lightning speed, and just in an instant, heat spread throughout the body, Ding Ling's skin membrane, meridians, etc., were forged and enhanced accordingly.
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.1]
[Physique +0.1]
[Defense +0]
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel.
Indeed, agility and physique both increased.
It seems the drug resistance is getting stronger.
This 600-year Great Medicine only enhanced Ding Ling by a mere agility 0.1, physique 0.1 per plant.
It's apparent that the more terrifying and powerful Ding Ling becomes, the more difficult it is for Great Medicine to enhance him.
If it weren't for Breathing Technique achieving the deepest level of Mastery.
Ding Ling might need a long time to refine such a Great Medicine!
But precisely because his Breathing Technique is so powerful.
Ding Ling dares to consume and evolve now.
After consuming one plant.
Ding Ling started eating again.
This box of 600-year Great Medicines contains as many as a dozen plants.
After Ding Ling finished consuming all of them.
[Strength +0]
[Agility +1]
[Physique +1]
[Defense +0]
The more he consumed.
The stronger drug resistance against the Great Medicines became.
The strength enhancement also reduced, as a dozen plants only increased his stats by 1 point.
Though slightly surprised, Ding Ling felt more exhilarated.
After all, these Great Medicines were akin to being picked up for free!
Ding Ling glanced at the panel.
Strength variation:
[Root Bone 1 (ordinary human is 1), Wisdom 2.1, Strength 31, Agility 27.7, Physique 29.1, Defense 31, Charm 7.]
Physique is increasingly approaching the limit of External Refining Breathing Technique values.
Ding Ling clearly feels his stamina, endurance, and life vitality surging.
If previously he could only live for 100 years.
Now possibly 120, even 130 years.
This is the benefit of enhanced physique!
Besides endurance, life vitality is becoming more exuberant!
"Continue."
Ding Ling proceeded to the 700-year Great Medicine area and started consuming again.
While Ding Ling was consuming the 600-year Great Medicine, Diao Chan and others glanced enviously at Ding Ling and then went back to cleaning the battlefield, clearing out Yuan Mansion.
The conquered Yuan Mansion.
May later serve as their rest and living quarters.
They naturally need to organize and gather items that can be helpful to their side as much as possible.
Crunch, crunch!
Ding Ling devoured Great Medicines one bite at a time.
After as many as eight 700-year Great Medicines were consumed, refined, absorbed, and enhanced.
[Strength +0]
[Agility +1.2]
[Physique +1.2]
[Defense +0]
Agility reached 28.9.
Physique directly broke the limit of the External Refining Breathing Technique value, reaching 30.3.
Ding Ling felt himself becoming even stronger.
Meridians and bones seemed to have been forged and stretched, leaping ability, speed, etc., increased significantly.
Physique breaking the limit also resulted in a doubling of growth.
Like strength, breaking the limit becomes more condensed. Its essence is far superior to the past. And as the limit value continues to increase, this essence will continuously evolve.
Until completely transcending the mundane, progressing to Celestial Human Realm, with every move like containing Celestial Might!
The current physique now has a similar feeling.
But it's still in the stage of metamorphosis!
Perhaps when it reaches 31 points, it will be the time to break the cocoon and reborn, thoroughly transforming and evolving!
"Very good."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, feeling greatly satisfied.
He walked to the box of 800-year Great Medicines.
Seeing there were as many as five Great Medicines inside, his spirit slightly lifted!
It must be noted that earlier, the Yuan Family Treasury didn't even have a single 800-year Great Medicine!
No. To be more accurate, only the eight-hundred-year-old reishi held by Diao Chan.
And here there are five.
This is quite rare.
Remember, the older the Great Medicine, the harder it is to find!
Sometimes, even after finding a thousand-century-old Great Medicines, it might not be possible to find a single 800-year-old one!
Such five Great Medicines.
Must definitely greatly aid Ding Ling.
Ding Ling knew this well, directly picked them up, and started eating.
Crunch, crunch!
Didn't hesitate to refine and consume them one by one.
The powerful Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique is like a Divine Level alchemy furnace, rapidly refining medicinal power, nourishing Ding Ling's own body!
Ding Ling's meridians and organs were once again forged, strengthened, and elevated.
A moment later.
[Strength +0]
[Agility +1.8]
[Physique +0.7]
[Defense +0]
Agility reached 30.7
Physique reached the limit value of the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Technique: 31 points!
"Hoo-hoo!"
With every inhale and exhale, rolling Spiritual Mechanisms entered the organs, transforming into his vast life source.
Ding Ling felt at this moment, he seemed to have achieved thorough metamorphosis.
It's an enhancement and evolution of life essence.
As if transforming from a mortal into an Immortal.
"This feeling?!"
Ding Ling is shaken. After a close comprehension.
Somewhat finds it hard to believe.
"My life vitality seems to be rushing towards a thousand years? Two thousand years? Or three thousand years? How is this different from immortality?"
His life vitality is too strong.
As long as he stands in this world.
The entire universe seems to become his Origin Land, continually providing him with vast Spiritual Mechanisms, boundless life vitality!
He seems to have become an immortal Divine Being!
A true Earth Immortal!
"So strong."
After explosive enhancements in strength and defense, Ding Ling didn't have such profound insights.
Indeed, the impact of life vitality impressed him more!
Who in the world doesn't fear death?
No matter how strong a Sword God or Spear God might be, there comes a day they will age and perish.
Worldly masters?
Many have silently died on some unnamed old mountain!

chapters.title: Chapter 221 221: I Am God (11/12)
paragraphs: At this moment, Ding Ling possessed the ability many dreamed of: immortality!
"Although I'm not sure how long I can live, this explosive vitality, as if I could live for 3000 years, or even 10,000 years, is truly wonderful!"
Ding Ling was overjoyed.
He hadn't expected that after his physique broke the limits of the mortal realm and reached the Celestial Human Realm, he would gain such abilities!
It's terrifying.
And at this moment.
Ding Ling was almost certain.
If there truly is a Land God like Nanhua Old Immortal in this world,
Then this Nanhua Old Immortal is likely a super expert whose physique and agility have broken 30 points and reached the 31-point Celestial Human Realm!
And it can be almost certain that if Nanhua Old Immortal has really lived a long time, he must have practiced the Breathing Technique of Unity of Inner and Outer!
And reached an extremely profound realm.
Because without a deep realm, it is impossible to perfectly refine the medicinal power, and the time required is terrifying.
"Continue."
Ding Ling was incredibly excited.
He walked to the box of 900-year Great Medicine.
Took a glance.
Inside, there were three whole Great Medicines!
"Very strong."
Ding Ling was moved.
Worthy of the top family, the Yuan Family!
Three whole 900-year Great Medicines!
He picked one up and crunched it down.
A strong warmth spread throughout his body.
After a while.
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.3]
[Physique +0]
[Defense +0]
At this moment, agility also reached 31 points.
Snap!
Snap!
Ding Ling's muscles and bones were stretched and forged to the extreme, and in just a moment, Ding Ling felt as if he had completely broken through the world's constraints once again!
This time the world seemed to relieve its limitations on his weight and leap.

Ding Ling came to the courtyard, executed the Flying Swallow Technique, and gently leapt into the air, soaring directly dozens of yards, over a hundred meters high, as if he could reach out and touch the clouds.

Because he soared so high, Ding Ling couldn't control it momentarily, not knowing how to adjust his posture mid-air, flailing his arms and legs, he fell like a meteor from a hundred meters high, bang!
A crater formed in the ground.
Yet Ding Ling was unscathed.
Only his clothes and armor were a bit tattered.
He was excited, joyful:
"This leaping ability is simply unbeatable!"
Ding Ling had imagined.
After all, once defense and strength broke the world constraints, they were terrifyingly powerful.
There was no reason for agility not to be just as strong once it broke the constraints.
And indeed it was.

After breaking the constraints and reaching the Celestial Human Realm, agility allowed a casual leap of a hundred meters, and if he leapt with full strength, could he soar several hundred meters? Even a thousand meters high?
At such heights?
How is it different from being Superman?!
"I just don't know if the me in the real world will become this strong as well?"
Ding Ling was eager to try.
He wanted to try earlier.
But unfortunately, there were many matters to handle in the game.
Moreover, some experiments in the real world are really difficult to conduct too extensively, so Ding Ling always logged in and out of the game hastily.
But he's decided next time he logs out,
he must study it thoroughly!
"If I can be immortal in reality as well. Just by enduring time, I could easily outlive several generations."
Comparing strength, etc.
In Ding Ling's view,
boundless vitality is truly the strongest.
Without strong longevity as support, no matter how powerful a person is, they'll only shine for a short while before turning to smoke and disappearing!
"This Three Kingdoms World is indeed extraordinary."
Ding Ling looked up at the sky:
"No wonder such god-like figures as Nanhua Old Immortal and Daoist Zuo Ci could emerge. It's not without reason!"
The more he practiced the Inner and Outer Breathing Technique, the deeper Ding Ling's understanding.
Now, having broken limits multiple times,
all four attributes reached the Celestial Human Realm.
Ding Ling understood this world more and more.
"You could say now, I can be called the god of this world!"
Ding Ling lightly clenched his fist, feeling the overwhelming power and vitality within himself! He felt deeply satisfied.
"With my current state, sweeping through the Three Kingdoms poses no problem."
Ding Ling pondered:
"Even if I became an emperor, I doubt anyone could contest me."
But what's the point of being an emperor?
Ding Ling's power was already unbeatable in this world!
Even Super-Elite Experts were no match for him in one encounter!
For him, any number of soldiers was just decoration, mere paper!
He had transcended this world, standing above everyone's heads!
"Being an emperor requires handling all sorts of governmental affairs, too tiring. How can it compare to the ease and freedom of being a leisurely Immortal?"
The stronger the power.
The greater the change in mindset.
Previously, Ding Ling had some thoughts about power in the Three Kingdoms World.
After all, the dream of sleeping on the beauties' knees and controlling the world after waking. He had had that dream.
But as he stood atop the world, Ding Ling suddenly saw the power of the secular world as no more than chicken ribs!
Previously, he yearned for power because it could bring him enough strength and backing! Providing an unparalleled sense of security!
But now?
His sense of security was through the roof!
Even as an emperor, he could kill whom he wished!
In this world, he could essentially have the final say!
"Choose an agent. End this chaotic Three Kingdoms earlier."
Ding Ling thought:
"After all, I promised Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Daoist Yhiuu Ji and those esteemed elders. One mustn't break promises to respectable elders!"
Against evil people, villains, and scoundrels.
Ding Ling believed in using violence to curb violence, evil to combat evil, so he would not speak of courtesy, morality, or keeping promises with bad people.
But figures like Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing were different!
They are respected and acknowledged saints.
Ding Ling must deliver on his promises to them! This is his core ethic!
Besides that.
He also promised Zhao Yun and Diao Chan and others.
And Zhao Yun and the others were his own people.
Towards his own people, Ding Ling was biased and deeply affectionate, he couldn't possibly break promises to them!
"Whom to choose as the agent?"
In an instant, a series of names flashed through Ding Ling's mind.
He needed someone who could ensure the people's peace and stability swiftly, possessing unparalleled talent!
Cao Mengde!
Ding Ling could only think of this answer.
Of course, if there were better options, he wouldn't mind excluding Cao Mengde.
Da-da-da!
A series of hurried footsteps suddenly sounded.

Ding Ling's thoughts were interrupted, and he looked towards the sound, only to see Diao Chan and others rushing over hurriedly, looking at the sky, then at the human-shaped pit on the ground, and comparing it to Ding Ling's stature, they couldn't help but gasp in shock:
"Ding Ling, you, did you create this?!"
They had seen a human-like silhouette emerge from the sky earlier from afar, and that silhouette plummeted towards the courtyard where Ding Ling was, creating a thunderous roar.
They became tense, moved, and rushed swiftly toward Ding Ling's direction.
Then they saw Ding Ling standing in tattered clothes as if pondering or deliberating something, seemingly without any other reaction.
But upon noticing the human-shaped pit, they compared and already concluded in their hearts.

sentences.text: At this moment, Ding Ling possessed the ability many dreamed of: immortality!
"Although I'm not sure how long I can live, this explosive vitality, as if I could live for 3000 years, or even 10,000 years, is truly wonderful!"
Ding Ling was overjoyed.
He hadn't expected that after his physique broke the limits of the mortal realm and reached the Celestial Human Realm, he would gain such abilities!
It's terrifying.
And at this moment.
Ding Ling was almost certain.
If there truly is a Land God like Nanhua Old Immortal in this world,
Then this Nanhua Old Immortal is likely a super expert whose physique and agility have broken 30 points and reached the 31-point Celestial Human Realm!
And it can be almost certain that if Nanhua Old Immortal has really lived a long time, he must have practiced the Breathing Technique of Unity of Inner and Outer!
And reached an extremely profound realm.
Because without a deep realm, it is impossible to perfectly refine the medicinal power, and the time required is terrifying.
"Continue."
Ding Ling was incredibly excited.
He walked to the box of 900-year Great Medicine.
Took a glance.
Inside, there were three whole Great Medicines!
"Very strong."
Ding Ling was moved.
Worthy of the top family, the Yuan Family!
Three whole 900-year Great Medicines!
He picked one up and crunched it down.
A strong warmth spread throughout his body.
After a while.
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0.3]
[Physique +0]
[Defense +0]
At this moment, agility also reached 31 points.
Snap!
Snap!
Ding Ling's muscles and bones were stretched and forged to the extreme, and in just a moment, Ding Ling felt as if he had completely broken through the world's constraints once again!
This time the world seemed to relieve its limitations on his weight and leap.

Ding Ling came to the courtyard, executed the Flying Swallow Technique, and gently leapt into the air, soaring directly dozens of yards, over a hundred meters high, as if he could reach out and touch the clouds.

Because he soared so high, Ding Ling couldn't control it momentarily, not knowing how to adjust his posture mid-air, flailing his arms and legs, he fell like a meteor from a hundred meters high, bang!
A crater formed in the ground.
Yet Ding Ling was unscathed.
Only his clothes and armor were a bit tattered.
He was excited, joyful:
"This leaping ability is simply unbeatable!"
Ding Ling had imagined.
After all, once defense and strength broke the world constraints, they were terrifyingly powerful.
There was no reason for agility not to be just as strong once it broke the constraints.
And indeed it was.
After breaking the constraints and reaching the Celestial Human Realm, agility allowed a casual leap of a hundred meters, and if he leapt with full strength, could he soar several hundred meters?
Even a thousand meters high?
At such heights?
How is it different from being Superman?!
"I just don't know if the me in the real world will become this strong as well?"
Ding Ling was eager to try.
He wanted to try earlier.
But unfortunately, there were many matters to handle in the game.
Moreover, some experiments in the real world are really difficult to conduct too extensively, so Ding Ling always logged in and out of the game hastily.
But he's decided next time he logs out,
he must study it thoroughly!
"If I can be immortal in reality as well.
Just by enduring time, I could easily outlive several generations."
Comparing strength, etc.
In Ding Ling's view,
boundless vitality is truly the strongest.
Without strong longevity as support, no matter how powerful a person is, they'll only shine for a short while before turning to smoke and disappearing!
"This Three Kingdoms World is indeed extraordinary."
Ding Ling looked up at the sky:
"No wonder such god-like figures as Nanhua Old Immortal and Daoist Zuo Ci could emerge.
It's not without reason!"
The more he practiced the Inner and Outer Breathing Technique, the deeper Ding Ling's understanding.
Now, having broken limits multiple times,
all four attributes reached the Celestial Human Realm.
Ding Ling understood this world more and more.
"You could say now, I can be called the god of this world!"
Ding Ling lightly clenched his fist, feeling the overwhelming power and vitality within himself!
He felt deeply satisfied.
"With my current state, sweeping through the Three Kingdoms poses no problem."
Ding Ling pondered:
"Even if I became an emperor, I doubt anyone could contest me."
But what's the point of being an emperor?
Ding Ling's power was already unbeatable in this world!
Even Super-Elite Experts were no match for him in one encounter!
For him, any number of soldiers was just decoration, mere paper!
He had transcended this world, standing above everyone's heads!
"Being an emperor requires handling all sorts of governmental affairs, too tiring.
How can it compare to the ease and freedom of being a leisurely Immortal?"
The stronger the power.
The greater the change in mindset.
Previously, Ding Ling had some thoughts about power in the Three Kingdoms World.
After all, the dream of sleeping on the beauties' knees and controlling the world after waking.
He had had that dream.
But as he stood atop the world, Ding Ling suddenly saw the power of the secular world as no more than chicken ribs!
Previously, he yearned for power because it could bring him enough strength and backing!
Providing an unparalleled sense of security!
But now?
His sense of security was through the roof!
Even as an emperor, he could kill whom he wished!
In this world, he could essentially have the final say!
"Choose an agent.
End this chaotic Three Kingdoms earlier."
Ding Ling thought:
"After all, I promised Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Daoist Yhiuu Ji and those esteemed elders.
One mustn't break promises to respectable elders!"
Against evil people, villains, and scoundrels.
Ding Ling believed in using violence to curb violence, evil to combat evil, so he would not speak of courtesy, morality, or keeping promises with bad people.
But figures like Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing were different!
They are respected and acknowledged saints.
Ding Ling must deliver on his promises to them!
This is his core ethic!
Besides that.
He also promised Zhao Yun and Diao Chan and others.
And Zhao Yun and the others were his own people.
Towards his own people, Ding Ling was biased and deeply affectionate, he couldn't possibly break promises to them!
"Whom to choose as the agent?"
In an instant, a series of names flashed through Ding Ling's mind.
He needed someone who could ensure the people's peace and stability swiftly, possessing unparalleled talent!
Cao Mengde!
Ding Ling could only think of this answer.
Of course, if there were better options, he wouldn't mind excluding Cao Mengde.
Da-da-da!
A series of hurried footsteps suddenly sounded.

Ding Ling's thoughts were interrupted, and he looked towards the sound, only to see Diao Chan and others rushing over hurriedly, looking at the sky, then at the human-shaped pit on the ground, and comparing it to Ding Ling's stature, they couldn't help but gasp in shock:
"Ding Ling, you, did you create this?!"
They had seen a human-like silhouette emerge from the sky earlier from afar, and that silhouette plummeted towards the courtyard where Ding Ling was, creating a thunderous roar.
They became tense, moved, and rushed swiftly toward Ding Ling's direction.
Then they saw Ding Ling standing in tattered clothes as if pondering or deliberating something, seemingly without any other reaction.
But upon noticing the human-shaped pit, they compared and already concluded in their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 222 222: The Immortal Traverses the Void (12/12)
paragraphs: But even so, Diao Chan and the others couldn't hide their shock, each showing a change of color.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling did not hide anything from Diao Chan and her group, nodding with a smile:
"My agility has broken through the limit and entered the Celestial Human Realm."
"Agility has also entered the Celestial Human Realm?"
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and Du Qingcheng were utterly shocked: "So fast?!"
It felt like just a blink of an eye!
Ding Ling broke through to the Celestial Human Realm with agility!
The speed was somewhat unbelievable!
They hadn't even finished cleaning up the Yuan Family yet!
"Besides agility, has your constitution also entered the Celestial Human Realm?"
Zhao Yun sensed the surging and raging life vitality within Ding Ling and couldn't help but ask.
Ding Ling had already explained to Zhao Yun and the others all the precautions about breaking through to the Celestial Human Realm.
He naturally also mentioned the specific situation of the four-dimensional attributes.
So now Zhao Yun and the others understood what Ding Ling meant by saying agility and constitution.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling nodded:
"All my four-dimensional attributes have broken into the Celestial Human Realm!"
"Hiss!"
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and the others collectively gasped, looking dumbstruck.
This is too fast!
In just a short time, both attributes broke through their shackles and entered the Celestial Human Realm.
"Is the unity of the Inner and Outer Breathing Method this powerful?"
Du Qingcheng said with longing.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling nodded:

"As long as the inner and outer breathing techniques reach mastery, the speed of refining medicinal power will be incredibly terrifying! The efficiency will be very high, with almost no waste, better than soaking in a medicinal bath a hundred times, a thousand times!"
Zhao Yun and Diao Chan listened, feeling both envious and longing, wishing that they could train their inner refining and external refining breathing techniques to mastery soon!
"Now, your strength definitely far exceeds my master and the Sword God."
Zhao Yun thought about when Ding Ling leaped lightly and soared directly into the sky, unable to help but click his tongue:
"If my master and they see you advancing to the Celestial Human Realm in such a short time, they'll surely be extremely shocked and awed!"
"I look forward to meeting the elders again."
Ding Ling smiled.
"Can you show us again the state of agility entering the Celestial Human Realm?"
Da and Xiao Qiao were hopeful.
"Of course.
Ding Ling said:
"Honestly, my proficiency and control over the agility of the Celestial Human Realm aren't deep yet. Just take this moment to practice and get familiar with it."
Ding Ling and his group went directly to the Yuan Family's martial arts field.
Then Ding Ling began to showcase high agility.
With a light leap, he reached a hundred meters!
Utilizing Ascending Skill and Flying Swallow Technique, with a heavy ground stomp, he could soar hundreds of meters high, seemingly reaching out to pluck the stars from the sky!
The sky was clear and bright at this moment!
The stars were high above.
Underneath the bright moon.
Ding Ling lightly leaped high in the air, akin to a divine being crossing to the other shore! Seeming to tread on the bright moon! To fly into the Celestial Court!
It was filled with a dreamlike, mythical hue.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun were dazzled, their hearts and spirits swaying! Almost unable to maintain themselves!

And some players who witnessed this scene, as if seeing a ghost, took out the telescopes developed and already spread in small scales among players, seeing clearly who was soaring in the sky, screamed in horror:
"Oh my, it's Ding Ling!"
"Unbelievable! Has that guy really become an immortal?!"
"He must be cheating!"

The screams were so loud that they woke many people, and once they understood what had happened, each borrowed a telescope or went to seek a vantage point, seeing clearly, they too were dizzy, almost fainting.
Many native commanders felt their worldviews collapsing.
They initially planned to gather troops to make a comeback, but upon seeing this scene, they immediately gave up, each pondering in their hearts:
"Ding Ling is so incredible and terrifying, truly beyond human! And indeed, this guy is not a human. How could ordinary people fly and wield a sword in the sky, traverse the void? Too terrifying.
The Yuan Family fighting against someone like this is simply seeking death!"
Thinking of the Wanted Order the Yuan Family issued against Ding Ling earlier.
And now seeing Ding Ling soaring and wielding a sword within the Yuan Mansion, akin to an immortal descending from the heavens, a deity paving the way!
Involuntarily mourning for the Yuan Family!
Needless to say.
The Yuan Family's top leaders must have collectively gone to see King Yama!
Daring to put a bounty on such an Earth Immortal, isn't that asking for trouble?!
"We even tried to obstruct such a deity? Truly the ignorance of the fearless, or what?!"
Screams.
Shouts.
Rising one after another.
Echoing throughout Wan City.
Wan City was a big city.
There were quite a few wealthy families.
Many people could afford telescopes.
Even those who couldn't buy could borrow from friends to watch.
So, one spread to ten, ten to a hundred.
During this hour that Ding Ling practiced and mastered the lightweight body technique and soared across the sky.
His deeds were suddenly spread throughout Wan City!
Countless people were deeply impressed by that figure that seemed to tread on the bright moon and wield a sword in the sky! It's safe to say they will never forget this scene in their lifetime!
It's like mortals seeing the Dragon King.
The impact was like countless meteors falling, the mighty bright moon crashing to the earth! Unparalleled, extremely terrifying! Indelibly etched in memory!
How could it be forgotten?!
Additionally.
Many people love to watch the excitement, especially the spectacle of the legendary 'Immortal'! This further triggered a collective uproar and widespread dissemination.
No one could refuse to watch such a celestial spectacle!

Even the poorest peasants at that moment couldn't help but climb to their rooftops, standing on tiptoe, looking with a face full of amazement and admiration at the direction of the Yuan Mansion, gazing at that drifting figure like a god, indescribably shocked and in awe!
Some peasants even knelt on the spot!
Mumbling something, praying without knowing for what.
And those far away, who couldn't see this wonder clearly and didn't have telescopes, all rushed frantically to places closer to the Yuan Mansion to watch.
It could be said.
This celestial spectacle of an Immortal crossing the void caused the streets to empty!
Countless people were vying to watch, the excitement exploded!
Ding Ling was completely oblivious to this.
He had already immersed himself in the exhilarating sensation of mastering the lightweight body technique.
At first, he wasn't skilled, always flying high and falling badly!
There were not a hundred, at least eighty human-shaped craters on the martial arts field!
Fortunately, his defense was invincible, particularly resistant to falls!
For another character with high agility, with a bit of carelessness, they might actually fall to their death!
As Ding Ling practiced and mastered the body technique, he couldn't help but be secretly thankful:

"Luckily, I enhanced my defense first. Otherwise, with the enhanced agility, it's imaginable, a bit of carelessness might not kill me, but would definitely cause serious injuries, falling a few more times might directly be game over!"
Defense breaking into the Celestial Human Realm.
Directly comparable to steel armor.
And also carries self-inflicted damage resistance.
Absolutely not fatal from falling. Unshakeable!
Truly a super invincible defensive aura 'armor'!
Ding Ling loved it.
Therefore, he practiced without any concerns, as he couldn't die from falling anyway!

chapters.title: Chapter 223 223: Zhao Yun Masters the Inner and Outer Breathing Technique (1/16)
paragraphs: It was because of the relentless practice, repeatedly falling and rolling.
Ding Ling's mastery and control of the Lightweight Body Technique were continuously improving!
Half an hour later.
Ding Ling could already maneuver Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill in the air, enhanced by Wall-Climbing Technique and Breathing Technique, preventing a rapid fall.
One hour later.
Ding Ling could wield a sword in the air, land safely, and avoid falling like a clumsy dog.
An hour and a half later.
Ding Ling could descend from high above gracefully, like an Exiled Immortal stepping down as if descending a Celestial Ladder, instead of crashing down directly!
By this point.
It's almost enough.
To progress further.
Unless finding a Lightweight Body Technique at a higher tier than Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill.
But it seems unlikely.
Because Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill are already of a very high level. Ding Ling would be satisfied to find a technique of the same tier.
Let alone a higher one.
Thinking of body technique.
After finishing his practice, Ding Ling went back to the library in the inner courtyard.
Searching for a Secret Manual.
He spoke to Diao Chan and the others who followed him, with a strange look on their faces:

"I can't use the Great Medicine here anymore. You all should strive to cultivate the Breathing Technique diligently, and I will help you prepare a medicinal bath. If you can master External Refining Breathing Technique like Zhao Yun, you can consume the Great Medicine directly, which would be ideal."
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao expressed immense gratitude.
Ding Ling's figure, akin to a Divine Being traversing the void and stepping through the sky, was deeply engraved in their memories, never to be forgotten in this lifetime.
"I want to cultivate Inner Refining Breathing Technique now."
Zhao Yun admitted:
"I discovered that I've reached a very deep level with External Refining Breathing Technique, and it's challenging to make further breakthroughs."
"Sure."
Ding Ling looked Zhao Yun straight in the eye:
"After I help Diao Chan and them with their medicinal bath, I'll assist you in practicing Inner Refining Breathing Technique."
Zhao Yun hesitated:
"Didn't we plan to take control of Wan City's military?"
"No need to rush."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"I'm not trying to conquer the world. It doesn't matter whether the military size is large or small; as long as it can maintain Wan City's security, it's enough. However, right now, Wan City's military is too large. Perhaps with around ten thousand soldiers, even if seventy to eighty thousand left, having ten to twenty thousand should suffice."
Only then did Zhao Yun nod in agreement.
Indeed, Wan City had a vast number of soldiers, many of whom were unarmored and unarmed conscripts forced into service.
Most of these soldiers were upstanding citizens of Wan City.
Clearly.
Yuan Shu had already initiated a flow of uncontrolled military recruitment!
An endless, unrestricted forced conscription.
But Ding Ling couldn't be defeated by sheer numbers.
His victory against the rampant military recruitment was as easy as subduing an Earth Immortal!
A period later.
Ding Ling assisted Da and Xiao Qiao with preparing the medicinal bath, allowing them to practice Breathing Technique in a secluded chamber.
Ding Ling began instructing Zhao Yun in Inner Refining Breathing Technique, specifically Taiqing Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling had mastered the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method to an extremely profound level; his breathing technique was cultivated to the Celestial Being level!
His guidance to Zhao Yun was more than sufficient.
In terms of efficiency, it surpassed Daoist Yhiuu Ji's teachings by about ten or even twenty times!
After all, Ding Ling aimed directly at the core issues, without detours.
While Daoist Yhiuu Ji, lacking an instructor for Taiqing Breathing Technique, had encountered numerous obstacles over time, making his teaching potentially more arduous for Zhao Yun.
Ding Ling was essentially overpowered, having reached full level immediately.
Otherwise, even with great aptitude and Daoist Yhiuu Ji's guidance, countless years of meticulous effort would be necessary to reach the inner Refining Breathing Technique's mastery level!
Thanks to Ding Ling's guidance, it was akin to a direct 'empowerment'!
No unnecessary complexities, hitting the core immediately, repeatedly bringing Zhao Yun to sudden realization!
The efficiency was indisputable.
By the end of the night.
Zhao Yun had already reached entry-level in the cultivation of Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
"I've successfully practiced it!"
Zhao Yun was ecstatic!
He was a person who rarely exhibited emotions, generally unperturbed by calamity and possessing an ice-clear heart!
Yet at this moment, he couldn't hide his joy.
Clearly, his inner emotions had reached a boiling point!
"Yes, you succeeded."
Ding Ling praised sincerely.
He had the advantage.
Zhao Yun, however, had truly achieved success through self-cultivation, even if only at an entry level.
But to achieve the successful Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method!
This was already proof of his extraordinary talent!
Historically, those who achieved the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method were all brilliant geniuses of unparalleled greatness!
"I must thank Ding Ling for your guidance and teaching."
Zhao Yun took a deep breath and solemnly expressed his gratitude:
"Without your guidance, even if I possessed the Inner Refining Breathing Technique's method, blindly groping would have taken at least three to five years to succeed!"
For the unskilled, it's impossible; for the skilled, it's easy!
Sometimes the barrier is fragile, but many don't find the method to break through, remaining outside the door and wasting a lot of time!
After mastering the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, Zhao Yun had a profound understanding of the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method!
He clearly knew.
His breakthrough, reaching the Unity of Inner and Outer level!
All thanks to Ding Ling's guidance, assistance, and direct vigorous Qi to guide him. Otherwise, he couldn't have proceeded smoothly, achieving success as swiftly as bamboo splits.
In the past, the idea wouldn't have even crossed his mind. It was just too exaggerated!
"We can essentially be considered family now."
Ding Ling patted Zhao Yun on the shoulder, laughing:
"Your sudden formality with me makes me feel a bit unaccustomed."
Zhao Yun smiled somewhat bashfully.
"Alright."
Understanding Zhao Yun's character, Ding Ling refrained from being overly polite, saying:
"Now let's go take control of the chaotic army. Later, I'll announce to the world that Wan City seeks a heroic leader. Anyone confident in persuading me is welcome to visit Wan City!"
Zhao Yun's spirit was revived:
"Ding Ling, are you preparing to bring peace and stability to the world?"
"Don't you want to?"
"No."
Zhao Yun was excited:
"I've been anticipating it for a long time."
Common people displaced, hungry, resorting to eating their own children - such occurrences were frequent.
Plagued by epidemics, wars, and bandits, they were arguably the most pitiable people under the sky.
Zhao Yun longed to pacify the world and restore a secure home and nation for the people!
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded, proceeding to the inner courtyard to meet Diao Chan and others before leaving Yuan Mansion to take control of the chaotic army.
Meanwhile.
Upon learning about Zhao Yun's achievement, Diao Chan and the others were extremely envious and admiring.
They resolutely decided to strive harder in cultivating External Refining Breathing Technique! Once mastered, Ding Ling wouldn't hesitate to teach them Taiqing Breathing Technique as well!

sentences.text: It was because of the relentless practice, repeatedly falling and rolling.
Ding Ling's mastery and control of the Lightweight Body Technique were continuously improving!
Half an hour later.
Ding Ling could already maneuver Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill in the air, enhanced by Wall-Climbing Technique and Breathing Technique, preventing a rapid fall.
One hour later.
Ding Ling could wield a sword in the air, land safely, and avoid falling like a clumsy dog.
An hour and a half later.
Ding Ling could descend from high above gracefully, like an Exiled Immortal stepping down as if descending a Celestial Ladder, instead of crashing down directly!
By this point.
It's almost enough.
To progress further.
Unless finding a Lightweight Body Technique at a higher tier than Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill.
But it seems unlikely.
Because Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill are already of a very high level.
Ding Ling would be satisfied to find a technique of the same tier.
Let alone a higher one.
Thinking of body technique.
After finishing his practice, Ding Ling went back to the library in the inner courtyard.
Searching for a Secret Manual.
He spoke to Diao Chan and the others who followed him, with a strange look on their faces:
"I can't use the Great Medicine here anymore.
You all should strive to cultivate the Breathing Technique diligently, and I will help you prepare a medicinal bath.
If you can master External Refining Breathing Technique like Zhao Yun, you can consume the Great Medicine directly, which would be ideal."
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao expressed immense gratitude.
Ding Ling's figure, akin to a Divine Being traversing the void and stepping through the sky, was deeply engraved in their memories, never to be forgotten in this lifetime.
"I want to cultivate Inner Refining Breathing Technique now."
Zhao Yun admitted:
"I discovered that I've reached a very deep level with External Refining Breathing Technique, and it's challenging to make further breakthroughs."
"Sure."
Ding Ling looked Zhao Yun straight in the eye:
"After I help Diao Chan and them with their medicinal bath, I'll assist you in practicing Inner Refining Breathing Technique."
Zhao Yun hesitated:
"Didn't we plan to take control of Wan City's military?"
"No need to rush."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"I'm not trying to conquer the world.
It doesn't matter whether the military size is large or small; as long as it can maintain Wan City's security, it's enough.
However, right now, Wan City's military is too large.
Perhaps with around ten thousand soldiers, even if seventy to eighty thousand left, having ten to twenty thousand should suffice."
Only then did Zhao Yun nod in agreement.
Indeed, Wan City had a vast number of soldiers, many of whom were unarmored and unarmed conscripts forced into service.
Most of these soldiers were upstanding citizens of Wan City.
Clearly.
Yuan Shu had already initiated a flow of uncontrolled military recruitment!
An endless, unrestricted forced conscription.
But Ding Ling couldn't be defeated by sheer numbers.
His victory against the rampant military recruitment was as easy as subduing an Earth Immortal!
A period later.
Ding Ling assisted Da and Xiao Qiao with preparing the medicinal bath, allowing them to practice Breathing Technique in a secluded chamber.
Ding Ling began instructing Zhao Yun in Inner Refining Breathing Technique, specifically Taiqing Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling had mastered the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method to an extremely profound level; his breathing technique was cultivated to the Celestial Being level!
His guidance to Zhao Yun was more than sufficient.
In terms of efficiency, it surpassed Daoist Yhiuu Ji's teachings by about ten or even twenty times!
After all, Ding Ling aimed directly at the core issues, without detours.
While Daoist Yhiuu Ji, lacking an instructor for Taiqing Breathing Technique, had encountered numerous obstacles over time, making his teaching potentially more arduous for Zhao Yun.
Ding Ling was essentially overpowered, having reached full level immediately.
Otherwise, even with great aptitude and Daoist Yhiuu Ji's guidance, countless years of meticulous effort would be necessary to reach the inner Refining Breathing Technique's mastery level!
Thanks to Ding Ling's guidance, it was akin to a direct 'empowerment'!
No unnecessary complexities, hitting the core immediately, repeatedly bringing Zhao Yun to sudden realization!
The efficiency was indisputable.
By the end of the night.
Zhao Yun had already reached entry-level in the cultivation of Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
"I've successfully practiced it!"
Zhao Yun was ecstatic!
He was a person who rarely exhibited emotions, generally unperturbed by calamity and possessing an ice-clear heart!
Yet at this moment, he couldn't hide his joy.
Clearly, his inner emotions had reached a boiling point!
"Yes, you succeeded."
Ding Ling praised sincerely.
He had the advantage.
Zhao Yun, however, had truly achieved success through self-cultivation, even if only at an entry level.
But to achieve the successful Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method!
This was already proof of his extraordinary talent!
Historically, those who achieved the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method were all brilliant geniuses of unparalleled greatness!
"I must thank Ding Ling for your guidance and teaching."
Zhao Yun took a deep breath and solemnly expressed his gratitude:
"Without your guidance, even if I possessed the Inner Refining Breathing Technique's method, blindly groping would have taken at least three to five years to succeed!"
For the unskilled, it's impossible; for the skilled, it's easy!
Sometimes the barrier is fragile, but many don't find the method to break through, remaining outside the door and wasting a lot of time!
After mastering the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, Zhao Yun had a profound understanding of the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method!
He clearly knew.
His breakthrough, reaching the Unity of Inner and Outer level!
All thanks to Ding Ling's guidance, assistance, and direct vigorous Qi to guide him.
Otherwise, he couldn't have proceeded smoothly, achieving success as swiftly as bamboo splits.
In the past, the idea wouldn't have even crossed his mind.
It was just too exaggerated!
"We can essentially be considered family now."
Ding Ling patted Zhao Yun on the shoulder, laughing:
"Your sudden formality with me makes me feel a bit unaccustomed."
Zhao Yun smiled somewhat bashfully.
"Alright."
Understanding Zhao Yun's character, Ding Ling refrained from being overly polite, saying:
"Now let's go take control of the chaotic army.
Later, I'll announce to the world that Wan City seeks a heroic leader.
Anyone confident in persuading me is welcome to visit Wan City!"
Zhao Yun's spirit was revived:
"Ding Ling, are you preparing to bring peace and stability to the world?"
"Don't you want to?"
"No."
Zhao Yun was excited:
"I've been anticipating it for a long time."
Common people displaced, hungry, resorting to eating their own children - such occurrences were frequent.
Plagued by epidemics, wars, and bandits, they were arguably the most pitiable people under the sky.
Zhao Yun longed to pacify the world and restore a secure home and nation for the people!
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded, proceeding to the inner courtyard to meet Diao Chan and others before leaving Yuan Mansion to take control of the chaotic army.
Meanwhile.
Upon learning about Zhao Yun's achievement, Diao Chan and the others were extremely envious and admiring.
They resolutely decided to strive harder in cultivating External Refining Breathing Technique!
Once mastered, Ding Ling wouldn't hesitate to teach them Taiqing Breathing Technique as well!

chapters.title: Chapter 224 224: The Famous General Chen Dao! Ding Ling Is Famous
paragraphs: The process of subduing the rebel troops was simple and easy.
Ding Ling merely appeared and announced that starting today, he would be the City Lord of Wan City, and all the soldiers and residents within the city must follow his arrangements and commands!
Then, many soldiers directly surrendered to him!
And sincerely expressed their willingness to follow Ding Ling!
Many soldiers, especially some players hiding among them, looked at Ding Ling with eyes almost ablaze, filled with jealousy, envy, and admiration.
They mingled in the ranks, secretly deciding:
"We must find a way to latch onto Ding Ling, this guy who has activated cheats! As long as he takes notice, soaring high to the skies will be within reach!"
Thinking of Ding Ling's extraordinary figure last night, descending from the heavens, traversing the void!
Their hearts were burning!
They are already certain that Ding Ling likely discovered the game's BUG.
If they could find a way to get Ding Ling to reveal the secret of the BUG, they would hit it big!
While the thoughts of the natives were relatively pure.
Simply out of awe for strength.
They had long been subdued by Ding Ling.
Together with Ding Ling's magical performance last night, it completely convinced them, elevating their recognition and reverence for Ding Ling to the highest levels!
This led to Ding Ling's commands being responded to with overwhelming surrender today!
Even if there was a small fraction that did not surrender, it didn't affect Ding Ling's conquest of Wan City.
No blood was shed.
In less than half a day.
Wan City was in hand.
Next, Ding Ling organized the twenty thousand troops stationed in Wan City for a phase of integration.
Ten thousand led by Zhao Yun for training and command.
Ten thousand led and commanded by Chen Dao.
Indeed.
The renowned Chen Dao was among the group of Wan City's warriors, and he voluntarily surrendered to Ding Ling.
He even approached Ding Ling directly, honestly confessing everything.
Originally.
Chen Dao was from Runan in Yuzhou.
His former residence was in Runan.
The Yellow Turban Army generals Hex Yi, Liu Pi, and others, attacked his family estate while he was out.
His entire family therefore perished.
Nearly wiped out!
The original of the ancestral techniques:
"Liaoyuan Spear Technique"
"Chen's Breathing Technique"
Were also lost since then.
Upon hearing this.
Ding Ling understood everything.

Earlier he was curious how the Liaoyuan Spear Technique was so fierce and powerful! Not much inferior to the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, and Chen's Breathing Technique was extremely remarkable, deserving of the title Top-Level Breathing Technique! How could Hex Yi, Liu Pi, and such Yellow Turban generals find them?
Now it seems, they must have wiped out Chen Dao's entire family and found them while searching the Chen family estate.

Consider: Chen Dao was a Shu Han general during the Three Kingdoms period, commander of the White Feather Soldiers under Liu Bei, his fame slightly less than Zhao Yun, but not much different in loyalty and combat power.
Of course, this was Ding Ling's speculation, and what is the actual truth?
Ding Ling tested Chen Dao's abilities, a master of the First-class Realm!
Very exceptional.
Know that Chen Dao was still young, just in his teens! With such abilities at this age, the future is limitless.
He can leave his mark on history, which speaks volumes.
Certainly.
What will happen to Chen Dao, Zhao Yun in the future? That's hard to say. After all, the Three Kingdoms history now is entirely different from before.
But what's certain is, following Ding Ling all the way, with Zhao Yun's Breathing Technique now in Unity of Inner and Outer, he will surely soar to the sky, rising to the Nine Heavens!
"I killed Hex Yi and the others, did Chen Dao see me as a benefactor? Coming to repay me?"
Ding Ling watched Chen Dao's back as he led the troops away, pondering:
"Being able to chase to Nanyang Wan City is quite admirable. Truly don't know how he found this place."
Ding Ling shook his head.
You can imagine.
Chen Dao must have run wherever he heard Ding Ling's news to repay the favor.
Later, he must have suffered greatly, realizing he couldn't catch up with Ding Ling, so he ran to Wan City.
After all, the Yuan Family's Wanted Order wasn't withdrawn, posing a huge threat to Ding Ling.

Chen Dao surely intended to join the Yuan Family to repay Ding Ling by other means, but unexpectedly, Ding Ling directly came to Wan City, single-handedly with a horse and a sword, wiping out the Yuan Family.
Ding Ling didn't even give him a chance to repay.
As a result, he straightforwardly abandoned his plan, choosing to pledge allegiance to Ding Ling directly.
Ding Ling asked about it afterward too.

As expected, his conjecture wasn't far off. Just had some discrepancies, but what was certain is, if Ding Ling hadn't come to Wan City, Chen Dao probably would have mingled into the Yuan Family to repay!
He has that capability!
Ding Ling defeated the Yuan Family in one battle.
Once again breaking through Wan City and occupying it with only a few individuals, the feat spread quickly with the pigeon post from spies hidden in Wan City to all directions!
These spies came from various feudal lords and heroes.
Including figures like Liu Biao, Cao Mengde, Yuan Shao, Gongsun Zan!
Wan City being Yuan Shu's headquarters, and the hideout of the Patriarch of the Yuan Family, naturally drew the attention of countless people.
After all, the Yuan Family had four generations of Three Ministers, with retainers spread across the nation.
Families that could rival them were extremely rare!
Such a significant place.
Every action could affect the nation's Fengyun.
How could it not be watched by people?
It's normal for various feudal lords to dispatch spies, plus the players' involvement led to runaway advancements of pigeon post, printing technology, horse shoe technology, and more!
Now the technological development of the Three Kingdoms is like pressing the fast-forward button.
If not for the short time, and being in troubled times, many advanced technologies might develop systematically.
But firearms temporarily can't be manufactured.
Yet some simple things are being mass-produced.
Horse shoes are just one of them.

Of course, one reason firearms haven't been manufactured: still lies in real-world control, given that if firearms run rampant in the game world, and technology leaks, who can assure that no one would risk using game-acquired techniques to build firearms in reality?
Especially extreme groups like powerful pirate gangs.
Who can constrain them?
Besides, various interests entanglements pull on every corner. Without proper negotiation, the game probably would not see rampant firearms proliferation.
Time is too short, and the Three Kingdoms World doesn't have the conditions for a proliferation!
And because development was fast-tracked.
Ding Ling's exploits in Wan City spread at an incredibly rapid speed to the entire Jiuzhou.
Ding Ling.
Has completely caught fire!
[3: You must let your reputation as War God echo throughout the entire Plane World. 59%/100%]
Directly jumped from 29% to 59%.
Nearly several percentage points a day.
The rise is incredibly fast.
Ding Ling looked at this rise, roughly guessing there must be spies in Wan City.
He didn't stop the spread of the events.
And soon after.
Released an announcement.
The announcement was lengthy with hundreds of words.
But the content was simple, roughly meaning:

chapters.title: Chapter 225 225: Liu Bei and Cao Mengde Enter Wan City Together
paragraphs: Ding Ling had no intention of vying for the world, wishing instead to lead everyone in Wan City to pledge allegiance to a powerful leader.
The premise was that the leader must impress Ding Ling!
He had to make Ding Ling believe he could bring peace to the world, stabilize the nation, and improve the people's livelihood!
As soon as this announcement was made.
Jiuzhou was in an uproar!
Countless self-proclaimed ambitious leaders and powerful figures all embarked on the road to Wan City!
They wanted to personally persuade Ding Ling.
Of course, there were also those who sent strategists and generals to Wan City.
They felt that dispatching trusted confidants to visit Wan City from a distance was giving Ding Ling enough respect, and there was no need for a personal visit.
Moreover,
Many rumors about Ding Ling were too outrageous.
Although spies firmly declared that it was absolutely true, some even pledged their lives, stating they would stake their family's fortunes to guarantee its truth.
Nevertheless,
The rumors were so ridiculous!
Their lords maintained a seventy percent skepticism, thirty percent doubt, unwilling to fully believe it.
In their words,
This matter must have Ding Ling stirring up trouble and spreading falsehoods, causing these rumors to run rampant!
How can a normal person become an immortal and pluck stars!
How can he traverse the void, break city gates with a single sword, or withstand a rain of arrows alone!
Only a fool would believe that!
Yuan Shao and a few others were so enraged that they executed the messengers directly!
Such an imposition!
Treating these lords as fools to deceive! Unforgivable!
Even those like Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others preparing to go to Wan City were skeptical.
However, several spies had the exact same tone.
And they even swore on their lives! It was just short of saying that if they lied, all their clans could be beheaded by their lord!
This stirred up immense waves in the hearts of Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and their group, as their loyal subordinates made such guarantees.
They had no reason not to investigate!
If it were true...
"Then I, Cao Mengde (Liu Bei, Liu Biao, Hann Sui, Ma Teng, Sun Jian, Gongsun Zan...), must do everything possible to draw Ding Ling to my side!"
The hearts of Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others burned hot as fire:

"Even if it's not true, it's definitely certain that Ding Ling is surrounded by a group of valiant and formidable warriors! If we can get such a group, our quest to conquer the world will surely be smoother!"
"Moreover, the rumors about Ding Ling are becoming increasingly exaggerated and absurd! But there's one undeniable point: No smoke without fire!"
"Everyone says Ding Ling defeated Lü Bu and others, and even Lü Bu never denied it! So even if it's not true, Ding Ling's combat power being comparable to Lü Bu has some credibility!"
Thinking of Ding Ling, whose combat power rivals Lü Bu,
The flames in the hearts of Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others grew ever stronger!

"In the battle of Hulao Pass, Lü Bu became famous throughout the world, defeating all heroes! If Ding Ling can indeed rival Lü Bu, whoever wins him over stands to gain immensely. With him as a formidable general cutting a path, who would be their match?!"
The eyes of Gongsun Zan, Sun Jian, Hann Sui, and others shone ever brighter!
Each of them became somewhat impatient.
No matter if Ding Ling truly could become immortal, break city gates alone, or seize Wan City!
But regarding the significance of Wan City,
And the significance of Ding Ling's group!
It was enough to make Liu Bei and others fight with all their might!
"Having such a team as Ding Ling's could save us at least five or six years, seven or eight years of struggle!"
Many teams organized by players also galloped furiously towards Wan City:
"With Ding Ling's support, I, Tian Yong (Tuoba Feng...), will surely achieve dominance over the Three Kingdoms, completing the glorious mission of conquering the Three Kingdoms!"
They were among the few players with first-class comprehensive strength!
Except for one person.
All others, without exception, chose the 'Path of the Emperor'.

Only because the difficulty of the Path of the War God chosen by that person was too high, and these people admitted they couldn't complete it. Naturally, they chose the 'Path of the Emperor' for ordinary competitors.
But after choosing the Path of the Emperor, they discovered that this path was also exceptionally difficult, very challenging.
Of course, compared to the personal Path of the War God, the 'Path of the Emperor' could be completed with the help of a team, which was very good news for them.

Unlike the Path of the War God, where one had to fight heaven and earth, becoming a true War God! And all must be completed personally, even if helped, others couldn't replace him to challenge the strongest of the Plane! To challenge powerful figures of the Plane, etc.
For them, who had barely advanced to first-class comprehensive strength after much effort.
It was too unrealistic.

They could reach first-class, and even then only in comprehensive strength, with none of their attributes like strength or agility reaching first-class, and this was only achieved with the expenditure of much family manpower, material resources, and other resources!
From this, they also realized their innate abilities in martial arts, naturally not thinking that another ten years, eight years of effort could let them surpass Lü Bu or Zhao Yun.
Since they couldn't surpass, the War God path was bound to fail, so why choose it?
And most importantly,
"We can confirm that Ding Ling chose the Path of the War God. Otherwise, he wouldn't voluntarily give up vying for the world!"
A few peak players also had eyes burning intensely:
"If we can win Ding Ling over, what are Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, but mere rabble, weaklings, who are no match at all!"
No one knew better than the players how strong Ding Ling was.
Especially as Wan City had an extremely large number of players.
Numerous players who had personally witnessed Ding Ling's otherworldly ascent were deeply impressed.
Moreover, among these players were many spies for top players like Tuoba Feng, Tian Yong, and others who sought to conquer the world!
"That Ding Ling, with invulnerable skin and iron bones, blades cannot injure, arrows cannot penetrate, immense strength, unyielding endurance, and flies across the void with ease. Simply invincible!"

"Truly, I don't know how he trained! No wonder many say Ding Ling was cheating, having discovered the game's bug. I too once suspected Ding Ling might be the same. Otherwise, how could his progress be so fast!"
Players, Cao Mengde, and other 'ambitious leaders' all gradually arrived at Wan City in the days that followed.
They all brought a few followers.
Upon entering Wan City,
When they went to visit Ding Ling, they would encounter each other.
Aside from the surprise,
They understood.
"Liu Bei, I did not expect to meet you here."
Cao Mengde stood seven feet tall, with slender eyes and a long beard, his gaze was intense and commanding, looking at the person beside him.

This person was seven feet five inches tall, with ears hanging down to his shoulders, arms reaching past his knees, a face like jade, and lips like red cinnabar, truly a handsome figure, with two people standing behind him on either side.
The person on the left: eight feet tall, with a leopard head, ringed eyes, swallow jaw, and tiger whiskers, exuding overwhelming Evil Qi, akin to a mortal Asura.
