"Even if it's not true, it's definitely certain that Ding Ling is surrounded by a group of valiant and formidable warriors!
If we can get such a group, our quest to conquer the world will surely be smoother!"
"Moreover, the rumors about Ding Ling are becoming increasingly exaggerated and absurd!
But there's one undeniable point: No smoke without fire!"
"Everyone says Ding Ling defeated Lü Bu and others, and even Lü Bu never denied it!
So even if it's not true, Ding Ling's combat power being comparable to Lü Bu has some credibility!"
Thinking of Ding Ling, whose combat power rivals Lü Bu,
The flames in the hearts of Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others grew ever stronger!
"In the battle of Hulao Pass, Lü Bu became famous throughout the world, defeating all heroes!
If Ding Ling can indeed rival Lü Bu, whoever wins him over stands to gain immensely.
With him as a formidable general cutting a path, who would be their match?!"
The eyes of Gongsun Zan, Sun Jian, Hann Sui, and others shone ever brighter!
Each of them became somewhat impatient.
No matter if Ding Ling truly could become immortal, break city gates alone, or seize Wan City!
But regarding the significance of Wan City,
And the significance of Ding Ling's group!
It was enough to make Liu Bei and others fight with all their might!
"Having such a team as Ding Ling's could save us at least five or six years, seven or eight years of struggle!"
Many teams organized by players also galloped furiously towards Wan City:
"With Ding Ling's support, I, Tian Yong (Tuoba Feng...), will surely achieve dominance over the Three Kingdoms, completing the glorious mission of conquering the Three Kingdoms!"
They were among the few players with first-class comprehensive strength!
Except for one person.
All others, without exception, chose the 'Path of the Emperor'.
Only because the difficulty of the Path of the War God chosen by that person was too high, and these people admitted they couldn't complete it.
Naturally, they chose the 'Path of the Emperor' for ordinary competitors.
But after choosing the Path of the Emperor, they discovered that this path was also exceptionally difficult, very challenging.
Of course, compared to the personal Path of the War God, the 'Path of the Emperor' could be completed with the help of a team, which was very good news for them.
Unlike the Path of the War God, where one had to fight heaven and earth, becoming a true War God!
And all must be completed personally, even if helped, others couldn't replace him to challenge the strongest of the Plane!
To challenge powerful figures of the Plane, etc.
For them, who had barely advanced to first-class comprehensive strength after much effort.
It was too unrealistic.

They could reach first-class, and even then only in comprehensive strength, with none of their attributes like strength or agility reaching first-class, and this was only achieved with the expenditure of much family manpower, material resources, and other resources!
From this, they also realized their innate abilities in martial arts, naturally not thinking that another ten years, eight years of effort could let them surpass Lü Bu or Zhao Yun.
Since they couldn't surpass, the War God path was bound to fail, so why choose it?
And most importantly,
"We can confirm that Ding Ling chose the Path of the War God.
Otherwise, he wouldn't voluntarily give up vying for the world!"
A few peak players also had eyes burning intensely:
"If we can win Ding Ling over, what are Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, but mere rabble, weaklings, who are no match at all!"
No one knew better than the players how strong Ding Ling was.
Especially as Wan City had an extremely large number of players.
Numerous players who had personally witnessed Ding Ling's otherworldly ascent were deeply impressed.
Moreover, among these players were many spies for top players like Tuoba Feng, Tian Yong, and others who sought to conquer the world!
"That Ding Ling, with invulnerable skin and iron bones, blades cannot injure, arrows cannot penetrate, immense strength, unyielding endurance, and flies across the void with ease.
Simply invincible!"
"Truly, I don't know how he trained!
No wonder many say Ding Ling was cheating, having discovered the game's bug.
I too once suspected Ding Ling might be the same.
Otherwise, how could his progress be so fast!"
Players, Cao Mengde, and other 'ambitious leaders' all gradually arrived at Wan City in the days that followed.
They all brought a few followers.
Upon entering Wan City,
When they went to visit Ding Ling, they would encounter each other.
Aside from the surprise,
They understood.
"Liu Bei, I did not expect to meet you here."
Cao Mengde stood seven feet tall, with slender eyes and a long beard, his gaze was intense and commanding, looking at the person beside him.

This person was seven feet five inches tall, with ears hanging down to his shoulders, arms reaching past his knees, a face like jade, and lips like red cinnabar, truly a handsome figure, with two people standing behind him on either side.
The person on the left: eight feet tall, with a leopard head, ringed eyes, swallow jaw, and tiger whiskers, exuding overwhelming Evil Qi, akin to a mortal Asura.

chapters.title: Chapter 226 226: Zhang Fei and Guan Yu (4/16)
paragraphs: On the right, a man stood: nine feet tall, hair two feet long, a face like a red date, with phoenix eyes and silkworm eyebrows. Tall and upright, imposing and awe-inspiring, he squinted slightly, resembling a god overlooking mortals from the heavens.
"Hehe."
The man whose hands reached past his knees was Liu Bei. He smiled slightly:
"If you, Cao Mengde, can come, why can't I, Liu Bei?"
"You, a mere mat-weaver and sandal seller, dare to come here."
Cao Mengde had yet to speak.
A refined man with a feather fan and a gauze scarf glanced at Liu Bei, sneering:
"What makes you think Ding Ling would choose you? What do you have to win over Ding Ling?"
"Hann Sui."
Behind Liu Bei, a round-eyed man was enraged:
"You're asking for death!"
With a shake of his snake spear, he intended to pierce Hann Sui.

From behind Hann Sui emerged a towering eight-foot man, also wielding a heavy iron spear, exuding a presence as formidable as a mountain. As he approached to battle, he emanated a menacing aura as if he had emerged from a sea of blood and corpses!
He shook his iron spear and thrust forward as well.
Clang!
The snake spear and iron spear clashed in mid-air, sending sparks flying. Both the round-eyed man and the towering man trembled slightly from the impact, resulting in a draw.
"Such impressive skill."
Cao Mengde's pupils narrowed slightly, smiling and advising:
"You both are heroic figures, so don't brawl in front of our host's home. If you displease the host here, do you think you'll still have a chance?"
"Humph."
Hann Sui snorted coldly, turning away from Liu Bei:
"I disdain staying with a hypocrite who constantly proclaims himself a descendant of Zhongshan Jing King. I'm going in first."
He and the towering man, along with several other mighty warriors, stepped into the Yuan Mansion, which was now renamed 'Ding Mansion'!
The characters on the Ding Mansion plaque were personally carved by Ding Ling, imbued with grand and majestic strokes, clearly the work of a master.
Cao Mengde and his group had once marveled at this.
Of course, now, due to this conflict, everyone's thoughts were mixed.
But it was certain that Liu Bei felt particularly depressed and unhappy. Turning, he instructed the round-eyed man:
"Third brother, you must stay calm. Once we enter Ding Mansion, do not resort to violence! Anger Ding Ling, and wasn't our long journey here for nothing?"
The round-eyed man protested:

"Big brother, many say Ding Ling can break city gates with one sword, travel like a flying immortal, traverse the void, and fight a nation alone! Don't you think this is exaggerated? In my opinion, Ding Ling is someone who basks in vanity and fame, not worth the effort to visit!
He looked at the nine-foot man with a face like a red date:
"Second brother, don't you agree?"
"This..."
The nine-foot man pondered for a moment, nodding:

"Indeed, the rumors are greatly exaggerated. Lü Bu is already considered top-tier martial prowess. But according to the populace, Ding Ling could crush ten, even a hundred Lü Bus. So, if third brother and I joined forces, shouldn't we stand a chance against him? Big brother, do you think it's possible?"
Liu Bei was uncertain.
Beside him, Cao Mengde seemed to overhear their conversation, approaching Liu Bei with a smile:
"To find out the truth, why not let Guan Yu and Zhang Fei try it out?"
He spoke with a face full of admiration:

"Guan Yu wows the world with a single battle. Zhang Fei's roar echoes through Jiuzhou. Your two virtuous brothers are unparalleled in bravery, rarely matched in the world. If they can defeat Ding Ling together, it proves he's just a pretentious figure, not to be feared. But if Ding Ling easily defeats Zhang Fei and Guan Yu, then..."
"Impossible?!"
Before Cao Mengde could finish speaking.
The round-eyed man, Zhang Fei, roared, like thunder exploding, making Cao Mengde's ears buzz.
He glanced at Zhang Fei with twitching eyebrows.
Zhang Fei exclaimed:
"I can fight Lü Bu for a hundred rounds. Lü Bu is known as the Flying General, the world's greatest! Even if Ding Ling can rival Lü Bu, how could he easily defeat second brother and me together?"
"I was just speaking casually."
Cao Mengde gave an awkward smile:
"Don't take it so seriously."
"Humph."
Zhang Fei clenched his fists, full of battle intent:
"I'll test Ding Ling later to see how strong he truly is!"
"Third brother."
Liu Bei was a bit anxious:
"We're here to visit Ding Ling, hoping for his recognition, not to challenge him."
Zhang Fei shook his head, disagreeing:
"Big brother, we're visiting a divine being! If he's truly as capable as the people say, he shouldn't bother with trifles! Just sparring a bit; he shouldn't refuse.
If he's always evasive, it proves he's merely boastful. Why should we spend so much effort and time visiting someone like that?"
Cao Mengde clapped and praised:
"Zhang Fei is right. A test will reveal everything. Just a little competition, and we'll see the truth."
Liu Bei coldly looked at Cao Mengde:
"Then why don't you dispatch Dian Wei and Xiahou Dun?"
Behind Cao Mengde stood two imposing figures.
One was burly and strong, holding a long spear, exuding authority without anger.
The other was over nine feet tall, nearly a yard in height, with a tiger's back and a bear's waist, his face fierce and ugly, holding dual halberds, evoking the presence of an ancient beast.
They were Xiahou Dun and Dian Wei!
Cao Mengde kept inciting Zhang Fei to fight Ding Ling but didn't mention dispatching Dian Wei and Xiahou Dun. His intentions were clear.
The reason was obvious.
Liu Bei was naturally furious, almost pointing at Cao Mengde and calling him shameless.
"Though Xiahou Dun and Dian Wei are brave, they're no match for Zhang Fei and Guan Yu."
Cao Mengde's eyes shone brightly as he gazed at Guan Yu and Zhang Fei:
"You two shook the world at Hulao Pass. You're super-elite experts. If you fight Ding Ling, observers will have a good measure."
"Indeed."
Zhang Fei, invigorated, exclaimed loudly:
"Can't wait to test Ding Ling's mettle."
Liu Bei, infuriated, gestured to Zhang Fei to no avail.
Growing more apprehensive and spiteful towards Cao Mengde, he couldn't resist his dissatisfaction.
Cao Mengde ignored Liu Bei's gaze and expressions.
On the way, he continuously incited Zhang Fei and Guan Yu.
Guan Yu, steady and proud, didn't speak much, but clearly enjoyed the flattery from power figures like Cao Mengde. Hearing his words, his stern face gradually relaxed.
Zhang Fei was visibly eager and excited.
Seeing this, Liu Bei wished to distance himself from Cao Mengde.
But Cao Mengde closely followed them, conversing endlessly with Zhang Fei and Guan Yu.
Dian Wei and Xiahou Dun remained silent, just curiously and cautiously observing the surroundings of Ding Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 227 227: Shameless Thief Cao! Brazen Liu Xuande
paragraphs: Ding Mansion was transformed from the Yuan Mansion.
After Ding Ling's grand and sweeping reforms.
Many unnecessary decorations and items were given to the nearby poor, or directly to the soldiers to win hearts and minds.
Ding Ling was already highly regarded, feared by all.
With these actions, he was even more loved and respected by everyone!
Now, just with a single command from Ding Ling, they would dare to rush forward through any danger.
Regarding worldly possessions.
Ding Ling didn't value them.
Thus, he was very generous with silver and such.

The reason he didn't care was because Ding Ling didn't need much. After all, these things couldn't be taken back to the real world, and in this Three Kingdoms World, he already stood at the pinnacle; anything he sought, he could attain.
A mere some silver was naturally insignificant to him.
Thus, he scattered silver with great generosity and flair.
A large amount of silver left by the direct descendants of the Yuan Family, half was directly given to Zhao Yun and Chen Dao as military funds.
Thirty percent was given to Diao Chan and a few others to hold for future use.
Ten percent was distributed among soldiers and civilians.
Ten percent was kept for current use.

Precisely because he was willing to use silver, though Ding Mansion no longer had so many cumbersome decorations and appeared much simpler and spacious, it also looked increasingly magnificent and grand.
Moreover, when guests came to Ding Mansion, the hospitality they received was first-class.
Medicinal cuisine, gourmet food, fine wine—all were available.
After Dian Wei and his group sat in the hall and saw such a scene, having tasted some delicacies and wine, they couldn't help but feel a growing fondness for Ding Ling.
At the very least, Ding Ling did not neglect anyone!
"I wonder where Ding Ling is?"
Zhang Fei ate some wine, grew more agitated, and loudly said to the hosting Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and others:
"I want to see him now!"
Swish, swish!
Cao Mengde, Sun Jian, Hann Sui, and Gongsun Zan all turned to look at Diao Chan and the others.
The player representatives like Tian Yong and Tuoba Feng did the same.
Their envy, jealousy, and resentment for Ding Ling reached a peak upon seeing Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng!
The grand Diao Chan! The enchanting Du Qingcheng!
Had been used as receptionists!
Too extravagant!
If it were them, they'd surely hide them in the palace for their own pleasure.

Yet thinking of Ding Ling's combat power, the players dared not be insolent, knowing that angering Ding Ling could mean their trip would be in vain, perhaps even leading to their death at Ding Ling's hands. So, even though they deeply wished to see Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng, they dared not make it overtly known.
Gongsun Zan and a few others, however, felt tempted, seeing Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's figures and brows, wanting to take a closer look.
Cao Mengde was the master of restraint among them.
But he kept urging others to be the vanguard.
Even now, he was quietly assisting Zhang Fei.
"Quiet down, everyone."
Diao Chan listened to the clamor, slightly furrowing her elegant brows:
"My master has said that wanting to see him requires a seven-day wait. After seven days, we can discuss further."
"Still seven days?!"
Zhang Fei's eyes widened:
"Why do so many of us have to wait for Ding Ling alone?!"
"You don't have to wait."
Diao Chan replied indifferently.
Her voice was soft yet had a firm iron-blooded edge; clearly a heroine from the battlefield!
"If we don't wait, then..."
Zhang Fei, having drunk too much, began to act up but was silenced by Liu Bei, who covered his mouth.
Liu Bei turned slightly, apologizing to Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng with an awkward smile:
"Sorry, the two of you, my third brother is like this, drunk and heedless, saying things not meant. Please don't mind him."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were indifferent, with a detached gaze.
Liu Bei's heart skipped a beat. While forcing Zhang Fei back to his seat, he immediately showed solemn sincerity:
"Ding Ling is a rare hero and outstanding figure. To gain his approval, waiting for seven days, seven months, even seven years is no problem!"
His face was full of sincerity, with eyes extremely earnest:

"For Ding Ling, I am willing to sit here patiently. I, Liu Bei, swear by the heavens that there is absolutely no falsity in my heart! I hope you two ladies will not hold any grudge against us three brothers. Speak some true words before Ding Ling. Liu Bei will be endlessly grateful!"
While speaking, he even slightly bowed to Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were surprised and returned a bow.
The heroes and figures present exchanged looks of disbelief.
This Liu Bei, just how shameless and undignified can he be!
For competition.
Utterly without limits.
To talk about waiting for seven years, and even claim the heaven bears witness to his sincerity without a shred of falsehood?
I scoff!
Many silently cursed in their hearts.
Disdainful of Liu Bei.
However, some like Cao Mengde were wary and admiring of Liu Bei.
Those who can lower their face and let go of dignity are destined to achieve great things!
Liu Bei's ability to bend and endure is worthy of respect!
Reflecting on this.
Cao Mengde immediately declared:

"I am Cao Cao Cao Mengde, and I request you two ladies absolutely pass on to Ding Ling that I have come with utmost sincerity and genuine heart. As long as Ding Ling is willing to recognize me, going without food for three days is of no concern. A mere seven days is trivial!"
The Thief Cao is truly a brother in shamelessness to Liu Bei!
The player representatives like Tuoba Feng, Tian Yong, hearing this, were amazed but quickly arose and solemnly stated:
"Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng. We also have major affairs to discuss with Ding Ling this time."
They took out the prepared letters and quickly approached Diao Chan:
"I kindly request you two pass them to Ding Ling. Once he reads them, he will understand."
Diao Chan frowned and did not accept the letters, simply saying:
"Discuss what you must after seven days. Those who cannot wait may leave first."
Tuoba Feng and Tian Yong were speechless, only able to retreat awkwardly to their seats and continue drinking.
They hadn't expected Ding Ling to be so pretentious!
What, did he think himself Zhuge Liang?
Demanding three visits to the humble abode?
Internally, Tuoba Feng and Tian Yong cursed him without end.
But thinking of Ding Ling's skills and capabilities, they could only suppress their displeasure and continue conversing with Cao Mengde and others.
Ding Mansion was vast.
No problem at all accommodating people like Cao Mengde.
With Zhao Yun overseeing with soldiers, no one dared make trouble within Ding Mansion or Wan City.
And seeing Zhao Yun's dignified presence, Liu Bei, Cao Mengde, Hann Sui, Sun Jian all admired, secretly overjoyed:
"To gain Ding Ling's approval means gaining the allegiance of people like Zhao Yun—for this trade, it's absolutely worth it."
The strength of Zhao Yun.
No need to test to know.

Because Zhao Yun recently achieved Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method, in its initial phase, the proficiency and control over his breath hadn't yet reached perfection, with occasional leaks of remarkable vigor.
These leaked breaths surged and roared like a true dragon singing, captivating those around!

"Sorry, the two of you, my third brother is like this, drunk and heedless, saying things not meant.
Please don't mind him."
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were indifferent, with a detached gaze.
Liu Bei's heart skipped a beat.
While forcing Zhang Fei back to his seat, he immediately showed solemn sincerity:
"Ding Ling is a rare hero and outstanding figure.
To gain his approval, waiting for seven days, seven months, even seven years is no problem!"
His face was full of sincerity, with eyes extremely earnest:
"For Ding Ling, I am willing to sit here patiently.
I, Liu Bei, swear by the heavens that there is absolutely no falsity in my heart!
I hope you two ladies will not hold any grudge against us three brothers.
Speak some true words before Ding Ling.
Liu Bei will be endlessly grateful!"
While speaking, he even slightly bowed to Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were surprised and returned a bow.
The heroes and figures present exchanged looks of disbelief.
This Liu Bei, just how shameless and undignified can he be!
For competition.
Utterly without limits.
To talk about waiting for seven years, and even claim the heaven bears witness to his sincerity without a shred of falsehood?
I scoff!
Many silently cursed in their hearts.
Disdainful of Liu Bei.
However, some like Cao Mengde were wary and admiring of Liu Bei.
Those who can lower their face and let go of dignity are destined to achieve great things!
Liu Bei's ability to bend and endure is worthy of respect!
Reflecting on this.
Cao Mengde immediately declared:
"I am Cao Cao Cao Mengde, and I request you two ladies absolutely pass on to Ding Ling that I have come with utmost sincerity and genuine heart.
As long as Ding Ling is willing to recognize me, going without food for three days is of no concern.
A mere seven days is trivial!"
The Thief Cao is truly a brother in shamelessness to Liu Bei!
The player representatives like Tuoba Feng, Tian Yong, hearing this, were amazed but quickly arose and solemnly stated:
"Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng.
We also have major affairs to discuss with Ding Ling this time."
They took out the prepared letters and quickly approached Diao Chan:
"I kindly request you two pass them to Ding Ling.
Once he reads them, he will understand."
Diao Chan frowned and did not accept the letters, simply saying:
"Discuss what you must after seven days.
Those who cannot wait may leave first."
Tuoba Feng and Tian Yong were speechless, only able to retreat awkwardly to their seats and continue drinking.
They hadn't expected Ding Ling to be so pretentious!
What, did he think himself Zhuge Liang?
Demanding three visits to the humble abode?
Internally, Tuoba Feng and Tian Yong cursed him without end.
But thinking of Ding Ling's skills and capabilities, they could only suppress their displeasure and continue conversing with Cao Mengde and others.
Ding Mansion was vast.
No problem at all accommodating people like Cao Mengde.
With Zhao Yun overseeing with soldiers, no one dared make trouble within Ding Mansion or Wan City.
And seeing Zhao Yun's dignified presence, Liu Bei, Cao Mengde, Hann Sui, Sun Jian all admired, secretly overjoyed:
"To gain Ding Ling's approval means gaining the allegiance of people like Zhao Yun—for this trade, it's absolutely worth it."
The strength of Zhao Yun.
No need to test to know.

Because Zhao Yun recently achieved Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method, in its initial phase, the proficiency and control over his breath hadn't yet reached perfection, with occasional leaks of remarkable vigor.
These leaked breaths surged and roared like a true dragon singing, captivating those around!

chapters.title: Chapter 228 228: Sunx Jian and Ma Teng's Speculations
paragraphs: Anyone with a bit of discernment who sees Zhao Yun in his gleaming silver armor will instantly like him. Not to mention that Zhao Yun's presence is extraordinarily exceptional, making him look like a Super-Elite Expert.
Indeed.
After achieving Unity of Inner and Outer.
During this period, Zhao Yun has been consuming Great Medicine.
And has not taken any medicinal baths.
With ample Great Medicine, his progress can be described as rapid.
In just a short time.
He has already traveled a long distance in the realm of the Super-Elite.
Such natural talent and aptitude.
Even Ding Ling greatly admires him.

Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao, upon witnessing this, are greatly inspired, diligently training day by day. Not understanding something, they consult Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, coupled with daily medicinal baths, their pace of progress is also quite remarkable!
It can be foreseen.
Perhaps in less than a year.
Diao Chan and the others will make a leap in progress!

After all, whether it is Ding Ling or Zhao Yun, now with Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method, guiding the practice of External Refining Breathing Technique is simply no problem! They can straight to the point, swiftly highlighting everything, allowing Diao Chan and the others to quickly understand the essence of things, and thereby achieve breakthrough progress!
Some things are just like that, understanding them leads to rapid progress, not understanding them makes effort vain.
Just like climbing a mountain.
Once understood, climbing higher will eventually reach the peak;
Not understood, no matter how much you walk sideways, efforts throughout life are in vain.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun's guidance to Diao Chan and others serves as a 'beacon', preventing them from losing direction on their path forward.
Moreover, with the assistance of Great Medicine, it is as though someone is helping them climb the mountain, the efficiency and results are imaginable!
The increasingly substantial aura emanating from them is evident.
Cao Mengde and his group stayed at Ding Mansion for three days.
Without seeing Ding Ling himself.
Out of boredom.
They planned to take a look around Wan City, incidentally mingling with the common people, to see what they truly think of Ding Ling.
They seemed to understand each other's thoughts without speaking.
Shortly after Cao Mengde left.
Liu Bei, Hann Sui, and others also went out.
But without exception.
After half a day.
They all returned to Ding Mansion with expressions of amazement, confusion, and bewilderment.
Within Cao Mengde's heart, there seemed to be a rolling tide:

"Every common person, even three-year-old children, idolize Ding Ling, claiming he's an Immortal descended from the heavens. This, this, this... incredible. Ding Ling's control and authority over Wan City have reached such a level? Or are the people's words indeed true? But is it possible for Immortals to exist in this world?"
Cao Mengde was somewhat skeptical.
Even during the Yellow Turban Rebellion, Zhang Jiao, although able to summon wind and rain, thunder and lightning, was essentially just an ordinary person, simply far more formidable than usual.
Yet in the mouths of commoners.
Ding Ling can do anything, knows everything, excels in all things, impervious to blades, unaffected by swords, flying, and earth escaping as if they were trivial.
This was indeed fantastic!
"This... Quite likely it's a case of Three Men Make a Tiger, just rumors spreading."
Cao Mengde exchanged a glance with Liu Bei.
Clearly seeing the confusion, enlightenment, and realization in each other's eyes.
Obviously.
At this moment, Liu Bei had the same idea as Cao Mengde.
Convinced that such Celestial Beings could not possibly exist in the world!
But Ma Teng and Sunx Jian recalled old family records about the Celestial Human Realm, pondering:
"Did Ding Ling break through to the Celestial Human Realm? But it seems the Celestial Human Realm shouldn't be that terrifying, should it?!"
They were puzzled and bewildered.

Little did they know Ding Ling had broken into the Celestial Human Realm in all four dimensions, while ordinary people breaking into even one attribute of the Celestial Human Realm was already remarkable, worthy of being called a Land God or Celestial Sage!
And their ancient records usually described someone breaking into one attribute of the Celestial as a genius.
"Cex, you've interacted with Ding Ling. Do you think he's as exaggerated as the people claim?"
Sunx Jian looked at Sunx Ce, asking.
With the Yuan Family's downfall.
Yuan Shu fled.
Sunx Jian decisively chose to break away from the Yuan Family and started his own business.
Thanks to players' reminders and assistance.
He also narrowly escaped a life-and-death calamity, now living well, with Sunx Family naturally still under his control, leading the team to recruit people was by his command.
Sunx Ce followed the expedition partly to broaden his horizons, partly to meet Ding Ling again.
At this moment, hearing Sunx Jian's words, Sunx Ce spoke instinctively:
"Not that exaggerated. But undeniably, Ding Ling's Combat Power is extremely terrifying. I am far inferior!"
"Hmm."
Sunx Jian had an idea.
After all, Sunx Ce had reported this matter to him many times.
If he hadn't known Ding Ling was worth recruiting, he wouldn't have ostentatiously brought Sunx Ce and others to Wan City.
"Since you know Ding Ling, could you try to connect with him in a few days, convincing him to actively join us?"
"This...
Sunx Ce was speechless:
"I've only met him a few times, and it's been one-sidedly crushed. Why would he pay attention to me? I better not be so tactless. You should be the one to speak, father."
"So many people are competing to recruit him."
Sunx Jian, tall and broad, possessing authority, now appeared deeply troubled:
"I'm afraid it will be hard to outcompete them. Especially Cao Mengde and Liu Xuande, those two are shameless! They're experts at flattery! I can't do that."
He looked at Sunx Ce.
Sunx Ce quickly shook his head:
"I can't do it either!"
Character is innate.
Being fierce and brave, asking them to do what Liu Bei does, being 'servile and deferential,' would be worse than killing them outright.
"We have to think of a way?"
Sunx Jian was troubled.
"I see Ding Ling often travels with several beauties. It seems he likes beauties. Perhaps you could consider gifting him a beauty."
Sunx Ce suggested.
Sunx Jian was speechless:

"In this brief period, where can I find a beauty comparable to Da and Xiao Qiao, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng of such national exquisite beauty?! Besides, even if I find one, I might not be willing to send her away."
He sighed.
Sunx Ce was stunned:
"Father. You..."
"Hehe."
Sunx Jian chuckled lightly:

"Heroes often succumb to beauties; you haven't found someone you fancy yet, but when you do, you certainly wouldn't say such a thing. I've experienced it, so I'll honestly say that I might not be willing to send them away!"
Sunx Ce pursed his lips, obviously disbelieving he would fall into a sea of love.
"But now, I'm not like before."
Sunx Jian revealed determination:
"If there truly is a suitable beauty, for the sake of the future, for the chance to recruit Ding Ling, I would certainly send her now. Just finding a suitable one is tough."
"If not sending a beauty, consider gifting something else..."
Every warlord was racking their brains, contemplating how they could earn Ding Ling's approval, completely convince Ding Ling, and have Ding Ling lead Wan City's forces to join them.
During these days.
Any warlord carefully observing or wandering around Wan City.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 229: The Warlords' Gifts
paragraphs: All were captivated by Zhao Yun and Chen Dao's unparalleled demeanor.
Moreover, the territory of Wan City is extremely important, and if it can be taken, it will have an indispensable important role in establishing dominance in the future.
Whether it's for the heroic figures under Ding Ling's command, or for this piece of land, or for Ding Ling himself, whose martial prowess can rival Lü Bu and even surpass him.
They all have reasons to find ways to persuade and move Ding Ling!
Time passed in a flash.
In the blink of an eye, it was almost the appointed time.
The closer they got to the time point.
The more restless their hearts became.
Cao Mengde even took out his swords, the Heaven-Swaying Sword and the Cyan Gang Sword, intending to offer them to Ding Ling.
As a highly skilled swordsman, he is certainly enamored with divine swords!
Hann Sui prepared a prized steed.

Ma Teng chose marriage alliance, his daughter Ma Yunlu is charmingly beautiful, standing tall and graceful, although not as alluring as Du Qingcheng, yet possessing Diao Chan's heroic spirit, extremely radiant and beautiful.
Gongsun Zan chose to send a group of white horses.
Sun Jian offered a hard-earned top divine skill secret manual.
All lords have made preparations, evidently aiming to win Ding Ling's favor during their first meeting.
Liu Bei, however, is empty-handed, troubled and extremely distressed, not eating or thinking.
Seeing this, Zhang Fei murmured:
"Big brother, you don't need to be like this at all. With me and second brother here, we are more than enough for Ding Ling. Besides, Ding Ling's abilities are mostly exaggerated, not true skills."
"You can't say that."
Liu Bei sighed:
"Being able to conquer the Yuan Family's residence is an earth-shattering skill. Can just a few of us take it down?"
These days Liu Bei has come to understand.
No matter if Ding Ling's divine skill prowess is merely hearsay!
But it can be confirmed that Ding Ling indeed conquered Wan City, indeed drove away the Yuan Family, and even killed the Yuan Family patriarch.
Just these few points.
Are enough to prove Ding Ling's extraordinary courage and prowess!
To have someone of his caliber loyal and allied is almost equivalent to increasing the probability significantly of resolving situations if encountering a daunting city like Wan City.
Such an astonishing opportunity.
Which lord can refuse?
Liu Bei cannot refuse either.
So these days he is 'worried his head white', just because he is 'plain and impoverished', compared to other affluent lords, he can only be described as extremely destitute!
"Hmph!"
Zhang Fei sneered in disagreement, snorted:

"I know for sure Chen Dao views Ding Ling as a benefactor. And Chen Dao was previously a not-so-small officer in Wan City. If he cooperates with Ding Ling, the chance of opening the city gates at the right time is very high.

Ding Ling can defeat the Yuan Family patriarch because, apart from Yuan Family's arrogance, most likely due to many like Chen Dao assisting Ding Ling. Ding Ling can only achieve such a perfect result!
However, now Ding Ling takes all the credit for himself.
It's rather shameless."
He clenched his fist, his eyes flashing with brilliance:
"Such a person, I must expose his true face. I want to challenge him! To see if he is really as the Wan City people say, like a god or a demon!"
He looked at Guan Yu:
"Second brother, you have to support me."
Guan Yu nodded instinctively; frankly, these days, all one hears outside are various news about Ding Ling, which makes Guan Yu quite uneasy.
To know that their trek through Hulao Pass shocked the world.
Yet in the eyes of Wan City people.
They seem just like mortals, not worthy to be compared with 'celestial god' like Ding Ling!
This is unbearable for the proud-hearted Guan Yu!
"Second brother, third brother. Calm down."
Liu Bei's head ached:
"We are here to invite him to help us, not to fight him."
"Big brother."
Guan Yu squinted, stroking his beard, speaking gently:

"Ding Ling has already been mythologized by Wan City's people, and even beautified by countless people across Jiuzhou! As martial artists, we should know very well that no one, even breaking celestial human realm, can be so powerful! Besides, how many years has it been? Has anyone broken celestial human realm?
I've only seen snippets associated with celestial beings in ancient texts. But even fragmented tales of celestial human realm, are there such absurd depictions?
No!
So, I suspect Ding Ling is beautifying himself! Even if you recruit him, do you think Big brother can manage him?
If he usurps our position, what will you do then? Confront him? Fight him?"
Liu Bei's expression changed slightly, somewhat unnaturally.
"You'll know if he has true skills by testing."
Guan Yu said solemnly:
"If his reality corresponds closely to the rumors, then Big brother can fully strive to win him over."
"Just afraid he may misunderstand us, ignore me then."
Liu Bei sighed.
"A hero esteems a hero and values heroes.
Guan Yu said proudly:

"We three brothers are heroes. If Ding Ling has insight, a broad outlook, and magnanimity, he won't mind our challenge; instead, seeing us display high martial prowess might respect us, thus choosing us."
"Really?"
Liu Bei hesitated.
"Big brother, follow second brother's advice, it's definitely right."
Zhang Fei was itching with excitement, his face alight, tightly gripping his spear:
"I've been waiting eagerly to test Ding Ling's level."
Both Guan Yu and Zhang Fei advocated testing.
Liu Bei had no recourse but to agree.
This day.
The seven days were up.
The lords gathered once more.
Diao Chan appeared, addressing them:
"Everyone, my lord will appear shortly. Please dine first."
Cao Mengde, Ma Teng, and others collectively sighed in relief, truly fearing Ding Ling might make them wait another seven days, which would be endless, unbearable!
Impossible to truly wait the seven months as Liu Bei suggested?!
Tian Yong, Tuoba Feng, and other players also eased their minds.
They truly feared Ding Ling would act grandly.
Like Zhuge Liang; requiring visiting thrice before meeting.
That would be too much bother!
Luckily, Ding Ling didn't play such empty moves.
During these seven days.
Ding Ling returned to the real world to experiment.
To his disappointment.
Although agility and physique increased considerably.
But not as exaggerated as in the Three Kingdoms World!
Just similar to a normal growth level.
Ding Ling tried multiple times afterward, finally forced to confirm a fact:
The Three Kingdoms World differs from the real world!
To achieve immortality and invincible defense in the real world, there's still a long road ahead.

"I've been waiting eagerly to test Ding Ling's level."
Both Guan Yu and Zhang Fei advocated testing.
Liu Bei had no recourse but to agree.
This day.
The seven days were up.
The lords gathered once more.
Diao Chan appeared, addressing them:
"Everyone, my lord will appear shortly.
Please dine first."
Cao Mengde, Ma Teng, and others collectively sighed in relief, truly fearing Ding Ling might make them wait another seven days, which would be endless, unbearable!
Impossible to truly wait the seven months as Liu Bei suggested?!
Tian Yong, Tuoba Feng, and other players also eased their minds.
They truly feared Ding Ling would act grandly.
Like Zhuge Liang; requiring visiting thrice before meeting.
That would be too much bother!
Luckily, Ding Ling didn't play such empty moves.
During these seven days.
Ding Ling returned to the real world to experiment.
To his disappointment.
Although agility and physique increased considerably.
But not as exaggerated as in the Three Kingdoms World!
Just similar to a normal growth level.
Ding Ling tried multiple times afterward, finally forced to confirm a fact:
The Three Kingdoms World differs from the real world!
To achieve immortality and invincible defense in the real world, there's still a long road ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 230: Three Supreme Skills of the Human Emperor
paragraphs: In response to this.
Although Ding Ling felt slightly disappointed, he accepted it anyway.
The good thing is, through the exchange of the Achievement Medal.
Ding Ling's strength continued to grow steadily.
As long as he keeps getting stronger.
Ding Ling is confident that in the future he will certainly reach a level comparable to a Land God like the Three Kingdoms World.
So...
War God Mission.
Must end as soon as possible.
Obtain the Glory Medal, enhance his physique, and so on.
This will make it easier for him to go to the next world.
Ding Ling currently has no clue about how to get to the next world.
Because the Game World provides no hints.
He speculates.
Only by completing the War God Mission might he get guidance!
This is like a road; until you reach the end, you won't see the sign.
Of course, this is just speculation, the facts remain to be verified.
Upon returning to the Game World.
Ding Ling began to guide Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng.
He has already reached the peak in this world!
Guiding everyone in martial arts, like a deity overseeing mortals, effortless and easy!
With such a 'full level' Master guiding them.
Plus various Great Medicines aiding them without regards to cost.
Da and Xiao Qiao's power increased rapidly, Zhao Yun even more so, as he successfully integrated Inner and Outer Breathing Technique, and his rare physique makes him a world-class talent!
With Ding Ling's guidance, the Great Medicine can be chewed directly, naturally soaring to great heights! Rapid progress, extraordinary speed, beyond outsiders' comprehension!
Besides guiding everyone.
Ding Ling focused on reading books, reading Secret Manuals.
During this period.
The Secret Manuals from Yuan Family Treasury had been almost completely read by him.
The Secret Manuals varied.
Geography, Zither Skill, Calligraphy, Chess Skills, and other related skill books were all at full level, further enhancing his strength.
Of course, his four-dimensional attributes had already reached the top, no longer moving.
Just after reading a lot of Military Strategy Manuals and Governing Secret Manuals.
Wisdom increased by 0.2.
Now his wisdom is 2.3!
The difficulty of increasing wisdom is evident!
Ding Ling sighed, it seems he won't have the hope of becoming someone as smart as Zhuge Liang in the Three Kingdoms World!
He sees this.
With an open mind.
It's okay not to compare with prodigies.
After all, he never planned to play dominion, nor to outwit smart people; he is a Martial Artist, a commoner, a War General, he chooses to use his fists, blades, and combat power to push through all!
As long as he is strong enough, even an emperor can be dethroned, can smart people, no matter how eloquent, cunning, or deceitful, beat his fists?
Just like now.
He stands at the pinnacle of the mortal world!
He is the strongest, who dares plot against him? Whoever does should be ready to be killed by his fist or slashed by his sword!
"This feeling is really exhilarating!"
Ding Ling felt delighted.
At this stage.
He is the law.
He is heaven!

"No wonder the old saying goes: 'The knight uses martial arts to violate prohibition.' Indeed, with a weapon in hand, murderous intent arises! At my level, as someone who grew up in peaceful times, I am still filled with passionate blood, feeling lawless. Those maniacs at my level, needless to say."
Ding Ling began to admire Nanhua Old Immortal, such a Celestial Human Realm powerhouse.
To be able to restrain inner desires while standing at the peak of the mortal world.
Living in seclusion in the deep mountains, not concerning oneself with worldly affairs.
This is extremely commendable.
Because possessing such powerful strength, Ding Ling felt an irrepressible sense of expansion!
This is despite having Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, and other techniques constantly balancing his aura and dispelling Evil Qi, helping Ding Ling nurture body and mind.
Otherwise, Ding Ling could fall into madness.
"One must have principles."
Ding Ling warned himself:
"Besides, I'm not strong enough yet. I need to continue working hard."
Ding Ling thought of Game World's other planes beside the Historical Plane, including the Wuxia and Xianxia planes!
Therefore?
How can he slack off?
"Not truly standing at the pinnacle of the mortal world, one must never be complacent, arrogant! Must stay grounded, courageous, and diligent!"
Ding Ling thought this way.
And acted this way.
These days.
He was continuously practicing techniques like Qingnang Scripture to nurture his body and mind, making himself increasingly peaceful and upright!
Meanwhile.
Upon confirming his mindset was restored.
He began reading the Secret Manuals on Martial Arts.
Among these Secret Manuals.
Ding Ling saw three familiar manuals:
"Confucian Breathing Technique"
"Ghost Prison Spear Technique"
"Calm Wind Swordsmanship"
These three manuals were acquired earlier from Yan Liang and Wen Chou.
At that time, he guessed that the Yuan Family proactively provided them to Yan Liang and Wen Chou; there must be copies in the family! Or originals!
Now it seems he was right.
What the Yuan Family gave to Yan Liang and Wen Chou were copies. What remained in the family are the original Secret Manuals!
Ding Ling set these three manuals aside.
Looked at other Secret Manuals.
The first one:
"Human Emperor Fist"!
Quickly scanning through, closed his eyes.
A new book appeared on a library shelf, clearly Human Emperor Fist.
In an instant.
[Human Emperor Fist Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0]
[Physique +0]
The essence of Human Emperor Fist transformed into instinct like light and electricity and entered every part of his body.
In just a moment, Ding Ling had completely mastered this high-tier fist technique!
A mild warmth began to ripple through his body.
But it soon vanished without a trace.
Seemingly transformed into profoundness and integrated into Ding Ling's body.
Ding Ling felt his body seemed lighter, his control over power seemed slightly improved.

"It seems that although fully leveled high-tier martial arts can't further increase the four-dimensional attributes, they can transform into a foundation, solidifying my base! Not only that, with more fully leveled high-tier martial arts, I believe my control over power and other things will become more natural, eventually reaching a Transformation Realm like a deity."
Ding Ling was hopeful.
He picked up the second Secret Manual.
"Human Emperor Palm Technique"!
Soon finished reading.
A new book appeared on the library shelf.
In the blink of an eye.
[Human Emperor Palm Technique Full Level]
"All are Human Emperor Secret Manuals, Ultimate Skills!"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows:
"It seems the Yuan Family had long ago successfully swapped all the core martial arts from the Royal Armory!"
This truly severed the Great Han Dynasty Liu Family's foundation!
Without the backing of royal martial arts, the Liu Family's descendants.
It is conceivable; their combat power would be significantly reduced, making it hard to command powerful ministers, not easy at all?
The third Secret Manual:
"Human Emperor Spear Technique"!
Instantly leveled up again.
Ding Ling's foundation further increased.
His control over power subtly improved yet again.
Boom!
Ding Ling tried punching and palming.
Causing the void to emit explosive sounds.
This Human Emperor Palm Technique, Human Emperor Fist, are extremely overbearing, immeasurable, dignified, and majestic, akin to the Jade Emperor sitting in the nine heavens issuing decrees!
Giving a feeling of being unavoidable, unstoppable, grand and vast!

chapters.title: Chapter 231 231: Liu Biao, Governor of Jingzhou, and Meeting Xun Chen Again
paragraphs: "Very good."
Du Qingcheng was very satisfied.
He continued reading the secret manual.
Next, he found that most of the secret manuals were incomplete or of low tier.
There were a few high-tier ones.
But they lacked the core techniques.
Even for someone like Du Qingcheng, who could instantly reach full level, he could only learn the incomplete moves and could not learn the missing core parts out of thin air.
Du Qingcheng didn't mind that.
There were dozens of incomplete, low-tier martial arts manuals.
Once he mastered them to full level.
His foundation increased significantly once again.
Du Qingcheng had a feeling.
When his foundation became unbreakably strong, perhaps his path in martial dao would be smooth and unobstructed, without impediments or limitations!
This made sense.
The more stable the foundation, the higher the building that can be constructed;
Conversely, if the foundation is unstable and one forcefully builds high, the only result is collapse!
Now that Du Qingcheng's martial dao foundation is deep, he can certainly go further and smoother in the future!
Therefore,
Even low-tier martial arts Du Qingcheng did not disdain, he read them all and then reached full level!
"Refreshing!"
Du Qingcheng exhaled.
The Yuan Family's accumulated efforts and hard work over many years were all used as a wedding dress for Du Qingcheng!
The pinnacle of royal supreme skills.
All became Du Qingcheng's skills!
On this day.
The appointed time for Du Qingcheng's meeting with the feudal lords arrived.
He had finished all sorts of tasks and stabilized his mindset.
In addition to learning and doing everything that needed to be done.
Du Qingcheng prepared to go to the hall to meet those feudal lords.
A period of seven days.
What needed observing should have been thoroughly observed.
From the reports of Diao Chan and others,
Cao Mengde was thick-skinned and strategic, Ma Teng was brave, Sun Jian was forthright, Hann Sui was cunning and opportunistic, Gongsun Zan was sincere, Liu Xuande could adapt...
Then there were player representatives, Tuoba Feng and Tian Yong, who were above others, enduring forcefully.
Du Qingcheng was already aware of the minds of those visiting.
As for those sent by Lü Bu, Chen Gong, and those by Yuan Shao, Xun Chen, etc.
Du Qingcheng also arranged for them to have the same seating as the feudal lords, showing proper decorum.
Regarding why Lü Bu is now tangled with Chen Gong?
Du Qingcheng could guess players are meddling and setting connections.
However, Xun Chen, an old acquaintance, coming here was unexpected for Du Qingcheng.

Du Qingcheng even considered making an exception to see him early. After all, during the time in Jizhou, Xun Chen had aided him significantly, helping Zhao Feng and Zhao Yun become generals, Xun Chen also contributed. Afterward, Zhao Feng and Zhao Bingxuan received protection and safely departed due to Xun Chen's strategizing.
With Xun Chen helping him so much, how could Du Qingcheng be ungrateful?
However, Xun Chen stated he was willing to wait and asked Du Qingcheng not to make an exception for him alone, to avoid violating principles.
He was very insistent.
Du Qingcheng didn't see him further but signaled Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and others to be more considerate towards Xun Chen.
Indeed, during these days, Xun Chen received extra care, with top-tier accommodations far better than the other feudal lords.
This time.
Du Qingcheng went to see the feudal lords, the first one he met was Xun Chen.
Xun Chen was very excited, met Du Qingcheng with a formal greeting, then tightly grabbed Du Qingcheng's hand, saying:
"Du Qingcheng, since we parted in Jizhou Ye City. It has been several months, I missed you dearly!"
Du Qingcheng's eye twitched, and he forced out a couple of awkward laughs.
Being told this by an older man, Du Qingcheng was covered in goosebumps.
This was Xun Chen, someone worthy of his respect and recognition; if it were anyone else, Du Qingcheng would definitely tell them to go away!
He was a normal person!
"Haha..."
Xun Chen, being wise, seeing Du Qingcheng's demeanor, laughed twice, looked around, and seeing Cao Mengde and others rushing over, couldn't help but say:
"Du Qingcheng, don't misunderstand. I don't have the penchant for broken sleeves. I just wanted to play chess with you. My fault, my fault..."
He slapped his forehead, laughed, and said:
"I didn't make myself clear."
"It's okay."
Du Qingcheng casually asked:
"How has it been during this time?"
"Very good."
Xun Chen was very satisfied:
"Your people have taken great care."
He pointed at Hann Sui and others:
"They have expressed opinions several times, claiming you are discriminating."
Hann Sui happened to rush in front of Du Qingcheng and, hearing Xun Chen's words, his face turned black immediately, he exclaimed:
"Xun Chen, don't slander good people! I never said that."
"Stubborn as a mule!"
Liu Biao chuckled, retorted Hann Sui, and then saluted Du Qingcheng:
"I am Liu Biao, Governor of Jingzhou, Du Qingcheng! I've admired you for a long time. Today I've finally met the true person. Indeed, you are very talented and dignified!"
"Don't dare, don't dare."
Du Qingcheng returned the greeting:
"I haven't thanked the Governor of Jingzhou for the special hospitality in Changsha County."
"That was just a small gesture."
Liu Biao, a 50-year-old or so man of elegance and charm, from his current demeanor, one could tell he must have been handsome and commanding when he was young.
Realizing Du Qingcheng remembered the small matters of Changsha County, although surprised, Liu Biao was moved and thought:

"Apparently Du Qingcheng is somewhat different from the rumors, not only respectful and courteous, but remembers these small matters, and specifically thanks me in public. Such a person, if drawn in and given significant favor, would never betray me."
Thinking this.
His heart warmed, growing more enthusiastic towards Du Qingcheng.
Du Qingcheng also smiled and chatted with Liu Biao.
Liu Biao was a scholar with a lingering stale air, the older he got, the more pronounced this became.
Du Qingcheng, having achieved mastery in many skills, easily discussed history, zither skills, poetry, and more with Liu Biao, fluently and effortlessly.
The more they chatted, the more Liu Biao appreciated Du Qingcheng, feeling he greatly suited his taste.
This literary talent was incredibly high!
Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others at this moment also arrived, witnessing this scene, listening to their conversation, looking at each other, they saw the amazement in each other's eyes.
Each secretly pondered:
"This Du Qingcheng has exceptional martial skills, but his literary talent seems to surpass Liu Biao! The rumors from Jizhou weren't far from the truth, albeit underrating Du Qingcheng."
After Yuan Shao took control of Jizhou,
He naturally suppressed and criticized everything related to Du Qingcheng.
Underrating Du Qingcheng was a regular activity!
Cao Mengde and others later heard some news which had been belittled.
Now comparing.
They naturally noticed the errors in the rumors.
In their shock, each pondered:

"With such literary talent, perhaps the martial skills have also been underrated. But it can't be! Du Qingcheng's martial skills are already legendary, akin to an Earth Immortal. If they're still underrated, what then?"
Thinking about the source of literary fame.
As well as the source of martial skills fame.

"With such literary talent, perhaps the martial skills have also been underrated.
But it can't be!
Du Qingcheng's martial skills are already legendary, akin to an Earth Immortal.
If they're still underrated, what then?"
Thinking about the source of literary fame.
As well as the source of martial skills fame.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 232: Zhang Fei Zhang Yide vs. Ding Ling
paragraphs: Many people have already speculated a general idea.
The literary talent originated in Jizhou. Ding Ling is a mortal enemy of the Yuan Family, so being belittled is normal.
The martial arts spread from Wan City. And Ding Ling is the City Lord of Wan City, fully controlling it, so who would dare belittle him?
Wan City, fully under the control of Ding Ling.
It's inevitable that under the influence of rumors, many things may get exaggerated, which is quite normal.
With this thought.
Liu Bei and the others finally understood.
Zhang Fei couldn't help it any longer. After Ding Ling finished talking with Liu Biao and others and exchanging greetings,
he was the first to stand up and loudly said:

"Ding Ling. It's rumored that you can break a city gate with one sword, and your body is like bronze and iron, able to withstand overwhelming arrow rain. I don't believe it and wish to test your skills."
"Hmm?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows.
Before he could speak, Liu Bei had already stood up and bowed deeply:
"I am Liu Bei Liu Xuande, a descendant of the Zhongshan Jing King. The one who just spoke is my third brother. He is rough and rude, disturbing you, Ding Ling. I apologize on his behalf."
"Big Brother!"
Zhang Fei glared.
"Sit down."
While Liu Bei was frantically making eye contact, he slightly turned his back to Ding Ling and scolded:
"We are guests. Provoking the host is a wrongdoing!"
"No problem."
Before Liu Bei could say more.
Ding Ling chuckled, looked at Zhang Fei, and said:
"Are you Zhang Fei?"
"Correct."
Zhang Fei glared his large eyes like bronze bells, straightened his back, and an aura of ferocity swept through the area:
"I am Zhang Fei Zhang Yide!"
"I've heard about you these days. It's said that you want to challenge me."
Ding Ling turned and walked away:
"Since you want a challenge, let's make it open and fair. To the Martial Arts Arena."
He walked slowly ahead.
Zhang Fei shouted 'Good'!
To Zhang Fei, it was a normal volume, but to others, it sounded like thunder, as if he was roaring.
"I will challenge you with my second brother together!"
said Zhang Fei.
His voice was like muffled thunder.
Ding Ling turned to look at Zhang Fei, then at Guan Yu and others, smiled indifferently, and said:
"I know what you are thinking. Soon you will know what I intend to do. After this challenge, you will understand everything."
Ding Ling seemed to be speaking in riddles.
Leaving Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others confused.
But in fact, he was telling the truth.
He obviously knew that his combat prowess, resembling a Land God, would have many warlords doubting it.
These warlords would come.
Curiosity is one reason; wanting to acquire Wan City and Ding Ling's legion is another;

More importantly, Ding Ling had fought many battles along the way, and due to Pigeon Post, with players occasionally leaking Ding Ling's information, Ding Ling was almost an open book in the Three Kingdoms World.
Many warlords have come to a conclusion: Even if Ding Ling's prowess is not as strong as Lü Bu, it's defiantly not much weaker!
This is why Zhang Fei immediately said he would challenge Ding Ling together with Guan Yu.
Because he wasn't confident enough to defeat Ding Ling!
But to say Ding Ling can withstand a waterfall of arrow rain;
Can traverse empty space, a celestial immortal from another world!
That's outrageous!
Zhang Fei didn't believe it and thought it was reasonable to test it!
Da da!
The group went quickly.
With Ma Yunlu and Ma Chao's siblings, Ma Teng's curiosity was also bubbling over.
Without exception, others all wanted to see for themselves, including some player representatives. After all, hearing is never as convincing as seeing with one's own eyes.
Da da!
Soon they arrived at the Martial Arts Arena.
Ding Ling, bare-handed, walked to the center of the Martial Arts Arena, looking at Zhang Fei, Sun Jian, Ma Teng, and others:
"You all can come together."
Zhang Fei was stunned for a moment, then his face flushed:
"Stop insulting people!"
He lifted his Snake Spear and with a great leap, jumped over dozens of meters in the air, and with a booming sound, landed heavily on the Martial Arts Arena, clanging!
With a shake of the Snake Spear, the shadows of the spear seemed to transform into a roaring serpent python in the air:
"My second brother and I can defeat you. Let me first test your skills."
With these words.
He was about to make a move, but seeing Ding Ling empty-handed, he paused his movement and shouted:
"Ding Ling, where is your weapon?"
"I can defeat you without any weapon."

Ding Ling's expression was calm, with a gaze like a deep well, seemingly a full-level account returning to the Newbie Village, looking at a field of low-level monsters, with no ripples or combat desire.
Tuoba Feng, Tian Yong, and other high-tier players almost spat blood, feeling Ding Ling was showing off too much! Truly the model for people like us!
Facing a super-elite like Zhang Fei, he could still speak like this.
He truly was amazing!
While feeling uncomfortable, they also felt jealousy and envy.
They also wanted to show off like this in front of Zhang Fei.
Yet their strength wouldn't allow this!
Liu Bei, Ma Teng, Guan Yu, Cao Mengde, and others all wore expressions of shock and disbelief.
Having a weapon and not having one.
Could be said to be two different states.
After all, the kung fu of most mounted generals lies in a weapon, without a weapon, they are like toothless tigers, their combat power greatly reduced.
Ding Ling is rumored to wield the Heaven-piercing Halberd to shake the world, and the Giant Que Sword to sweep across the land!
Now facing the famous Zhang Fei, he boldly claimed he wouldn't use a weapon?!
Was this seeking death? Or seeking death?!
Instinctively, Liu Bei and others felt that Ding Ling was looking for trouble, because even Lü Bu dared not say or do this.
But thinking Ding Ling wouldn't be so foolish, and considering the rumors, they suddenly thought to themselves in astonishment:
"Could the rumors be true?!"
"Such arrogance!"
Zhang Fei's face turned purple, he opened his mouth fiercely, roaring:
"Since you seek death, I'll fulfill your wish. Take my spear!"
Bang!

Zhang Fei activated the Breathing Technique, rushing forward swiftly, at that moment, turning into a streak of lightning on the Martial Arts Arena, extremely fast, his thrusting Snake Spear cast countless overlapping spear shadows!
Each spear shadow was like a massive serpent roaring towards Ding Ling;
Countless spear shadows fell.
It was as if thousands of monstrous serpents opened their terrifying ravenous jaws, about to swallow Ding Ling whole.
Amidst the astonished cries of the crowd.
Boom!
Each spear shadow struck heavily upon Ding Ling's body.
With a constant booming sound.
"Ding Ling is finished."
Liu Biao was shocked:
"Why didn't he dodge?!'
"A hero's life, ended just like this?"
Cao Mengde sighed:
"I know of Ding Ling's deeds quite well. He is undoubtedly a top-tier warrior, an unrivaled hero. Why would he think so irrationally?"
Many people shared Cao Mengde's thoughts.
More people thought Ding Ling must have lost his mind, behaving abnormally!
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and others watched calmly, even observing the expressions of Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others...

chapters.title: Chapter 233 233: Guan Yu's Three Spring and Autumn Blades (11/16)
paragraphs: The expressions in Diao Chan and her companions' eyes were somewhat unusual, peculiar.
They cannot be blamed for this.
The truth is that Hann Sui, Ma Teng, and others looking at Ding Ling as if he's a colossal fool caused Diao Chan and the group to feel a considerable sense of discrepancy! A sense of reversal!
Clearly, Ding Ling came prepared, ensuring he would emerge unscathed.
Yet Ma Teng and the others believed Ding Ling was undoubtedly doomed, a fool.
What will happen when the results are revealed?
The answer is obvious.
Boom!
With a series of explosive sounds reverberating through the air.
Zhang Fei takes a deep breath, holding the Snake Spear, retreats two steps, and fixes his gaze in Ding Ling's direction.
Then, as the dust settles.
Ding Ling's figure becomes visible.
He stands tall, his imposing figure covered in a layer of completely ravaged armor.
Beneath the armor is skin as smooth as jade!
Upon closer inspection.
It's discovered that Ding Ling's entire body remains intact, except for his damaged armor; not a drop of blood, not a single strand of hair seems to have fallen.
Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, Liu Biao, Guan Yu, Ma Chao, Hann Sui, and Gongsun Zan almost all gasp, their pupils widened, faces full of disbelief.
Zhang Fei's jaw nearly drops to the ground, utterly shocked:
"How, how, how is this possible?!"
His robust, burly frame trembles.
This isn't fear or terror.
But being stunned and shaken by such an ironclad fact that sounds like a fairy tale! The body's instinctive twitching response!
"It's terrifying!"
Dian Wei is moved, his hand gripping the halberd involuntarily shaking:
"Is this guy even human?!"
"Just now, Zhang Fei's furious strike—without blocking, one Lü Bu wouldn't stand a chance; even ten Lü Bu would be killed! Ding Ling, though? Completely unharmed!"
Xiahou Dun and other fierce generals swallow hard, their faces instantly tense, looking at Ding Ling as if seeing a Ghost God.
The entire Martial Arts Arena.
Except for Zhang Fei's thunderous roar resonating, the surroundings are dead silent.
Everyone stares in slack-jawed astonishment at Ding Ling.
As if struck by lightning, their bodies rigid to the extreme, minds utterly blank!
"Phew."
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun finally exhale in relief.
Though they knew Ding Ling would be alright, given that earlier he fell from such a great height without harm, leaving the ground pitted by impact!
Various instances prove Ding Ling's defense is unmatched.
Yet, Diao Chan and the others' worries persisted, hearts perpetually anxious.
Now seeing him unscathed brings a heavy sigh of relief.
Seeing Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others' reactions.
They are overwhelmed with a sense of pride! Feeling greatly honored to be associated.
They're 'family's' Ding Ling, suppressing heroes from across Jiuzhou alone! What earth-shattering prowess is this? Extraordinarily remarkable!
[Achievement Medal acquired: Intimidating Hann Sui.]
[Achievement Medal acquired: Intimidating Liu Bei]
[Achievement Medal acquired: Intimidating Ma Teng.]
[Note: Your invincible defense has made all the 'spectating' lords start doubting their existence! Feeling this is too unreal!
Reflecting on your past exploits, and the rumors from Wan City.
They've been broken in defense!
Developed deep reverence toward you!]
In one breath, you've acquired eight Achievement Medals.
Ding Ling slightly raises his brow; it seems obtaining these lords' Achievement Medals is quite challenging, as players haven't yet acquired them.
Yet, he just showcased a fraction of his abilities and reaped the rewards.
Indeed, strength is truth!
Thinking of this, Ding Ling gently brushes off his garment, looking calmly, composedly at Zhang Fei, a slight smile:
"Still want to fight?"
Noticing Zhang Fei's Achievement Medal hasn't been acquired.
Presumably, other players have obtained Zhang Fei's medal or he's still unconvinced at heart.
"Fight!"
Zhang Fei roars:
"Second brother, join me!"
"Alright!"
Guan Yu, carrying the Cyan Dragon Crescent Saber, strides wildly to Zhang Fei's side, loyally wielding his saber with eyes blazing as he looks at Ding Ling:
"Guan Yunchang of the Guan Family, please enlighten me!"
"Come on."
Ding Ling is unhurried, his expression calm:
"Let me see your skills."
"Okay. I'll be direct."
Guan Yu doesn't question why Ding Ling is without weapons, as Ding Ling already proved his unmatched defense earlier; further inquiry would be self-degrading.
With a roar, he thrusts the Cyan Dragon Crescent Saber forward furiously.
Spring and Autumn Saber Technique!

Upon unsheathing, dazzling saber light emerges into the world, blade light splits and comes together, one face exhibiting the boundless beauty of spring, another the bleakness of autumn's chilling north wind!
One Yin, one Yang; one positive, one negative! One Spring, one Autumn!
Spring and Autumn Great Saber.
One slash breaks forth, swiftly followed by three consecutive frenzied strikes.
Each blow exceeds the preceding one!
With three strikes, stacking together; all around, saber light fills the sky, possibly cleaving Heaven and Earth, piercing the Underworld!
A soul-stealing aura emanates from the blade's tip, surging through the Ten Directions Realm.
Even those distanced, like Cao Mengde and others, unconsciously freeze in breath-hold, feeling the presence of Death God!
Such three slashes.
Prepared to unleash suddenly, not to mention First-class Fierce Generals; even Super-Elites would struggle to block easily! One lapse ensures instant execution.
These three strikes rival Zhang Fei's myriad spear images, even more soul-stirring!
Like masterful artistry, the three strikes.
Carve turbulence in the void, stirring earth into a mild tremor.
With Guan Yu's loud shout, clanging!
The Cyan Dragon Crescent Saber slices into Ding Ling, producing a rumbling sound.
Scattered saber energies shoot in all directions, striking the ground, stirring dust clouds, smoke rises, completely shrouding Ding Ling in haze.
When the smoke dissipates.
Ding Ling's figure is once again revealed.
This time, his armor is entirely in tatters, strips of cloth hang from his body.
Clear as day is his jade-like skin.
Still intact!
Not even a hint of damage.
Though the premonition was there.
This reality shocks Guan Yu as if struck by lightning; he retreats several steps, unable to believe his eyes looking at Ding Ling, as if witnessing a Ghost God, observing the Heavenly Dao.
In such manner.
Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others are no different.
At this moment.
They suddenly believe the words from Wan City's residents:
"Lord City Lord alone breaks the city gates, emerges from the rain of arrows unharmed!"
These words abruptly flash in their minds.
They previously doubted its authenticity.
But now an ironclad fact stands before them!
They have no choice but to accept, believe Ding Ling's defense is indeed as divine, unassailable as if protective of heavenly and magical realms!
Were Ding Ling to appear on the battlefield in full heavy armor, who could ever kill him?
Relying on this defense.
Ding Ling can be deemed invincible!
With this understanding, Liu Bei, Cao Mengde, and others look at Ding Ling with increasingly fervent eyes!

Just the thought of it.
Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, Sunx Jian and the others couldn't help but shiver!
They couldn't imagine what it would be like to face Ding Ling directly on the battlefield!
It would definitely be a nightmare!
"Continue?"
Ding Ling looked composed, his deep eyes scanning Zhang Fei and Guan Yu:
"Do you still want to fight?"
Zhang Fei and Guan Yu were speechless.
Their strongest strike landed on Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was as if tickled, how can they continue to fight like this?!
Zhang Fei's face was as red as fire.
Thinking of his previous arrogant remarks!
He was even more embarrassed and ashamed!

Guan Yu also felt quite uncomfortable because he didn't believe that Ding Ling was as terrifying as the rumors said. However, now their strongest three strikes couldn't harm Ding Ling, continuing would just be self-deception and self-humiliation!
"Ding Ling."
Sunx Ce couldn't help but ask loudly:
"Is it true, as rumored, that you broke through the city gate with a single sword and crossed the void?"
"You'll know if you come and try together."
Ding Ling casually tore off his broken armor, revealing his sturdy, thick tiger-like back!
Diao Chan immediately ran over with a white garment and handed it to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling put it on.
Standing there with his hands behind his back, he looked every bit the Grandmaster.
"I said so. After today's battle, you will understand what I intend to do."
He scanned the gathered lords, without a trace of emotion, and said gently:
"My goal is to assist one lord in unifying the land! So among you, only one will be chosen by me!"
Hearing this.
All the lords' hearts burned with eagerness.
Each one looked at Ding Ling with fiery eyes.
Almost saying 'choose me', 'pick me now'!
And to further gain Ding Ling's approval.
Ma Teng even took Ma Yunlu directly past the crowd into the Martial Arts Arena to express his wish to form a marriage alliance with Ding Ling.
Ma Yunlu did not oppose, her almond-shaped eyes sparkling like water as she looked at Ding Ling, her face full of admiration and awe.
Ding Ling was astounded.
Ma Teng had caught him off guard.
He glanced at Ma Yunlu, fresh, spirited, with an aura of grace and poise, a rare peerless beauty, though not surpassing Da and Xiao Qiao and the like.
But she was far superior to ordinary women by countless measures.
Especially with Ma Yunlu's shy anticipation, her face like a peach blossom looking at Ding Ling, his breath caught, almost losing his Grandmaster's composure.
Cao Mengde secretly thought this wasn't good, quickly stepped forward a few steps, and took the sword from his waist, presenting it to Ding Ling with sincerity:

"Ding Ling, a treasure sword is fit for a hero! These are my personal swords, the Heaven-Swaying Sword and Cyan Gang Sword! I'm giving them to you now! Because maybe only you in this world can bring out their true sharpness!"
Ma Teng was furious, wasn't Cao Mengde being disruptive?
He could tell that Ding Ling had no intention to refuse. Clearly, all Ma Teng needed to do was persist a bit more; Ding Ling might have just agreed.
If he truly had a son-in-law like Ding Ling!
Just the thought of it made Ma Teng's blood boil with excitement, unable to contain his emotions.
If this alliance really happened, he imagined he would laugh with joy and pride for years!
"Ding Ling! I have an unparalleled horse for you."
Hann Sui started speaking loudly before reaching the Martial Arts Arena:
"A true Da Wan's fine horse, one in a million steed, as a military general, how can you have only one good horse? I'm giving you another one. Just perfect for you!"

"Ding Ling, I have a top-tier Divine Skill Secret Manual! I've heard rumors about your fast martial arts cultivation speed, learning just by looking at the secret manual without needing guidance. I didn't believe it. But today, I want to test it out. Come on, Ce'er, take out our family's ancestral secret manual, treasured for hundreds of years."
Sunx Jian quickly followed up.
Sunx Ce was speechless.
What secret manual treasured for hundreds of years?
This was quite an exaggeration!
However, he cooperated with Sunx Jian and took out an ancient secret manual from his bosom.
"Ding Ling, my family also has a daughter. As beautiful as a flower, gentle and charming, perfect to be your good match..."
"Ding Ling, I have a batch of white horses..."
"Ding Ling, I have a troop of Divine Weapons!"
"Ding Ling..."
A lot of lords were eagerly recommending their 'treasures', 'fine commodities', 'daughters', 'Divine Weapons', 'fine horses'...
Ma Teng's marriage plan was thus shattered.
He grimly took Ma Yunlu aside, gritting his teeth in anger at Cao Mengde.
Of course, he didn't give the other lords good looks either.
Especially Hann Sui, after agreeing to be brothers, stabbing him at a crucial moment, what kind of crappy brotherhood is this?!
Ding Ling thought of task 1: Defeat more than 20 plane warriors:
Task 3: You must make your title as War God resonate throughout the entire Plane World.
He began actively inviting Ma Teng, Ma Chao, Yann Xing, Dian Wei, Xiahou Dun, Gongsun Zan, Sunx Jian, Sunx Ce, and others to challenge him!
"Just a sparring session."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"It's no problem."
He paused, then added:
"As long as any one of you can harm even a single hair on my head, I will immediately join his team!"
As soon as these words were spoken.
The entire venue erupted.
Even players Tian Yong and Tuoba Feng began to get eager.
Cao Mengde and the others loudly asked:
"Is this true!"
"Absolutely true."
Ding Ling said firmly.
"Alright."
Cao Mengde gave Dian Wei and others a signal with his eyes:
"Then let's spar with you, Ding Ling."
Ta-da!
Dian Wei, Xiahou Dun, Sunx Jian, Gongsun Zan, and Yann Xing who stood shoulder to shoulder with Zhang Fei without being at a disadvantage, and others all took the stage.
Dozens of fierce and famous generals, lords surrounded Ding Ling.
Each one was armed, fighting bare-handed Ding Ling.
This was intolerable for some proud people.
Ding Ling saw it and didn't delay; he directly activated the Breathing Technique, his body slightly shook and a majestic awe spread in all directions!
"If you do not attack, then I will start!"
He turned his wrist, lightly clenched his fist, activating the Human Emperor Fist, a faint Human Emperor Pattern flickered on his fist.
As Ding Ling's aura continued to surge.
The Human Emperor Pattern seemed almost tangible, shining brightly on Ding Ling's hand.
With a shout from Ding Ling, the Human Emperor Pattern started to move with his fist towards Guan Yu.
"All together!"
Guan Yu knew Ding Ling's strength, roared, and along with Zhang Fei, was among the first to rush in.
