chapters.title: Chapter 235 235: Ding Ling vs a Group of Super-Elite Fierce Generals
paragraphs: A Spring and Autumn Three-Blade Slash!
Each blade stroke like the horns of an antelope, leaving no trace, resembling a divine saber that could split the heavens; each slash capable of shattering the firmament;
A Heaven-Swallowing Python Spear!
Every thrust manifested infinite spear shadows, piling up like mountains, devouring downward, akin to the hook snake emerging from the ancient time river, roaring and hissing at the earth;
The two were as if telepathically connected, perfectly coordinated, one cleaving the head from above, the other thrusting towards the vital point below!
A perfectly unparalleled duo attack!
Amidst the roaring and intense sound of breaking through the air, the attack was directed at Ding Ling!

Ding Ling advanced without retreating, with a hearty laugh, his fists condensed with the golden Human Emperor Pattern, punching towards the Cyan Dragon Crescent Saber with one fist, and towards the Snake Spear with the other.
Bang!
The fist seemed to gather the star power of the Divine Fist, punching out and making the void seem to bow down, visibly collapsing in sections under the fist's impact.
Under the startled gaze of everyone.
Boom Boom Boom!

Fist collided with blade and spear! Accompanied by a booming sound, spreading across the Celestial Extreme, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei were struck like by lightning, an unimaginable force transmitted from their weapons to their hands, causing their grip to tremble violently.
Yet the continuous divine power felt like heavy hammers pounding on them, causing their hands to fracture and bleed, with a muffled grunt, they could no longer hold on and released their grip.
Clang
Clang clang clang!
The two divine weapons fell to the ground.
In just one round, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei had their wrists severely injured by the Divine Fist, unable to fight effectively in the short term.
"How could it be?!"
Guan Yu and Zhang Fei stared in shock.
Sunx Jian and others were aghast, mutually seeing disbelief in each other's eyes.
It was one thing to have an invincible defense.
The power was also so fierce and terrifying!
How could there be such a person in this world?
"Come!"
Ding Ling called out clearly.
Sunx Jian and the others no longer hesitated, surrounding him and launching the strongest attack!
Rumble!
In an instant, the sky was filled with spear shadows, sword lights, and blade images... dazzling like stars falling from the sky, seeming able to destroy and obliterate everything!
"Ha ha..."

Ding Ling was fearless, laughing aloud, sometimes punching directly, hitting Sunx Jian's Ancient Dian Saber, knocking it out of hand and flying over ten meters away, embedding into the edge of the Martial Arts Arena.
At times, employing the Human Emperor Palm Technique, directly grabbing Yann Xing's long spear with one palm, kicking him, and sending Yann Xing flying dozens of meters away in astonishment.
Boom boom boom!
Ding Ling began to unleash his might.
At times, his arms became blades, chopping downward, filling the sky with erect Golden Gates, crashing and sending fierce generals flying everywhere!
Sometimes his arms became swords, with Sword God Skill, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, and Human Emperor Swordsmanship changing in succession, continuously colliding and contending with various weapons.
Each collision.
Was bound to knock someone flying!

Finally, Ding Ling became exhilarated, launching Ascending Skill and Flying Swallow Technique, his body like lightning, weaving through the crowd, with steel-like hands, continuously slapping and pounding, accompanied by the sound of booming, crackling, continuously arching across the sky.
In just a moment.
The Martial Arts Arena was filled with people lying around!
Whether it was the fierce Dian Wei or the fearless Zhang Fei, or the bold and brave Sunx Jian and the others.
They were all defeated by Ding Ling in an instant, like a flash of lightning!
There was dead silence in the audience!
A pin drop could be heard!
[Received E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Zhang Fei.]
[Received E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Guan Yu.]
[Received E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Dian Wei!]
[Note: Whether it's Zhang Fei or Guan Yu and others, they initially held a negative view of the rumors about you breaking through city gates with a single sword, traversing space and others.
Because in their understanding.
Even a general Celestial Human Realm expert couldn't be so valiant.
So, they doubted and denied you, even deeming you a fame-seeking pretender!
Zhang Fei was especially confident that he could join forces with Guan Yu to balance or even defeat you!
However, the recent battle.
Completely shattered their confidence in you, making them doubt their lives! Their worldview collapsed!
Your strength, beyond imagination, terribly frightening!
Made them realize, for the first time, what a truly strong person is!]
Collected a total of 5 E-level Achievement Medals.
20 Ordinary Achievement Medals!
Some fierce generals' Achievement Medals were not prompted, possibly taken by other players.
But gaining so many Achievement Medals in one go.
Especially 5 E-level ones, made Ding Ling quite joyful.
After all, Achievement Medals have significant uses.
Without Achievement Medals.
Ding Ling couldn't exchange power back into reality, nor quickly grow stronger. So Achievement Medals were very beneficial for him.
Even worrying about being unable to harvest many Achievement Medals in other worlds.
Ding Ling was reluctant to waste any Achievement Medals, saving them for future world crossings, to conveniently exchange power back into reality.
Click clack!
Ding Ling walked to one side.
Cao Mengde suddenly awakened, rushing to stand in front of Ding Ling, grabbing his hand earnestly and saying:
"Ding Ling, tell me what it takes to impress you. I guarantee to implement it fully, no hesitation!"
Ding Ling's power inspired wariness, horror, and astonishment!
Just now, Ding Ling, with bare hands.

Every punch and kick seemed to carry Celestial Might! As if the Celestial Emperor himself was punching and kicking, manifesting visions, with an imposing presence! Just seeing those mountain-like descending fist shadows was enough to make ordinary people lose their will to fight!
At this moment, Cao Mengde truly realized why Ding Ling received such fervent recognition and worship from the citizens of Wan City, not because of his absolute control over the city.
But because of his extraordinary prowess, akin to a land god!
With such strength.
If he had the Giant Que Sword in hand.
Breaking through city gates with a single sword was entirely feasible!
And recalling Ding Ling weaving like light and electricity among fierce generals just now.
Cao Mengde was convinced that the rumors of traversing space must also be true.
"Invincible defense!"
"Peerless power!"
"Unrivaled speed!"
"Boundless vitality!"
"Practically a living deity!"
'If such a character isn't won over, then my path to conquer the world will be completely blocked!'
How wise was Cao Mengde?
With such discerning eyes.
In one glance, he saw Ding Ling's significant role in the current chaotic world.
It could be said.
Whichever lord possessed Ding Ling, it was like having a Stabilizing Needle!
Ding Ling appeared!
Who dared to defy?
A group of super-elite fierce generals was effortlessly defeated by Ding Ling!
Ordinary generals facing Ding Ling?
Could they make any difference?!
"Ding Ling!"
Hann Sui was fervent, almost kneeling to Ding Ling, shouting loudly:
"As long as you are willing to help me. Whatever you want, I'll give it to you! I, Hann Sui, will keep my word, absolutely!"
"Ding Ling, help me."

chapters.title: Chapter 236 236: Liu Bei and the Others Start the Involution
paragraphs: The player representatives like Tian Yong and Tuoba Feng swarmed forward, attempting to grasp Ding Ling's arm, but found it impossible to find a position. Ding Ling was completely surrounded by Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, Hann Sui, and other quick-handed lords.
Forget about hands.
There was no space for even legs.
Liu Bei shamelessly hugged Ding Ling's leg directly, and with teary eyes, he choked and sincerely said:
"I, Liu Bei, have waited for so many years, and finally I've found my destined person! Ding Ling, as long as you assist me, this world, the Great Han, this kingdom will be saved.
As a descendant of Zhongshan Jing King, I have the responsibility and obligation to restore this land! You must help me!"
"As long as you are willing to help me."
"I would even kneel down and bow before you!"
"For the sake of this shattered nation, for the countless people suffering from the chaos of war."
"I, Liu Bei, even if I break my head, what does it matter?"
"As long as Ding Ling, you are willing to help me restore the land, I, Liu Bei, would cut off my leg and gouge my eyes for you!"
"Sacrifice me, and save millions! So what if I die?!"
Liu Bei wore an expression of 'heroic sacrifice, righteous and resolute'.
The player representatives like Tian Yong were completely dumbstruck.
They have seen shameless people, but never someone this shameless!
They were gaining insights!
If they could be this shameless, what couldn't they accomplish?!
But to actually say such words to Ding Ling?
They expressed they couldn't do it!
All are players, the meaning is enough. Why put their face to the ground too, that's too embarrassing!
Tian Yong and the others felt a bit despairing, this recruitment competition is too intense! The rivals too over the top! How could they compare?
"Liu Bei!"
Hann Sui shouted:
"You have nothing, why should Ding Ling help you, just based on your mouth?! I spit!"
He disdainfully glanced at Liu Bei, then respectfully looked at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, don't listen to Liu Bei's nonsense. Besides shamelessness, he has no other merits. Choose me. I am much better than him!"
"Hann Sui!"
Liu Bei became anxious.
Zhang Fei was even more furious, almost about to pick up his spear again.
After the battle with Ding Ling.
Zhang Fei was completely subdued!
He was thoroughly convinced by Ding Ling. Earlier, his tone changed greatly, loudly praising Ding Ling as 'worthy of the name' and 'living up to reputation'!
So seeing Hann Sui dare to not only compete for people with his brother but also speak insultingly, he was about to erupt on the spot.
Guan Yu quickly pulled him, whispered:

"Calm down, third brother. This is Ding Mansion! Earlier you said Ding Ling was deceiving the world and stealing fame, Hann Sui heard that, if he uses those words against you. What do you think Ding Ling would think of you?"
Zhang Fei was speechless, regretful, and sighed:
"Second brother. Those rumors were too exaggerated, completely mythologizing Ding Ling. It's normal for me not to believe."
He muttered:
"Besides. Didn't you and elder brother also not believe it? It wasn't just me!"
"Hmm?!"
Guan Yu gave him a sidelong glance.
Zhang Fei laughed awkwardly:
"I'm wrong. I'll apologize to Ding Ling later!"
"Hmm."
Guan Yu said solemnly:
"I'll accompany you. The Saints said, knowing and correcting a mistake brings great virtue! If we apologize early, gain Ding Ling's approval, it would be helpful to elder brother."
He also regretted:
"I doubt Ding Ling was insignificant but shouldn't have been the first to challenge him earlier. What will Ding Ling think of us brothers?"
Zhang Fei felt even more uneasy:
"It's my fault. I'll apologize now."
"Alright. Just don't add to the confusion now!"
Guan Yu waved:
"Ding Ling is about to choose a lord to assist. Let's just watch."
He sighed:

"The situation is clear now. Whoever gets Ding Ling's help will pacify the world! Think of the consequences of opposing Ding Ling. He's invulnerable to blades and spears, possesses unrivaled power, can cross the void, come and go without a trace, if he enters the grand array and slays us, we cannot stop him, the battle array would collapse instantly.
Even if we hide deep in the rear camp city.
Ding Ling could fly into the city, directly find us, and slice us. How can you fight like this? It can be said, whoever Ding Ling chooses now, the future world is theirs."
At this moment.
Guan Yu no longer doubted Ding Ling's ability to cross the void.
Zhang Fei listened and got anxious:
"Then what are we waiting for, hurry to win Ding Ling!"
"Elder brother is already on it."
Guan Yu gave Zhang Fei a sidelong look:
"You and I would only hold back. Just watch carefully."
Zhang Fei could only sullenly close his mouth, stand aside, and watch with wide eyes!
Meanwhile.
He also felt a desire rising within, wanting to become a martial artist like Ding Ling, akin to a land god!
He didn't know how Ding Ling trained to such a level.
But he decided he must find a way at all costs to climb to a higher pinnacle of Martial Dao!
There were quite a few fierce generals with similar thoughts as Zhang Fei.
Suddenly realizing the super-elite are actually so weak!
None of the super-elite fierce generals were willing to accept it, the flame in their hearts burned, all pondering how to strengthen themselves, how to become like Ding Ling.
Of course, the lords presently thought more about how to win over Ding Ling.
At this moment.
Lords from all sides.
The Eight Immortals crossed the sea, each showing their divine techniques!
Various shameless and brazen tactics were all exhibited.
In terms of shamelessness.
Cao Mengde and Liu Bei were neck and neck.
The two battled fiercely, each move 'cutting deep', truly evenly matched, hard to distinguish superiority!
This continued for nearly half an hour.
The lords had talked themselves dry.

Ding Ling went from shocked, scalp tingling to clicking tongue, to numbness, to stiffening, and then to acceptance... in just half an hour, Ding Ling seemed to have lived several lifetimes, its thrilling aspects had a unique flavor.
He didn't expect.
The lords would be so intense.
Beyond his imagination!
It seems these lords had thoroughly studied articles like 'Learning shamelessly' and 'Humiliation under the crotch', showing tendencies to align with Hann Xin!
Ding Ling was also for the first time realizing, ancient people revving up could totally match modern folks!
In some respects, even surpassing them.
He didn't want to delay further, directly made a decision:
"Enough. Tomorrow at this time, everyone meet again in the Ding Mansion hall, I will announce my decision then.

No matter who gets chosen. But it's certain I will fully assist in uniting Jiuzhou, striking beyond the borders, ruling the Western Realm, striving to expand our Great Han's territory to deeper, farther lands!"
Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, Hann Sui, Liu Biao, and Gongsun Zan were all entranced, repeatedly praising Ding Ling for being nationalistic, visionary, ambitious, bold, with a grand vision and layout, etc.
Ding Ling felt even his bones were going soft listening.
A group of historical figures wildly flattering him.
Just a few months ago, he dared not even dream of this.
After all.

chapters.title: Chapter 237 237: Sunx Jian and the Players Are All Taking Exams Advertisement
paragraphs: After all...
At that time, Ding Ling was still pondering who to align with for better prospects.
He never imagined he would become the decision-maker in this world!
But reality can sometimes be so dramatic!
The power of the Celestial Human Realm is comparable to that of a Land God.
Ding Ling, who has broken into the Celestial Human Realm in all four dimensions, is akin to having defense, strength, speed, stamina, vitality, endurance, and so on comparable to Deities!
He has reached this stage.
Every move, every word, can easily rewrite the structure of this world.
His courage, vision, and insight have naturally been elevated significantly.
Realizing.
What he can do is actually more than he had imagined!
His heart naturally swelled with the notion that he could easily overturn this world and rewrite people's destinies at will!

Fortunately, through recent battles, recuperation, and the continuous operation of the Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, and Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, almost all of the Evil Qi in his body has been dispelled, and his heart became increasingly clear, no longer as inflated as before.
He appears slightly less overbearing.
But his grand demeanor is more evident, increasingly showing the style of a Grandmaster!
Even so.
Faced with a group of renowned people fawning over him almost sycophantically.
Ding Ling still felt a little uncomfortable.
After all, a few months ago, he was just an ordinary person!
Although he experienced many things and was praised by many people during this period, this was the first time encountering someone like Liu Bei and others.
Ding Ling faced this kind of situation for the first time.
Even for someone like him, who has "bathed" in "flowers and praises,"
it was a bit overwhelming, making one's legs feel weak, which was quite normal.
Fortunately.
He is, after all, not an ordinary person.
He is a Land God who has broken into the Celestial Human Realm in four dimensions!
His mentality and demeanor have changed drastically from the past.
After parting with Liu Bei and others.
He began to write down questions one by one.
1: Are you willing to offer your Inherited Secret Martial Arts?
2: Are you willing to persuade your subordinates to offer their Secret Martial Arts?
3: Are you willing to offer Divine Weapons, fine horses, and other top items?
4: Will you wholeheartedly serve the country and the people? If you can't, what will you do?
5: How do you plan to govern the country?
A total of ten-plus questions.
After writing, Ding Ling quickly made dozens of copies and had Diao Chan deliver them to Cao Mengde and others.
And instructed Du Qingcheng, Diao Chan, and Da and Xiao Qiao to make it clear that the 'exam' must be submitted within one hour!
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and Du Qingcheng left.
A while later.
Cao Mengde, Liu Bei, and others were either racking their brains, writing feverishly, checking materials, consulting others, or finding somebody to ghostwrite for them...
Player representatives like Tian Yong and Tuoba Feng looked at the 'exam papers', looked at each other in dismay, and were dumbfounded:
"In the game world, do I have to take an exam?! Do I have to go this far?!"
"That guy Ding Ling is too arrogant. We're all players; can't we relax a bit?"
"Exactly. I've even secretly passed notes to Ding Ling. I made it very clear that as long as he chooses to support us, we would help him in the real world. Unfortunately, he seemed to ignore me!"
Players were more aware than the natives about Ding Ling's combat power and identity.
So they wanted to use coercion and inducement to force Ding Ling to cooperate with them.
But it seemed ineffective.
They thought about mutual support.
Yet Ding Ling still ignored them.
Frustrated and also very angry, they felt Ding Ling was too pretentious!
"Hmph. Ding Ling has offended Ning Yi, Ning Zhen, and others. Now he's provoking us too. I really don't know if he's fearless or really foolish?"

"Do you think a foolish person could be far ahead of all players, becoming the Land God of the Three Kingdoms world?! Hmph. He likely has something to rely on! It's just hard to tell what his background or supporters are, with so many rumors out there!"
"Let's have Ning Yi and others test Ding Ling's methods first. Once Ding Ling suffers, then we can approach him. By that time, he likely has no reason not to cooperate with us."
One hour later.
Ding Ling flipped through the 'exam papers'.
He was most dissatisfied with those from the players and set them aside.
Because they were too perfunctory, in comparison to the heartfelt words and fervent respect from Liu Bei and Cao Mengde, the players were automatically outshone during the process.
Ding Ling could not choose them as the administrators of the Three Kingdoms world.
Everyone knew each other.
If the players were to control the Three Kingdoms world, it would be too much of a leap and would easily get messed up!

Moreover, Ding Ling did not trust the players. He knew the players simply saw this as a game world, putting interests first, and would inevitably exploit this Three Kingdoms world of resources until depletion, then discard it as a worn-out shoe.
This was unacceptable to Ding Ling.
He had several benefactors, friends, and mentors in the Three Kingdoms world.
He couldn't bear to watch this world fall apart.
Repay goodness with goodness.
Repay malice with revenge.
These are Ding Ling's principles; he treats benefactors respectfully while showing no mercy to demons!
Ding Ling is not someone who is decayed or stubborn!
"It's him."
After reviewing all the papers.
Ding Ling chose Cao Mengde's.
Because Cao Mengde was the most willing to give, with relatively abundant resources, and his talents in governance far exceeded those of Liu Bei and others.
Regardless of how Liu Bei might develop later.
Currently, Liu Bei could not match Cao Mengde in domestic affairs, governance, or military strategy.
Furthermore, Cao Mengde was someone who was open to recruiting talents, with enlightened thinking, and would be a good monarch.
It's undeniable that he has various faults.
But who doesn't have faults?
Everyone has faults, and even Ding Ling has various faults himself!
Ding Ling is very clear about this.
The most important part is that Cao Mengde keeps his original intention, not experiencing too many dirty, bloody affairs.
If Cao Mengde really becomes like Dong Zhuo and does many unscrupulous things.
Ding Ling, with his prejudices, might not have chosen him.
After all, he was only choosing a proxy, wanting his friends, benefactors, and others to lead better lives.
At the same time, this is closely related to his mission.
Choosing the right person.
No doubt.
His Path of Glory for the War God would go more smoothly and perfectly.
The next day.
Ding Ling announced the result.
Cao Mengde was overjoyed, laughing up to the sky, his face unable to contain his joy, twisting with laughter that wouldn't stop for a long time.
Liu Bei, Liu Biao, Sun Jian, Hann Sui, and others were speechless, envious, jealous, and resentful!
Why was it Cao Mengde?
Ma Teng, straightforward as ever, asked the question everyone wanted to know.
Ding Ling directly took out everyone's exam papers.
Let them compare.
After a while.
Everyone fell silent.
The looks at Cao Mengde were of admiration and also disdain.
To win over Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 238 238: Cao Mengde in High Spirits (16/16) Advertisement
paragraphs: Cao Mengde has seemingly forgotten all the ancestral rules and traditions!
He is even willing to offer up all the related Inherited Secret Martial Arts and more!
This exceeds the bottom line for many people.
Ma Teng, Gongsun Zan, and others admitted they couldn't do it.
But Cao Mengde can!
Of course, Cao Mengde's state governance, Military Strategy, and such are extremely outstanding, making even Liu Bei and others admit their inferiority.
By comparing like this.
They came to understand why Ding Ling chose Cao Mengde.
If they were in the same position, they would also choose Cao Mengde.
There's no hurt without comparison.
Compared to Cao Mengde, they appear much more ignorant and less sincere.
Cao Mengde is willing to offer up all the related secret techniques!
This truly shows his attitude.
Although Liu Bei is also willing to offer everything!
But in terms of state governance and such, Liu Bei lags far behind Cao Mengde.
"Hahaha..."
Cao Mengde laughed heartily, continuously clasping his hands and saying:
"Everyone, I accept your concession!"
He strode over to Ding Ling, grasped his hand, his eyes sparkling with sincerity, and said earnestly:
"Ding Ling, don't worry, when I, Cao Mengde, give my word, it is as solid as a nail, like spilled water, irreversible. I guarantee your satisfaction!"
"Good."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"I hope for a pleasant cooperation."
"Haha, certainly! Certainly!!"
Cao Mengde's grin stretched to the back of his ears.
To have the assistance of someone like Ding Ling, an Earth Immortal.
He seemed to already envision unifying Jiuzhou and striking across the frontier.
His heart couldn't help but boil with excitement and passion.
Hann Sui's face twisted with jealousy!
Ma Teng felt stifled.
Sun Jian's face darkened.
Liu Bei sighed.
Liu Biao clutched his arm in regret.
Gongsun Zan felt deeply regretful.
The various warlords displayed different expressions.
But without exception, all were extremely envious and jealous of Cao Mengde.
Cao Mengde also felt this, growing increasingly proud, joyful, and excited, he shouted to the warlords:
"Everyone, you must now know the result. Do you think if one day I stand before your gates, could you withstand Ding Ling's Divine Skill methods?"
Hann Sui, Ma Teng, Liu Biao, and others were shocked.
"You surely can't withstand it."
Cao Mengde, high-spirited, exuding confidence, seemed as if he had received Immortal teachings, with an Immortal as his backing, what did he have to fear from commoners?
Their status wasn't on the same level at all.
Completely able to overlook and crush them:
"So, why don't we sit down and talk seriously about how to better and more quickly integrate each other's strengths?"
Before Cao Mengde finished speaking.
Hann Sui was the first to speak up:
"Cao Mengde, how could we easily hand over the lands we have painstakingly managed and invested our efforts into just because of a few words from you? Don't overestimate yourself."
"You're quite right."
Cao Mengde was straightforward:
"I've never overestimated myself. I think none of you should overestimate me either."
He pointed at Ding Ling:

"You should regard Ding Ling seriously! Think about it, even if Ding Ling lets you leave today, once we meet on the battlefield, how many moves can you withstand? To die before success is achieved! How tragic, how pitiful. Don't you wish to become high officials in the court and enjoy generous salaries?
Don't you want your name to be recorded in history?
Don't you want to achieve great glory and leave a rich legacy for your descendants?
If you don't want it.
Insist on opposing Ding Ling. Fine. You can leave now.
As I said here today.
Whoever leaves first today.
Will be the first we eliminate with Ding Ling in the future!"
Originally Hann Sui, who had stepped out, turned black-faced as the bottom of a pot upon hearing this!
He opened his mouth and angrily rebuked:
"Cao Mengde, stop pushing us too far!"
"Hehe."
Cao Mengde laughed heartily, never having been this happy in his life:
"Telling you the truth is bullying you. Jiuzhou must be unified. As Ding Ling mentioned before. So, anyone who prepares to oppose Ding Ling should think about the consequences clearly!"
All the warlords fell silent.
"Ding Ling is like an Earth Immortal, which of us commoners can withstand his blows?"
Cao Mengde advised:
"I mean well, and if you insist on your way, you can leave now."
Nobody left.
This was because no one wanted to become the first target of Ding Ling.
"Let's go inside and discuss matters properly."
Cao Mengde enthusiastically pulled the reluctant Liu Bei, Sun Jian, and others into the hall for talks.
Ding Ling stood aside watching, saying nothing.
The negotiations were intense.
The issues concerning interests were very complex.
Some were satisfied, while naturally, some were dissatisfied.
In the end, for everyone's joy, they unanimously pointed their aims at the warlords not present at Wan City: Dong Zhuo, Yuan Shao, Liu Yan, and others.
When our own interests aren't enough,
we shall divide others' interests.
Cao Mengde and his group discussed until the next day.
Only then did they set the plans.
First to eliminate Dong Zhuo, then to clear out Yuan Shao and others.
As long as Ding Ling proves his strength.
Liu Bei, Sun Jian, and others would have no qualms about joining Cao Mengde's group, becoming a part of it!
"Good!"
Ding Ling exclaimed.
He finally reached an agreement.
He was nearly falling asleep. Too tedious! Clearly, he's not cut out for being a politician, too big a headache from listening, and avoiding listening leads to mistakes.
So the best solution is not to participate!
To leave these troublesome matters to Cao Mengde was indeed suitable.
If it were him, he would certainly choose overwhelming force, obey or perish.
But Cao Mengde is different, he maximizes the use of all talent, mobilizing them without wasting Jiuzhou's talent.
For Jiuzhou to have long-lasting and stable development.
Talent is essential.
Though Ding Ling's state governance skills may be Full Level, the lack of wisdom and other factors make it extremely challenging for him to manage domestic affairs smoothly and effortlessly.
Even if it weren't overly challenging, he still wouldn't want to do it.
It's too time-consuming, arduous, and strenuous. How is it comparable to direct force? Swift? Decisive? Efficient?
"I'll just go remove Dong Zhuo's head."
Ding Ling lifted his legs to leave, after a few steps, he turned to Cao Mengde and the others: "Who's sending troops to receive the Si Li territories?"
"I'll go!"
Liu Bei was very proactive:
"I brought a troop, stationed thirty miles from Wan City. I can have my second brother and third brother accompany you, Ding Ling."
Hann Sui secretly cursed shamelessness, quickly standing up to say:
"To be honest, I also brought a troop of Iron Cavalry, stationed fifty miles northwest. I believe it's appropriate for me to receive the Si Li territories!"
The other warlords also spoke up earnestly.
When it came to seizing interests, each of them was like a ravenous wolf, not holding back at all.

This exceeds the bottom line for many people.
Ma Teng, Gongsun Zan, and others admitted they couldn't do it.
But Cao Mengde can!
Of course, Cao Mengde's state governance, Military Strategy, and such are extremely outstanding, making even Liu Bei and others admit their inferiority.
By comparing like this.
They came to understand why Ding Ling chose Cao Mengde.
If they were in the same position, they would also choose Cao Mengde.
There's no hurt without comparison.
Compared to Cao Mengde, they appear much more ignorant and less sincere.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 239: Breaking Through Tong Pass! Arrival at the Ancient City (1/17)
paragraphs: Ding Ling remained silent.

He thought: These warlords are quite well-prepared! Each of them has brought a heavy army, are they planning to have someone ready to aid their escape if negotiations fail? Or perhaps they are ready to collaborate internally and externally to seize Wan City?
It's not impossible.
The premise is that Ding Ling's capabilities aren't particularly high.
Now, Ding Ling's capabilities and skills are absurdly high.
Their measures and preparations naturally become jokes, futile efforts.
They didn't voice their intentions.
But as soon as Ding Ling spoke, they couldn't help themselves.
Ultimately, Ding Ling still chose to side with Cao Mengde's forces.
Cao Mengde breathed a sigh of relief.
He looked at Liu Bei and the others with a meaningful gaze.
Liu Bei and the others gave an awkward smile.
Although it was Cao Mengde's people who went to take over the territory,
almost all the warlords followed along to Hulao Pass, then to Luoyang, then through Tong Pass, and finally into Chang'an City.
The whole way was cavalry.
Cao Mengde spent his entire fortune to quickly take over Si Li's territory.
Each cavalryman had two horses, just to quickly reach Luoyang, Tong Pass, and other places.
The cavalry troops of Wan City.
Were all bundled up and given to Cao Mengde.
This left the other warlords envious beyond measure.
They also truly realized that Ding Ling was not joking; he was indeed preparing to assist a warlord in unifying Jiuzhou and the world.
Since Ding Ling is serious.
They naturally had more reason to carefully observe Ding Ling's methods.
If they really couldn't resist,

Liu Bei, Ma Teng, and the others weren't foolish; they naturally wouldn't do something as futile as stopping a chariot with their arms. Following the trend and joining Cao Mengde's forces to gain greater and more benefits was the sensible thing to do!
On the way.
Xun Chen bid farewell to Ding Ling.
He looked at Ding Ling with a very complex look; originally, he thought he was just a courageous general, who knew Ding Ling turned out to be an Earth Immortal!
Opposing such a Divine Being?
How far can Yuan Shao go?
"After I return, I will try to persuade the lord; if he doesn't listen... ah~"
Xun Chen was anxious, his face full of exhaustion and helplessness; facing a Divine Being like Ding Ling, he had no confidence to resist.
No matter how strong one's unrivaled wisdom or cunning stratagems may be,
faced with a person like Ding Ling,
they would all be useless!
Because with one punch from Ding Ling, their side's people might die!
"If he doesn't listen, take Tian Feng and Jushou and stay at home, don't venture out casually; I will deal with Dong Zhuo, and on the way, I'll also make a trip to Ye City."
Ding Ling said.
As expected, Pan Feng, under his advance arrangements, didn't die.
But he was demoted, and finally, with the joint help of Xun Chen and others, he fled into the deep mountains with Zhao Feng.
Ding Ling searched for keywords in the real world.
This is how he learned.
It turned out that Yuan Shao had long intended to seize Jizhou, so he wanted to find a way to kill the loyal Pan Feng first!
But what Yuan Shao didn't know was that Pan Feng received many pigeon posts from Ding Ling and Ding Ling's relentless deployment of players infiltrating Jizhou to support Pan Feng.
Ensuring that Pan Feng escaped death.
But he escaped.
Hann Fu, however, could not escape, and ultimately met an untimely death.
Who knows if Pan Feng will go mad with rage when he learns of Hann Fu's death?
"I'll do my best."
Xun Chen nodded hesitantly.
To say he was extremely loyal to Yuan Shao, that wasn't necessarily so.
After all, he hadn't followed Yuan Shao for very long!
He just didn't know whether Yuan Shao, in a fit of rage, would implicate the innocent.
After speaking with Xun Chen for a while.
They parted ways.
Afterwards.
Thin and tall, with refined features, Chen Gong specifically sought out Ding Ling and hoped Ding Ling could spare Lü Bu's life:
"He is the Flying General. His destiny should be on the battlefield, not dying meaninglessly at the hands of his own people."
"If he is sensible, I will spare him."
Ding Ling recalled the scene when he sparred with Lü Bu and said casually.
"Thank you."
Chen Gong rode away.
He needed to return and report the situation here to Lü Bu first.
Ding Ling and his entourage each had two horses.
That day.
The group reached Tong Pass.
This pass.
Very hard to breach.
But Ding Ling leapt hundreds of meters high, stepping lightly in the air, ignoring the rain of arrows shot at him, and wielded a Giant Que Sword, activating the Sword God Skill.
Flowers in Bloom unfolded, perfectly blocking all arrows outside.
Then, with a light leap, he landed on the wall of Tong Pass.
Amid everyone's aghast gaze.
Ding Ling swung the sword in his hand.
Qing Frost Swordsmanship!
Vigorous Qi condensed into flying snow and frost droplets, exploding through the air with a crackling sound, leaving in its wake a bloody scene of broken limbs and shattered bodies.
In just a moment, the hundreds of soldiers before Ding Ling were cleared away.

He lightly pushed against the 'ground', like a lightning bolt through the air, in the blink of an eye, flying across a hundred meters, cutting through everything like a hot knife through butter, none could withstand a single swing from Ding Ling.
Just like that, amid everyone's dumbfounded expression, Ding Ling swung his sword, and swoosh! The head of the Defender General of Tong Pass soared into the sky.
In an instant, it was sliced clean off by him.
The Defender General didn't even see his technique before he died just like that!
"So strong!"
Ma Chao was shocked:
"He can really fly?! How is this even possible?!"
Ma Yunlu looked at Ding Ling with admiration.
Liu Bei, Ma Teng, Sunx Ce, and others had surging emotions and couldn't stay calm.
They finally witnessed how sharp and invincible Ding Ling was on the battlefield.
Such a heroic pass like Tong Pass! It couldn't even stop Ding Ling for a moment or two and was easily broken just like that.
It's entirely conceivable
that opposing him,
even hiding in deep forests and old woods, as long as Ding Ling saw their figure, they wouldn't escape calamity!
"That Defender General was quite skillful, yet he was easily taken down like this!"
Hann Sui and others were deeply moved.
"Move!"
As the gates of Tong Pass were opened by Ding Ling.
Tong Pass was seized by Cao Mengde's army from then on.
He left Le Jin to integrate the surrendered troops.
Indeed.
As Ding Ling killed the Defender General, with a clear shout, those who surrendered would not be killed, almost all the soldiers directly knelt!
Next.
Along the way.
Ding Ling made swift progress through every hurdle.
No one could stop his advance.
Liu Bei, Sunx Jian, and others went from having their scalps tingling and hair standing on end to being numb and stiff, and have since evolved into composure.
They decided to go with the flow!
Because seeing this.
They completely understood.
Ding Ling alone could defeat a nation!
Or even say Ding Ling alone could destroy a nation! It's absolutely not a joke!
Opposing such a person?
You must be tired of living?
That day.
Amidst the rapid sound of hooves.
Ding Ling and his party reached Chang'an City.
Due to the necessity of taking over the Si Li Region,
the accompanying troops and generals became fewer and fewer.
The famous generals by Cao Mengde's side: Cao Ren, Cao Hong, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Li Dian, were all busy integrating the surrendered troops, taking over Si Li Region territory.
The surrendered troops were especially numerous.
Without leaving some troops to watch over, Cao Mengde feared that Xiahou Dun and others couldn't hold them down.

chapters.title: Chapter 240 240: Slaying Guo Si with a Single Sword! One Man Breaks Ten Cities
paragraphs: So, when Ding Ling arrived at Chang'an.
Beside Cao Mengde, there was only Dian Wei left. The troops were merely thirty guards.
In Cao Mengde's own words.
If Chang'an is taken.
It will be enough to prove Ding Ling's terrifying strength, and the armies of Liu Bei and others should naturally give up command, submitting to Cao Mengde's leadership!
In this way.
Wouldn't there be someone to guard the conquered Chang'an?
Ding Ling was not one for delay.

Upon reaching the ancient city, he directly drew his sword, mounted his horse, and with a flying spin kicked off the ground, deploying the Flying Swallow Technique. Like a graceful wild goose, he soared hundreds of meters into the sky.
Under the piercing sunlight.
In the air, Ding Ling seemed like a deity covered entirely in golden paint, shining brightly, dazzling and noble, reaching the peak of luminosity.
In the slightly numb eyes of Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, Guan Yu, and others.
Ding Ling faced the downpouring arrows from the walls of Chang'an City, stepping on sunlight, wielding the Giant Que Sword, crossing hundreds of meters, and flew onto the ancient city's walls.
"Ah!"
The general guarding the gates roared:
"Release arrows, shoot him dead! Shoot him dead for me!"
His voice was filled with fear, astonishment, and dread.
Ding Ling sharply looked at the general.
The general was startled, turned, and ran.
Ding Ling kicked off, soared into the air, stepping on the air like it was solid, taking several strides and crossing over the phalanx of thousands of soldiers, arriving before the general.
A sword swung down.
Clang!
The general swiftly retaliated, swinging his sword to clash with Ding Ling's blade, causing a thunderous noise!
But only for a single strike.
His sword was knocked flying, his arm shattered by an irresistible force!
As if he wasn't just fighting with another person.
But crashing against a mountain, in just an instant, his bones broke, his face contorted with pain.
Looking incredulously at Ding Ling, he wanted to say 'Are you a god? A mortal? Or a demon?'
But Ding Ling gave him no chance to speak.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword swung.
In a flash of sword light.
A massive head flew skywards amidst a blood pillar rushing to the heavens.
"General Guo is dead!"
"Run!"
The players were the first to flee.
"Surrender and you won't be killed."
Ding Ling shouted clearly.
The players were the first to kneel and throw away their weapons!
Ding Ling was already accustomed to this scene.
It was all too familiar.
Walking along the way.
The players always acted this way.
Seeing him 'charge alone,' they were already prepared to flee, barely putting in any effort.
When Ding Ling reached the walls, many players had already sneaked to the corners, ready to escape.
Ding Ling said to surrender without killing.
They breathed a sigh of relief, no need to run, they could instead submit to Cao Mengde's side.
Mixing with Cao Mengde seemed quite good indeed!
They heard that several leading generals among players were famous ones like Xiahou Dun, and learning martial arts with such generals was excellent!
Crunch crunch!
Chang'an City.
The heavy, historically rich gates opened.
Liu Bei, Sun Jian, and others sighed lamentably:
"Guo Si was at least a peak first-class fierce general! Just died like that? Without any feeling!"
"Had I not fought Guo Si, I would've thought he was just some weakling."
Ma Teng was most shocked because he was also from Xiliang and knew Guo Si well:
"Guo Si roamed Xiliang so unchecked and overbearing. Few people could restrain him! To think he'd die so easily at Ding Ling's sword today!"
Ma Teng touched his neck.
Involuntarily shivered.
"If I were guarding the city? Could I withstand Ding Ling's sword?"
He knew, he absolutely couldn't!
The moment Guo Si died.
The silhouette of Ding Ling grew ever grander, heroic, and immeasurable in the hearts of Ma Teng and others!
[Received Achievement Medal: Subdue Guo Si!]

[Note: The lawless and murderous Guo Si prided himself on his martial prowess. Except for a few like Lü Bu, he obeyed no one, wielding a great army, there were almost none who could truly earn his respect.
But you are the only exception.
Your appearance is like a ray of light breaking through darkness! Intensely hot and dazzling.
In just a moment, you shattered Guo Si's long-held perspectives! Made him realize for the first time that no matter how large an army or high authority, before a true expert, they mean nothing!]
Ding Ling felt slightly surprised.
He didn't expect that the one he just killed was Guo Si, who previously made him extremely wary and avoidant!
Time has changed!
The once formidable and fearsome Grand General!
Now seemed like mere paper before him!
Unable to withstand a single blow!
Looking at the prostrate army covered the ground.
Ding Ling reaffirmed his goals and thoughts:
"I must become the true War God! With enough power, all obstacles can be easily obliterated!"
Previously upon seeing Guo Si's banner.
Ding Ling would detour.
Now he directly and effortlessly cut it down.
Without even a sensation!
"Indeed, reaching a realm changes one's mindset subtly. No matter how you adjust it, change will happen."
Ding Ling's mindset underwent numerous adjustments and balances through Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases.
Already quite stable.
But now it seems, there's something different after all.
Ding Ling smiled knowingly.
No longer thought much of it.
Reaching a status changes what one thinks and whom one interacts with. Changing the mindset is normal. As long as he remains himself, it's fine.
Clip-clop!
Ding Ling's Ferghana Horse crossed through the gates, Ding Ling leaped down, landing lightly on its back.
Cao Mengde and others watched, exclaiming in amazement.
This is truly a divine being, the demeanor of a master!
Ding Ling continued forward.
All along the way.
He had already earned several achievement medals.
Including [Single Ride Break at Tong Pass], [Single-handedly Took Ten Cities], [Single Person Intimidated Hundred Thousand Troops], and more.
These achievement medals.
Ordinary players could not accomplish.
Because.
They were clearly single-player achievements! Not team achievements!
Single-handedly intimidating a hundred thousand troops?
Only achievable if like Ding Ling having attained celestial human realm in four-dimensional attributes, or celestial realm in at least defense and strength attributes.
Otherwise insufficient defense would lead to being shot through;
Insufficient strength would be overpowered by super-elite fierce generals;
Insufficient stamina and endurance would prevent lasting combat;
Insufficient agility would prevent ascending the city wall.
Each of the four-dimensional attributes has its unique traits!
To individually collect various achievement medals, at least two attributes should reach celestial level, thus achieving a semblance of invincibility.
Like Ding Ling, whose four-dimensional being.
That's truly an all-round king!
Genuine invincibility!
Clip-clop!
Ding Ling rode ahead, far leading Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, and others, and arrived first at the Imperial Palace of Chang'an Ancient City.
Here.
A densely packed army guarded.
Leading was...

sentences.text: So, when Ding Ling arrived at Chang'an.
Beside Cao Mengde, there was only Dian Wei left.
The troops were merely thirty guards.
In Cao Mengde's own words.
If Chang'an is taken.
It will be enough to prove Ding Ling's terrifying strength, and the armies of Liu Bei and others should naturally give up command, submitting to Cao Mengde's leadership!
In this way.
Wouldn't there be someone to guard the conquered Chang'an?
Ding Ling was not one for delay.
Upon reaching the ancient city, he directly drew his sword, mounted his horse, and with a flying spin kicked off the ground, deploying the Flying Swallow Technique.
Like a graceful wild goose, he soared hundreds of meters into the sky.
Under the piercing sunlight.
In the air, Ding Ling seemed like a deity covered entirely in golden paint, shining brightly, dazzling and noble, reaching the peak of luminosity.
In the slightly numb eyes of Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, Guan Yu, and others.
Ding Ling faced the downpouring arrows from the walls of Chang'an City, stepping on sunlight, wielding the Giant Que Sword, crossing hundreds of meters, and flew onto the ancient city's walls.
"Ah!"
The general guarding the gates roared:
"Release arrows, shoot him dead!
Shoot him dead for me!"
His voice was filled with fear, astonishment, and dread.
Ding Ling sharply looked at the general.
The general was startled, turned, and ran.
Ding Ling kicked off, soared into the air, stepping on the air like it was solid, taking several strides and crossing over the phalanx of thousands of soldiers, arriving before the general.
A sword swung down.
Clang!
The general swiftly retaliated, swinging his sword to clash with Ding Ling's blade, causing a thunderous noise!
But only for a single strike.
His sword was knocked flying, his arm shattered by an irresistible force!
As if he wasn't just fighting with another person.
But crashing against a mountain, in just an instant, his bones broke, his face contorted with pain.
Looking incredulously at Ding Ling, he wanted to say 'Are you a god?
A mortal?
Or a demon?'
But Ding Ling gave him no chance to speak.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword swung.
In a flash of sword light.
A massive head flew skywards amidst a blood pillar rushing to the heavens.
"General Guo is dead!"
"Run!"
The players were the first to flee.
"Surrender and you won't be killed."
Ding Ling shouted clearly.
The players were the first to kneel and throw away their weapons!
Ding Ling was already accustomed to this scene.
It was all too familiar.
Walking along the way.
The players always acted this way.
Seeing him 'charge alone,' they were already prepared to flee, barely putting in any effort.
When Ding Ling reached the walls, many players had already sneaked to the corners, ready to escape.
Ding Ling said to surrender without killing.
They breathed a sigh of relief, no need to run, they could instead submit to Cao Mengde's side.
Mixing with Cao Mengde seemed quite good indeed!
They heard that several leading generals among players were famous ones like Xiahou Dun, and learning martial arts with such generals was excellent!
Crunch crunch!
Chang'an City.
The heavy, historically rich gates opened.
Liu Bei, Sun Jian, and others sighed lamentably:
"Guo Si was at least a peak first-class fierce general!
Just died like that?
Without any feeling!"
"Had I not fought Guo Si, I would've thought he was just some weakling."
Ma Teng was most shocked because he was also from Xiliang and knew Guo Si well:
"Guo Si roamed Xiliang so unchecked and overbearing.
Few people could restrain him!
To think he'd die so easily at Ding Ling's sword today!"

chapters.title: Chapter 241 241: Beheading Li Jue! Entering the Imperial Palace
paragraphs: Li Jue!
This was told to Ding Ling by a player who was leading him.
In order to please Ding Ling, the player voluntarily rode alongside him, guiding Ding Ling and informing him of various precautions, among which was Li Jue.
At this moment, they encountered Li Jue's Great Army at the Imperial Palace gate.
The player recognized him at first glance and informed Ding Ling of the truth.
Ding Ling lifted his gaze.
He saw a man standing at the forefront of the city tower inside the Imperial Palace.
The man was eight feet tall, dignified in appearance, and burly in build, holding a long spear, slightly squinting as he observed Ding Ling.
The two men exchanged glances.
Li Jue spoke first:
"Is the person approaching Ding Ling?"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling nodded.
"We mean no hostility towards you. Please do not misunderstand!"
"Hmm?"
Ding Ling was surprised and looked at the player.
The player explained:

"The siege of Chang'an City has been reported here, but Li Jue likely doesn't know the specifics yet. The urgency of the situation makes it hard for the messengers to convey the full story clearly. Li Jue is unaware of your prowess, which is understandable."
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded, mounted his horse, drew his sword, and charged towards Li Jue.
The player watched in admiration and envy, wishing he could be as powerful as Ding Ling someday—it would be wonderful.
"Courting death!"
Li Jue was utterly shocked but quickly reacted, giving the order:
"Release the arrows, kill him!"
Li Jue naturally knew of Chang'an City's siege.
Though the messenger claimed a person named Ding Ling accomplished all this.
Li Jue did not believe one person could breach the city gates alone.
There must have been traitors aiding from within.
Seeing the traitor next to Ding Ling wearing a Xiliang Army armor, nodding and fawning, it's clear there were traitors for sure!
Traitors opening the city gates;
Great Army assisting in attacking Guo Si.
Guo Si was caught off guard and could be understood to have perished.
But claiming Ding Ling single-handedly defeated Guo Si, Li Jue refuses to believe it, because even ten Lü Bu couldn't accomplish such a feat.
Why Ding Ling?!
But in the next moment.
He learned why!
In his stunned daze.
Ding Ling, braving the storm of arrows, galloped onward, leaping into the air like Feiyan, reaching right in front of him in just a few blinks.
"You!"
Li Jue was shocked and horrified, instinctively thrusting his spear at Ding Ling!

Ding Ling advanced instead of retreating, disregarding the spear's thrust, swinging the Giant Que Sword, and unfolding the Calm Wind Swordsmanship, clang, clang, clang! The sword's edge resonated! The sword's body fiercely vibrated, transforming the elusive Sword Qi into strands of wind in the world!
The Calm Wind formed by Sword Qi.
Blew in the midair.
Whoosh!
Splurt!
As the whooshing wind sound spread, with a light splurt, Li Jue's head was instantly sliced off, and a pillar of blood soared to the sky.
Li Jue's face froze in a complex expression of shock, bewilderment, bewilderment, regret, confusion, and disbelief.
[Achievement Medal Earned: Subduing Li Jue.]
[Note: Li Jue did not believe the messenger's words. He didn't believe one person could be like a deity or demon.
Yet your appearance made him realize the rumors were true!

His spear, in his full-force thrust, could easily pierce through boulders! But when it struck you, you were unharmed and moreover, the immense recoil even made him unsteady in gripping the spear. In that moment, he realized your strength, but he wanted to flee, unfortunately, it was too late.
If there were reincarnation, encountering you, he would surely flee in terror. Only because your demon god-like figure was etched deep into his soul!]
Another Achievement Medal.
Ding Ling's eyes scanned the soldiers on the city wall.
Each one was tall and robust, armored in heavy gear, holding huge shields and long guns, clearly elite soldiers.
But at this moment, they all stared at Ding Ling in shock and horror.
"Surrender, and you won't be killed!"
Ding Ling shouted clearly.
This was his customary call.
As was expected.
As soon as he shouted, a player among the crowd immediately dropped his weapon and shield, shouting, "I surrender! Boss, spare me!"
Judging by the voice, another player.
The player's surrender hastened the collapse of this army.
Although there were still many extremely stubborn ones among them.
Someone even shouted loudly to avenge Li Jue.
But Ding Ling casually swung his sword, triggering the Calm Wind Swordsmanship.
Strands of wind blew towards the stubborn ones.
Even from ten meters away, splurt, splurt!
Heads were easily cut off.
Bodies quickly pierced through!
In just a short span.
Hundreds of stubborn ones were all killed.
The ground was a mess!
Blood everywhere!
Everyone was horrified.
Their gazes towards Ding Ling were filled with immense fear.
"Open the gates."
Ding Ling surveyed the cluster of players.
They promptly went to open the inner city gates.
At this moment.
Liu Bei and others arrived belatedly.
Seeing Ding Ling had quickly taken the inner city.
They marveled in shock and jealousy, envy towards Cao Mengde was more pronounced! If only Ding Ling had chosen them, they would have hit it big!
Cao Mengde smiled with satisfaction, realizing for the first time how easy warfare could be.
Seeing Ding Ling's figure, like Mount Tai—immense, profound, and towering.
Cao Mengde's heart started considering cultivating a genuine 'Deity' with all his might!
On the battlefield.
No matter how many soldiers or generals, facing such a deity, only slaughter awaited!
Clearly.
The future battlefield will definitely belong to deities!
Whichever side has deities, that side is the absolute stronghold, the controller!
Click, clack!
Ding Ling paid no heed to how Cao Mengde and others managed the surrendered troops.
He continued forward.
The Imperial Palace was vast, grand, luxurious.
Walking through.
The sheer amount of luxury items on display was enough for many ordinary families to struggle a lifetime for.
And it was all filled here.
Dong Zhuo knew how to enjoy, understood the art of enjoyment.
It was evident.
Tap, tap!
A regimented, hurried footstep sound came from ahead.
Ding Ling turned towards the sound.
He saw a familiar, sturdy, heroic figure.
"Lü Bu."
Ding Ling's pupils slightly contracted, but soon he felt relieved.
Now he was a deity!
Not just one Lü Bu.
Even ten, a hundred, facing him, could only kneel.
"Ding Ling!"
Lü Bu, holding the Heaven-piercing Halberd, glanced behind Ding Ling, seeing only one soldier in Xiliang Army armor, no others, he was amazed:
"Did you come in alone?!"
"What else?"
Ding Ling retorted:
"Do you intend to stop me?"
"No, no, no."
Chen Gong rushed out from one side, standing between Lü Bu and Ding Ling, smiling awkwardly:
"Ding Ling, Lü Bu certainly has no intention of opposing you. You are free to proceed to find Prime Minister Dong."

chapters.title: Chapter 242 242: Slaying Dong Zhuo (4/17)
paragraphs: "Hmph."
Lü Bu snorted coldly, with some disdain and anger:

"Chen Gong went to Wan City, and after returning he was mumbling. He said you're unparalleled, possessing unpredictable might, like a Celestial God overlooking the mortal realm, boundless to the extreme. Heh heh..."
He scoffed:

"I certainly know Ding Ling is very strong. Otherwise, I wouldn't have agreed to let Chen Gong meet you. But it seems you've bought him off? Or maybe you've indeed bewitched and enchanted him, making him single-mindedly try to hinder me from fighting with you. How absurd and laughable!"
"Is that so?"
Ding Ling didn't waste words, directly walking towards Lü Bu:
"Then I'll let you witness what it means to have unpredictable might."
"Ding Ling."
Chen Gong couldn't help but shout.
"Don't worry."
Ding Ling didn't look at Chen Gong:
"I won't kill him. The premise is that he has no intent to kill or murderous thoughts towards me. Otherwise, I don't mind slaughtering him."
"You!"
Lü Bu was enraged, the Heaven-piercing Halberd slightly trembling as he thrust it towards Ding Ling:

"I know your Overlord Halberd Technique has reached the Transformation Realm! But do you know that since we parted that day? I've been training day and night, and now I've progressed further. I will definitely not lose to you again!"
In response to Lü Bu was Ding Ling's Giant Que Sword!
A sword strike unleashed!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Majestic Vigorous Qi surged forth like waves, rapidly condensing a dazzling golden Human Emperor Pattern mid-air.
The pattern seemed solid, as the Giant Que Sword slashed down, rumbling towards Lü Bu's Heaven-piercing Halberd.
Boom!
A loud crash.
Ding Ling's hand didn't move at all.

Yet Lü Bu let out a miserable cry, the Heaven-piercing Halberd was directly knocked away by an unparalleled, overwhelming force, his wrist instantly fractured with a crunch, as if he wasn't dueling a person, but battling the heavens and the earth.
The counter-shock, the massive impact force.
Just in an instant.
Lü Bu was slammed sideways, tumbling to the ground, rolling a few times before barely dissipating the force.
He clutched his broken wrist, looking at Ding Ling with a face full of terror and disbelief:
"You, you, you..."
Ding Ling paid him no further attention, turning to continue deeper into the Imperial Palace.
Leaving Lü Bu with a slightly 'lonely' supreme figure!
Like a deity turned against the mortal world, a feeling of solitude and invincibility filled Ding Ling's entire being!

Lü Bu's body and mind were greatly shaken, his pupils dilated to the extreme, making him appear dumbfounded like an idiot, until Chen Gong pushed him a few times, he seemed to come to his senses, he turned to Chen Gong, mumbling:
"Just now, just now, was it all real?"
"Doesn't your hand hurt?
Chen Gong countered.
Lü Bu couldn't believe it:

"But this is the mortal world. And just a few months ago, I encountered and fought Ding Ling, he was clearly not this strong! How could a person become so terrifying in such a short time! During the duel just now, I felt like I was facing an infinite cosmos, an endless ocean, so powerless, so insignificant, so lost!"
"I don't understand either."
Chen Gong said honestly:
"Just like Cao Mengde and Liu Bei are perplexed why there's someone like Ding Ling in the mortal world. Perhaps he was born as a deity."
Chen Gong sighed, "It's just that recently he's awakened his past life powers as a deity."
Lü Bu looked at Chen Gong as if he was a fool.
Chen Gong was unconcerned, only saying:
"You should be grateful that Ding Ling didn't kill you. Otherwise, you'd definitely be a dead man by now."
Lü Bu's face was ashen, but he had to admit that Chen Gong was right.
"Find a time to thank him with me."
Chen Gong said:

"Put down all your pride. Because right now, in Ding Ling's eyes, you're just an ant! If you don't want to die, you'd better not anger him, and if you don't want Ding Ling to settle scores later, you'd better apologize and thank him."
Lü Bu endured the intense pain in his wrist, nodding with a gloomy face.
At the same time.
An absolute yearning for power surged continuously in his heart!
He must become someone like Ding Ling!
A person like a god!
Ding Ling didn't kill Lü Bu.
Naturally, Chen Gong's persuasion played a certain role.
Moreover, Ding Ling also hoped Lü Bu could be used by Cao Mengde, using his rightful 'efforts' for the integration and unification of this world.
If a Flying General like Lü Bu were to die just like that, it would indeed be a waste of talent.
Death, he'd better die on the path to unifying the world!
That way, resources won't be overly wasted.
Moreover, compared to the brutal Dong Zhuo's Legion.
Lü Bu's Army is better restrained by Zhang Liao and others.
This is also why Ding Ling held back slightly.
Otherwise, Lü Bu wouldn't just have a broken wrist, but would have been killed outright!
Clip clop!
Ding Ling held the Giant Que Sword, steadily advancing into the Imperial Palace.
Along the way, anyone daring to block him.
A swing of the Giant Que Sword, either displaying the prowess of Calm Wind Swordsmanship; or activating Qing Frost Swordsmanship.
These two High Tier sword skills are indeed unrivaled weapons for harvesting ordinary soldiers.
Sweeping snowflakes;
The blowing calm wind;
Where he passed, severed limbs and arms fell all over, rivers of blood flowing enough to float a pestle.
Everyone viewed Ding Ling as a Demon God.
Later.
Seeing Ding Ling.
No one dared to block him anymore.
Because all the generals who dared to block Ding Ling were slain.
Just like soldiers, dying without value.
Ultimately.
Ding Ling found Dong Zhuo in the palace where the Empress resided.
He was tall and robust, with a body like a tiger.
But maybe due to age, or perhaps due to recent indulgence.
He had become increasingly obese.
His face was as round as a ball, grotesquely hard to look at.
However, despite this.
He still exuded formidable might.
His eyes radiated intimidating light.
He looked at Ding Ling, as if an emperor looking at a Martial Arts Expert, with the unique pressure of a superior:

"Ding Ling, belong to me. I can give you supreme power, glory, countless beauties, gold and silver! Make you a person above people, below only one and above thousands! The whole world, the entire court will obey your command, fall under your rule, what do you think?"
"I think you're fantasizing!"
Ding Ling raised the Giant Que Sword.
Dong Zhuo's eyes showed a hint of panic, he seemed to be pretending to be calm, loudly saying:
"Ding Ling, wait! What do you want to spare me?"
"Just cut off your head, then naturally you can be spared."
As the voice fell.
Ding Ling didn't wait for Dong Zhuo to respond, a wave of his hand.
Clang!
The sword blade rang out, strands of clear wind blew past Dong Zhuo like lightning.
Dong Zhuo's towering figure was cut into pieces.
A fat head fell from his body.
Rolling, spinning, it stopped at Ding Ling's feet.
Ding Ling looked down.
Seeing Dong Zhuo's eyes filled with fear, disbelief, confusion, remorse, regret, sighs, and other complex emotions!

sentences.text: "Hmph."
Lü Bu snorted coldly, with some disdain and anger:
"Chen Gong went to Wan City, and after returning he was mumbling.
He said you're unparalleled, possessing unpredictable might, like a Celestial God overlooking the mortal realm, boundless to the extreme.
Heh heh..."
He scoffed:
"I certainly know Ding Ling is very strong.
Otherwise, I wouldn't have agreed to let Chen Gong meet you.
But it seems you've bought him off?
Or maybe you've indeed bewitched and enchanted him, making him single-mindedly try to hinder me from fighting with you.
How absurd and laughable!"
"Is that so?"
Ding Ling didn't waste words, directly walking towards Lü Bu:
"Then I'll let you witness what it means to have unpredictable might."
"Ding Ling."
Chen Gong couldn't help but shout.
"Don't worry."
Ding Ling didn't look at Chen Gong:
"I won't kill him.
The premise is that he has no intent to kill or murderous thoughts towards me.
Otherwise, I don't mind slaughtering him."
"You!"
Lü Bu was enraged, the Heaven-piercing Halberd slightly trembling as he thrust it towards Ding Ling:
"I know your Overlord Halberd Technique has reached the Transformation Realm!
But do you know that since we parted that day?
I've been training day and night, and now I've progressed further.
I will definitely not lose to you again!"
In response to Lü Bu was Ding Ling's Giant Que Sword!
A sword strike unleashed!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Majestic Vigorous Qi surged forth like waves, rapidly condensing a dazzling golden Human Emperor Pattern mid-air.
The pattern seemed solid, as the Giant Que Sword slashed down, rumbling towards Lü Bu's Heaven-piercing Halberd.
Boom!
A loud crash.
Ding Ling's hand didn't move at all.

Yet Lü Bu let out a miserable cry, the Heaven-piercing Halberd was directly knocked away by an unparalleled, overwhelming force, his wrist instantly fractured with a crunch, as if he wasn't dueling a person, but battling the heavens and the earth.
The counter-shock, the massive impact force.
Just in an instant.
Lü Bu was slammed sideways, tumbling to the ground, rolling a few times before barely dissipating the force.
He clutched his broken wrist, looking at Ding Ling with a face full of terror and disbelief:
"You, you, you..."
Ding Ling paid him no further attention, turning to continue deeper into the Imperial Palace.
Leaving Lü Bu with a slightly 'lonely' supreme figure!
Like a deity turned against the mortal world, a feeling of solitude and invincibility filled Ding Ling's entire being!

Lü Bu's body and mind were greatly shaken, his pupils dilated to the extreme, making him appear dumbfounded like an idiot, until Chen Gong pushed him a few times, he seemed to come to his senses, he turned to Chen Gong, mumbling:
"Just now, just now, was it all real?"
"Doesn't your hand hurt?
Chen Gong countered.
Lü Bu couldn't believe it:
"But this is the mortal world.
And just a few months ago, I encountered and fought Ding Ling, he was clearly not this strong!
How could a person become so terrifying in such a short time!
During the duel just now, I felt like I was facing an infinite cosmos, an endless ocean, so powerless, so insignificant, so lost!"
"I don't understand either."
Chen Gong said honestly:
"Just like Cao Mengde and Liu Bei are perplexed why there's someone like Ding Ling in the mortal world.
Perhaps he was born as a deity."
Chen Gong sighed, "It's just that recently he's awakened his past life powers as a deity."
Lü Bu looked at Chen Gong as if he was a fool.
Chen Gong was unconcerned, only saying:
"You should be grateful that Ding Ling didn't kill you.
Otherwise, you'd definitely be a dead man by now."
Lü Bu's face was ashen, but he had to admit that Chen Gong was right.
"Find a time to thank him with me."
Chen Gong said:
"Put down all your pride.
Because right now, in Ding Ling's eyes, you're just an ant!
If you don't want to die, you'd better not anger him, and if you don't want Ding Ling to settle scores later, you'd better apologize and thank him."
Lü Bu endured the intense pain in his wrist, nodding with a gloomy face.
At the same time.
An absolute yearning for power surged continuously in his heart!
He must become someone like Ding Ling!
A person like a god!
Ding Ling didn't kill Lü Bu.
Naturally, Chen Gong's persuasion played a certain role.
Moreover, Ding Ling also hoped Lü Bu could be used by Cao Mengde, using his rightful 'efforts' for the integration and unification of this world.
If a Flying General like Lü Bu were to die just like that, it would indeed be a waste of talent.
Death, he'd better die on the path to unifying the world!
That way, resources won't be overly wasted.
Moreover, compared to the brutal Dong Zhuo's Legion.
Lü Bu's Army is better restrained by Zhang Liao and others.
This is also why Ding Ling held back slightly.
Otherwise, Lü Bu wouldn't just have a broken wrist, but would have been killed outright!
Clip clop!
Ding Ling held the Giant Que Sword, steadily advancing into the Imperial Palace.
Along the way, anyone daring to block him.
A swing of the Giant Que Sword, either displaying the prowess of Calm Wind Swordsmanship; or activating Qing Frost Swordsmanship.
These two High Tier sword skills are indeed unrivaled weapons for harvesting ordinary soldiers.
Sweeping snowflakes;
The blowing calm wind;
Where he passed, severed limbs and arms fell all over, rivers of blood flowing enough to float a pestle.
Everyone viewed Ding Ling as a Demon God.
Later.

chapters.title: Chapter 243 243: Cao Mengde Ascends the Throne! Grand General of the Realm
paragraphs: [Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidate Dong Zhuo.]
[Note: Dong Zhuo is cruel and bloodthirsty, uncontrollable! Even after the lords united against him, forcing the capital to relocate!
He remained self-indulgent, becoming even more brutal and ruthless!
He indulged in pleasures, arrogant and wanton. No one in the court mattered to him.
In his eyes, everyone was a pawn or a tool, including Lü Bu and Li Ru.
He thought he could enjoy the rest of his life in the Chang'an Ancient City, but your appearance shattered his hopes!
He couldn't believe that there could be someone as strong as you in this world!
Your presence overturned his established beliefs and worldview!
He wanted to resist but found his martial power utterly powerless against your speed and strength!
He didn't want to die; he was terrified, scared, regretful.
His greatest regret was perhaps not recruiting you when you were in Luoyang City. If he had subdued you like Lü Bu in advance,
wouldn't he, Dong Zhuo, have become truly invincible?]
Hearing the prompt sound.
Ding Ling was stunned.
Even in death, Dong Zhuo was still lost in unrealistic fantasies!
No matter who Ding Ling sided with, he would never align with someone as unscrupulous as Dong Zhuo!
Ding Ling directly had the players pick up Dong Zhuo's head from the ground and walked out of the palace gates.
Outside the palace gates.
Liu Bei, Cao Mengde, and others were waiting.
When they saw the head held by the player behind Ding Ling, they all looked dazed as if witnessing a dream!
"Ding Ling actually did it! Alone, with a horse and a sword, he fought from outside Hulao Pass all the way to Chang'an City! He completely dismantled and destroyed Dong Zhuo's army!
Even the thief Dong's head was taken down! So powerful!"
Young men like Sun Ce and Ma Chao looked at Ding Ling with faces full of admiration, seeing Zhou Yi as a deity, an idol, a milestone on the road ahead!
"Truly a man who can stand shoulder to shoulder with the gods!"
Han Sui, Gongsun Zan, Liu Bei, Ma Teng, and others felt a chill to the core, completely abandoning any thoughts of opposing Ding Ling and Cao Mengde.
The immense faction of Dong Zhuo.
Was resolved by Ding Ling as if chopping vegetables, so easily.
Their strength was far less than Dong Zhuo's!
One can only imagine the consequences and aftermath of opposing Ding Ling!
What followed was a natural progression.
Han Sui, Gongsun Zan, Liu Biao, and others, seeing no hope, all conformed to the great trend and joined Cao Mengde's team.
Cao Mengde couldn't contain his joy, often waking up laughing in his sleep at night.
He was truly so happy and elated!
He couldn't help himself!
The Han Emperor still existed.
But everyone knew he was just a puppet.
Ding Ling didn't care what Liu Xie, the young emperor, and officials like Wang Yun thought of him and directly had Cao Mengde become the emperor!
And held the coronation ceremony right in the Chang'an Ancient City!
At first, Cao Mengde was anxious and uneasy with three parts nervousness and excitement.
But he was no ordinary person.
After truly ascending the throne, he quickly displayed his extraordinary, iron-fisted measures.
A group of ministers extremely loyal to the Han Emperor was directly swept out of the court!
One by one, young, courageous, and capable ministers were promoted to higher positions.
Among these capable ministers were sons of humble origins and also players.
Cao Mengde's ability to recruit talents without sticking to forms was evident at a glance.
Ding Ling didn't participate in the enthronement, construction, or reforms, etc.
But the occasional prompt sound reminded him.
His reputation had truly resounded throughout Jiuzhou.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane Strongmen: 47/20.]
The first task was already exceeded.
After Ding Ling continuously defeated top-tier experts like Guan Yu, Yann Xing, Zhang Fei, Dian Wei, Xiahou Dun, Le Jin, Li Dian, Cao Ren, Gongsun Zan, Ma Chao.
He had already exceeded the completion of this task.
Arriving at the Si Li Region.
Battling all the way.
The top experts he killed included Li Jue, Guo Si, Dong Zhuo, and Fan Chou, significantly advancing his task progress.
Ding Ling knew.
The more Plane Strongmen he defeated, the more honor bonuses he would receive. He just didn't know how much his honor bonus was now?
Apart from that...
[3: You must make your War God name known throughout the entire Plane World. 89%/100%.]
From 59%.
It shot up to 89%.
The task looked about to be completed.
Ding Ling felt quite thrilled.
He knew that after completing the task, it might be the time when he could leave the Three Kingdoms World at any moment and head to a more powerful, advanced Plane World!
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: You have already become the National Guardian Grand General of Great Wei!]

[Note: Ten days after Cao Mengde's ascension. He overcame all opposition, recommending you as the first Divine General, the Guardian God of Great Wei, the Guardian God of Jiuzhou, the World's Number One Sword God, Great Wei National Preceptor, Great Wei Grand General...]
Ding Ling was astonished.
Cao Mengde really is something.
This series of titles.
He was blinded by them all.
Yet becoming a Grand General earned him an E-level Achievement Medal.
It seems that Cao Mengde's Great Wei Kingdom has been recognized and is about to rise!
"Before heading to Jizhou, let's first study these Divine Skill Secret Manuals."
At this moment, Ding Ling was staying in the study of a mansion.
This was Guo Si's mansion, extremely luxurious and spacious.
It could comfortably house hundreds of people.
Cao Mengde immediately declared this mansion as Ding Ling's.
Naturally, no one dared to object.
Ding Ling took residence accordingly.
During this time.
While Cao Mengde was busy, his feet never touching the ground, he did not forget what he promised Ding Ling.
Manuals after manuals were swiftly sent.
Among those manuals.
Many were sourced from the Royal Treasury of Chang'an Ancient City, and Dong Zhuo's Meiwu!
Of course.
The mansions of Li Jue, Fan Chou, Guo Si were also scavenged thoroughly.
Some of the top-tier items, manuals, Divine Weapons scavenged were sent straight to Ding Ling, who got first pick. Only after his selections could Liu Bei and others have a chance!
Ding Ling's priority was always first!
This was Cao Mengde's prior promise; he indeed kept his word, perfectly handling each promise to Ding Ling, either accomplished or in progress!
"Warm Jade Sword Technique."
Ding Ling opened the first manual.
Finished it quickly.
A new book immediately appeared on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Warm Jade Sword Technique Full Level]
This was a top-level Sword Skill Manual.
It was Cao Mengde's ancestral sword technique!
Quite remarkable!
Once performed, the whole sky would be filled with enchanting warm jade illusions!
In the instant when one's heart and spirit faltered, a glimmer of sword light seemed to pierce through from dawn, capable of shattering everything in an explosion!
This is an extremely crafty and bizarre sword technique.
It's the Cao Family's clan-level skill.
Cao Mengde's willingness to share it demonstrated his extraordinary vision.
Ma Teng, Sun Jian, and others simply couldn't bear to part with theirs.
The manuals they could offer were all seized from other places, the real ancestral manuals were never given.
After reading the Warm Jade Sword Technique manual, Ding Ling closed it.
