chapters.title: Chapter 244 244: Hundreds of Secret Manuals at Full Level! All Disciplines Mastered
paragraphs: Start flipping through the second secret manual.
Quickly.
Another book appeared on the bookshelf.
In an instant.
[Moon Shadow Swordsmanship Full Level]
This is also a top-notch sword technique secret manual.
It comes from the Xiahou Clan.
Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, and Cao Mengde have extraordinary relationships, voluntarily offering their clan's supreme skills.
Moon Shadow Swordsmanship is just one volume of the sword technique manuals.
Once this sword technique is activated, it will sketch a crescent pattern in the void, following the sword blade, with immense power, unfathomable.
The third secret manual.
[Breaking Army Spear Skill Full Level]
This is the spear technique of the Xiahou Family.

It is a top-notch spear technique secret manual, a battlefield secret technique for breaking army formations, once unleashed, the passionate Blood Evil Qi sweeps across all directions, extremely captivating.
The fourth secret manual:
[Howling Moon Sword Technique Full Level!]
Obtained from Dong Zhuo's Meiwu library. It is the Royal Secret Skill after being swapped by the Yuan Family over four generations and Three Ministers.
Though inferior to Human Emperor Swordsmanship.
It is still a remarkable sword technique, extremely exceptional.
The fifth:
[Slaughter Void Saber Technique Full Level]
It was all collected from Guo Si Mansion.
The sixth...
Hundreds of secret manuals!
About twenty high-tier martial arts secret manuals!
More than ten top-level Breathing Technique secret manuals!
Dozens of ordinary Breathing Technique secret manuals!
Hundreds of low-tier martial arts secret manuals!
Hundreds of fragmented martial arts secret manuals.
Ding Ling finished reading them all.
Even if reading ten lines, a hundred lines at a glance, Ding Ling spent several hours!
Reading books like flipping through books.
It still took such a long time.
It shows how great Ding Ling's harvest is this time!
Except for Breathing Technique, all the martial arts are max level!
Even the broken moves can be full level!
His foundation is crazily growing! Now in the martial arts aspect, his roots are as solid as a mountain! Indestructible!
"The control over power is also continuously improving."

Ding Ling carefully perceives, very clearly sensing that now his control over the power of the Celestial Human Realm is becoming more and more adept and proficient, even the vast and boundless deity-like power can now be wielded much easier than before.
This is the result of enhanced foundation!
Just like a person's physical quality getting better, his immunity will surely be higher, a similar principle.
"Not bad."
Ding Ling is very satisfied.
He continues to flip through the secret manuals.

This time he is reading about military strategy, state governance, chess manuals, medical books, Legalist school secret traditions, Mo Family scholarship, Confucian classics, strategist doctrines, Daoist scriptures, and other secret manuals.
After some time.
All secret manuals are max level.
[Wisdom +0.2]
[Charm +0.8]
"A total of over a thousand secret manuals from Confucianism, Daoism, etc., only increased wisdom by 0.2 and charm by 0.8?!"
Ding Ling feels a bit helpless.
Wisdom is too hard to increase.
It's pretty good for charm to increase by 0.8.

After all, these secret manuals are not true supreme skill classics like Qingnang Scripture or Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, but just books of academic category, with a small part containing related supreme skills, but they are also fragmented.
But for Ding Ling, having them is better than not having them.
Whether fragmented or not, he learns them all, anyway they reach max level instantly, he has read, learned, and mastered them, making them part of his knowledge system.
"It seems not easy to increase wisdom."
Ding Ling muses:
"Just like my innate aptitude, no matter how many full-level Divine Skills I learn, it remains at 1 point!"
"To significantly increase wisdom, perhaps it requires special opportunities!"
Wisdom and innate aptitude are inborn.
And for adults, they are set!
To change them requires special opportunities.
Ding Ling can increase some wisdom by reading full-level Daoist, Military School, and other articles, which is already rare.
"After increasing wisdom, the mind becomes much clearer, and the ability to sense danger seems to have risen somewhat."
After careful reflection, Ding Ling understands.
Reached the Celestial Human Realm.
He is just like a deity in this world.
Perceiving subtle changes within his body is easily achievable.
In the real world, it's not so easy.
It shows that each world has its special characteristics, cannot be mixed.
"It's time to set off."
Ding Ling walked out of the retreat space.
Went to the hall.
Met Zhao Yun who had been waiting for a long time.
He captured Li Meng.
The reason for capturing Li Meng.
Is quite simple.
When Ding Ling came to Luoyang last time.
Hu Feng blocked the gate.

Hu Feng said it was Li Meng who leaked the information to him. Additionally emphasized that Li Meng deduced the likeliness of the two people fitting the images of the two great experts defeating Hu Zhen's army, possibly being Ding Ling and Zhao Yun!
Although Hu Feng said to just grab two scapegoats.
But it cannot be denied that one of the sources of all this is Li Meng.
Ding Ling questioned Li Meng about this.
Li Meng trembled and said:
"It was Duanmu Qing who bribed and enchanted me to do this."
"Duanmu Qing?"
A hairless, fair face suddenly flashed in Ding Ling's mind.
"He is the Court Officer!"
Li Meng added.
"It's indeed this guy."
Ding Ling had already got related evidence before, felt it's highly likely to be this guy.
Now Li Meng also says so, then it must be right.
He asked:
"Where is Duanmu Qing?"
"Escaped."
"Immediately lead a team to hunt Duanmu Qing, just focus on the places he appears or disappears, once he appears, kill him, if you can make him not dare to show up for a year, I'll spare you."
Ding Ling looks at Li Meng:
"Otherwise, just take your own life!"
Li Meng exhales in relief and instantly tenses up, under Ding Ling's indifferent gaze, can only swear a military vow, stating success or death!
"Don't think about running, even if you run to the ends of the earth, I have a way to execute your nine clans!"
Ding Ling coldly states.
Nine clans...
Li Meng shivers, not caring for his own life. If truly implicates the nine clans, he cannot atone for his sins even in death!
He is remorseful, regretful.
If he knew Ding Ling is someone akin to a deity.
Even with ten guts, he wouldn't dare to frame Ding Ling!
Simultaneously.
He also hates Duanmu Qing with gritted teeth.
If not for Duanmu Qing, how could he have this unwarranted disaster.
If not kill Duanmu Qing into a mental shadow.
Li Meng definitely won't stop!
The development of Duanmu Qing's follow-up hardly needs to say.
Under Li Meng's exceptionally strong action capability.
Duanmu Qing was hunted till skill level zero.
Finally dared not to come online.
And crazily sprayed negative comments about Ding Ling on the network in real life, saying various bad things about Ding Ling.
To this, Ding Ling ignores.
He has not yet reached the point where he can act recklessly in the real world.
Otherwise.
Duanmu Qing wouldn't have enough lives for Ding Ling to kill.
However, being able to kill Duanmu Qing to level 0 in the game world, completely cutting off his future, is also very satisfying for Ding Ling.
He was forced to flee Luoyang City earlier.
Swore to kill those scheming against him to level 0.
Now Duanmu Qing's skill levels are zero.

sentences.text: Start flipping through the second secret manual.
Quickly.
Another book appeared on the bookshelf.
In an instant.
[Moon Shadow Swordsmanship Full Level]
This is also a top-notch sword technique secret manual.
It comes from the Xiahou Clan.
Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, and Cao Mengde have extraordinary relationships, voluntarily offering their clan's supreme skills.
Moon Shadow Swordsmanship is just one volume of the sword technique manuals.
Once this sword technique is activated, it will sketch a crescent pattern in the void, following the sword blade, with immense power, unfathomable.
The third secret manual.
[Breaking Army Spear Skill Full Level]
This is the spear technique of the Xiahou Family.

It is a top-notch spear technique secret manual, a battlefield secret technique for breaking army formations, once unleashed, the passionate Blood Evil Qi sweeps across all directions, extremely captivating.
The fourth secret manual:
[Howling Moon Sword Technique Full Level!]
Obtained from Dong Zhuo's Meiwu library.
It is the Royal Secret Skill after being swapped by the Yuan Family over four generations and Three Ministers.
Though inferior to Human Emperor Swordsmanship.
It is still a remarkable sword technique, extremely exceptional.
The fifth:
[Slaughter Void Saber Technique Full Level]
It was all collected from Guo Si Mansion.
The sixth...
Hundreds of secret manuals!
About twenty high-tier martial arts secret manuals!
More than ten top-level Breathing Technique secret manuals!
Dozens of ordinary Breathing Technique secret manuals!
Hundreds of low-tier martial arts secret manuals!
Hundreds of fragmented martial arts secret manuals.
Ding Ling finished reading them all.
Even if reading ten lines, a hundred lines at a glance, Ding Ling spent several hours!
Reading books like flipping through books.
It still took such a long time.
It shows how great Ding Ling's harvest is this time!
Except for Breathing Technique, all the martial arts are max level!
Even the broken moves can be full level!
His foundation is crazily growing!
Now in the martial arts aspect, his roots are as solid as a mountain!
Indestructible!
"The control over power is also continuously improving."

Ding Ling carefully perceives, very clearly sensing that now his control over the power of the Celestial Human Realm is becoming more and more adept and proficient, even the vast and boundless deity-like power can now be wielded much easier than before.
This is the result of enhanced foundation!
Just like a person's physical quality getting better, his immunity will surely be higher, a similar principle.
"Not bad."
Ding Ling is very satisfied.
He continues to flip through the secret manuals.

This time he is reading about military strategy, state governance, chess manuals, medical books, Legalist school secret traditions, Mo Family scholarship, Confucian classics, strategist doctrines, Daoist scriptures, and other secret manuals.
After some time.
All secret manuals are max level.
[Wisdom +0.2]
[Charm +0.8]
"A total of over a thousand secret manuals from Confucianism, Daoism, etc., only increased wisdom by 0.2 and charm by 0.8?!"
Ding Ling feels a bit helpless.
Wisdom is too hard to increase.
It's pretty good for charm to increase by 0.8.

After all, these secret manuals are not true supreme skill classics like Qingnang Scripture or Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, but just books of academic category, with a small part containing related supreme skills, but they are also fragmented.
But for Ding Ling, having them is better than not having them.
Whether fragmented or not, he learns them all, anyway they reach max level instantly, he has read, learned, and mastered them, making them part of his knowledge system.
"It seems not easy to increase wisdom."
Ding Ling muses:
"Just like my innate aptitude, no matter how many full-level Divine Skills I learn, it remains at 1 point!"
"To significantly increase wisdom, perhaps it requires special opportunities!"
Wisdom and innate aptitude are inborn.
And for adults, they are set!
To change them requires special opportunities.
Ding Ling can increase some wisdom by reading full-level Daoist, Military School, and other articles, which is already rare.
"After increasing wisdom, the mind becomes much clearer, and the ability to sense danger seems to have risen somewhat."
After careful reflection, Ding Ling understands.
Reached the Celestial Human Realm.
He is just like a deity in this world.
Perceiving subtle changes within his body is easily achievable.
In the real world, it's not so easy.
It shows that each world has its special characteristics, cannot be mixed.
"It's time to set off."
Ding Ling walked out of the retreat space.
Went to the hall.
Met Zhao Yun who had been waiting for a long time.
He captured Li Meng.
The reason for capturing Li Meng.
Is quite simple.
When Ding Ling came to Luoyang last time.
Hu Feng blocked the gate.
Hu Feng said it was Li Meng who leaked the information to him.
Additionally emphasized that Li Meng deduced the likeliness of the two people fitting the images of the two great experts defeating Hu Zhen's army, possibly being Ding Ling and Zhao Yun!
Although Hu Feng said to just grab two scapegoats.
But it cannot be denied that one of the sources of all this is Li Meng.
Ding Ling questioned Li Meng about this.
Li Meng trembled and said:
"It was Duanmu Qing who bribed and enchanted me to do this."
"Duanmu Qing?"
A hairless, fair face suddenly flashed in Ding Ling's mind.
"He is the Court Officer!"
Li Meng added.
"It's indeed this guy."
Ding Ling had already got related evidence before, felt it's highly likely to be this guy.
Now Li Meng also says so, then it must be right.
He asked:
"Where is Duanmu Qing?"
"Escaped."
"Immediately lead a team to hunt Duanmu Qing, just focus on the places he appears or disappears, once he appears, kill him, if you can make him not dare to show up for a year, I'll spare you."
Ding Ling looks at Li Meng:
"Otherwise, just take your own life!"
Li Meng exhales in relief and instantly tenses up, under Ding Ling's indifferent gaze, can only swear a military vow, stating success or death!
"Don't think about running, even if you run to the ends of the earth, I have a way to execute your nine clans!"
Ding Ling coldly states.
Nine clans...
Li Meng shivers, not caring for his own life.
If truly implicates the nine clans, he cannot atone for his sins even in death!
He is remorseful, regretful.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 245: Guan Yu's Desire! One Man Conquers a Hundred Cities
paragraphs: The true personal level has not yet reached level 0.
How could Ding Ling possibly give up on killing him like this!
Instinctively, Ding Ling felt that if a person's personal level returned to zero, something terrible would definitely happen.
Bring Duanmu Qing down until his personal level returns to zero.
Consider that a tit for tat.
Of course.
That was a matter for later.
Time flows back.
After Li Meng walked away with a face full of awe and deference.
Ding Ling went to find Cao Mengde, talking about the strategy to conquer the land of Jizhou.
Cao Mengde was overjoyed.
They said it was a strategy.
Actually, it's just following Ding Ling to take over the territory!
This is also the reason he dared to truly ascend the throne and begun to boldly implement reforms, clearing away various 'messy things' and 'useless people'!
If Ding Ling were slightly weaker.
He wouldn't dare.
Because there were too many supporters of the Han!
The established old factions were too strong; if not handled well, he would be overturned into the sea with his people and ship, leaving no trace!
Even with Ding Ling as a backup!
He was extremely cautious about his diet and other aspects, fearing poisoning, or when going out, he had Dian Wei and Xuu Chu as bodyguards to prevent an assassination attempt.
As for Ding Ling, he had no such concerns; his diet was handled by Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao. As for guards? No one could break his defense; what need did he have for guards?
Ding Ling certainly knew the terrors of old powers.
And also understood that water can carry a boat but also capsize it!
Especially in the 'water' of the Three Kingdoms World, which had vast depths, currents churning violently! One careless move could result in disaster at every turn!
But Ding Ling from the beginning never intended to play with military strategy or schemes with others.
He wanted to overcome them head-on!
Anyone daring to block him, he would kill!
Killing off these old factions.
Naturally, a group supporting the new powers would be born!
This world.
The swap of new heaven for old happens every few hundred years or decades!
Ding Ling was almost like a Land God.
If even he dared not replace the old heaven with the new!
Who would dare?
The journey through Jizhou was quite smooth.
Ding Ling went through obstacles and adversaries with ease.
One horse, one sword, one man, wherever he went, he swept all before him, unstoppable!
Came to the point.
The generals guarding Jizhou, once spotting Ding Ling riding alone from afar, threw away their armor and fled.
Other soldiers upon seeing this, naturally fled at wind's first whisper, an army in disarray!
Ding Ling managed to intimidate an entire great province alone!
[Achievement Medal Received: One Man Breaks a Hundred Cities!]
[Annotation: On your journey, you alone have broken through a hundred city gate barriers, subdued a hundred defending generals, and intimidated hundreds of defending armies, big and small!]
Ding Ling harvested another achievement medal.
But he did not stop his pace.
He traversed throughout Jizhou, his footsteps never stopping.
Following behind him, Xiahou Dun, Cao Ren, Le Jin, Zhang Fei, Hann Sui, and others were astonished!
Face to face, they couldn't help but sigh in inferiority.
Although having grown accustomed to Ding Ling's speed in overwhelming and harvesting!
They still couldn't help but feel a chilling, spine-shivering sensation.
Just too frightening!
Too worldview shattering!
That one person could truly conquer city gate barriers so effortlessly.
Moreover, his stamina was simply unmatched.
They found themselves nearly exhausted taking over cities and surrendering troops.
Yet Ding Ling remained lively and vigorous.
Having gone several days and nights without sleep!
Ding Ling exhibited no signs of fatigue, remaining vibrant and full of spirit.
Guan Yu's eye twitched, but knowing he had to follow Ding Ling to Ye City to take over surrendering troops there, he could only endure, keeping pace with Ding Ling.
He spurred his horse rapidly, leading elite soldiers alongside Ding Ling.
Ran for several days and nights continuously.
The horse was tired.
The men were nearly collapsing.
Ding Ling seemed unaffected, still conquering lands without pausing in his pace.
His physical strength was strong, stamina was unparalleled, endurance was high.
Sufficient to astonish anyone to their core.
Guan Yu was thoroughly convinced by Ding Ling, willing to obey his every command.
Of course.
Along the way, Guan Yu also sought from Ding Ling guidance on becoming a Celestial Human Realm strongman.
Ding Ling would only reply:
"Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method, chew more Great Medicine."
Guan Yu asked:
"I don't know where the Inner Refining Breathing Technique was learned by the General?"
"Yhiuu Ji."
This was no secret; many players knew, and Zhou Yu, among others, was also aware.
"May I learn from him?"
"Of course. As long as you can learn it."
Upon hearing this, Guan Yu decisively sent a 'Pigeon Post' instructing Liu Bei to go to Yangzhou to seek out Yhiuu Ji for the 'True Scripture'.
The outcome was expected.
No matter how nicely Liu Bei spoke, Yhiuu Ji simply ignored him.
Guan Yu was helpless, only thickening his skin to seek the Inner Refining Breathing Technique Cultivation Skill from Ding Ling.
He truly longed to become a Celestial Human Realm strongman!
Once a person has glimpsed the light of gods!
They would undoubtedly yearn greatly!
Especially after knowing how to become godlike, he couldn't refuse such temptation.
Especially someone like Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Xiahou Dun, who were Martial Fanatics!
Ding Ling simply stated:
"If General Guan is willing to give me the ancestral Technique, I don't mind passing on the Inner Refining Breathing Technique to you."
This was genuine.
In any case, Daoist Yhiuu Ji wouldn't oppose his sharing of the Technique.
Moreover, the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method was extremely difficult to learn.
Even with the Technique.
Whether one can achieve Unity of Inner and Outer is a major issue.
Ding Ling obviously wouldn't guide Guan Yu as meticulously as he did Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, and others; it was only an exchange of Techniques.
However.
Guan Yu remained silent.
Clearly.
He was unwilling.
Ding Ling naturally wouldn't press.
Willing to exchange, then exchange.
If not, just leave it!
He wasn't lacking Martial Arts Techniques!
Besides, currently training Martial Arts wouldn't increase the Four-dimensional Attributes, lowering his desire and urgent need for Martial Arts to historical lows!
His attitude now was completely laid-back.
Best if learning can enhance the foundation and control over power.
If not, no matter, not missing one or two Techniques!
Moreover...
Having come all this way.
Conquering city gate barriers, major clans.
Once Cao Mengde's subordinates organized the harvest.
There would surely be a batch of Martial Arts Secret Manuals sent to him.
Thus.
He became more laid-back.
While Ding Ling was relaxed, Guan Yu, after his silence, became somewhat anxious and rushed.
Especially witnessing Ding Ling easily break the fifty thousand strong army sent by Yuan Shao, directly storming the formation, easily capturing Zhang Hex, Juyi, and others.
His intensifying sense of urgency and desire for the Celestial Human Realm heightened to a peak!
Yet ancestral family rules bound him, placing him in a conflicted situation.
At this moment.
He greatly admired Cao Mengde.
Cao Mengde's free spirit, decisiveness, grandiosity, willing to sacrifice and gain, no wonder Ding Ling favored him.
Just with this trait.
He couldn't compare with Cao Mengde.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 246: The Shock of Zhang Hex and Gao Lan
paragraphs: Ding Ling arrived at Ye City.
Behind him followed Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Juyi, and others.
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Juyi and others felt extremely awkward.
At the same time, each of their eyes was dull and shocked.
Juyi was slightly better off, after all, his relationship with Ding Ling was quite ordinary!
For Zhang Hex and Gao Lan, who could be described as 'both mentor and friend' to Ding Ling, they were so shocked that their souls trembled.
No one knew better than them about Ding Ling's previous combat power!
And how long has it been since then?
Ding Ling is now comparable to a Land God.
One person breaks hundreds of cities!
One person crushes tens of thousands of a great army!
As easily as eating and drinking!
Is this something a human can achieve?!
"Too incredible."
Zhang Hex sighed, dazed:
"If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I would have thought I was dreaming."
"Indeed."
Gao Lan lamented:
"I still remember a few months ago when Ding Ling was learning sword techniques from me, and now look at him. If I wasn't sure it was the same person, I would have thought I got the wrong person!"

"There are all sorts of rumors and gossip about Ding Ling flying around. We were skeptical, simply because some of the gossip was too absurd. But now, it seems, we have a narrow vision! Those rumors were true! Some even downplayed Ding Ling's combat power. Ding Ling is even more terrifying than some rumors suggest!"
Juyi couldn't help interjecting, his expression extremely complex:
"A few months ago, I could still spar with Ding Ling evenly. Now I can't even withstand a single round from him, not to mention being effortlessly killed by him in one round. Too strong."

Thinking of Ding Ling breaking through a pass alone, a single sword causing a bloody storm and limbs flying, moving through the crowd like lightning, seemingly leisurely yet as fast as thunder, unstoppable along the way!
Juyi's body couldn't help but tremble.
This is an exposure of extreme fear and awe!
"A bit hard to accept."
Zhang Hex admitted:
"I'm still standing in place, yet Ding Ling has soared high, making me unable to see his back. To think I used to be his instructor!"
The term "instructor" came from players.
Having interacted with players a lot.
Zhang Hex and others naturally learned some trendy expressions.
They sighed endlessly in the rear.
Ding Ling had already soared like a Feiyan, gently landing on the city wall of Ye City.
In the panicked, furious shouts of the Defender General.
Ding Ling walked step by step towards him as if strolling through a courtyard.
With each step he took, the Giant Que Sword would swing once.
Any soldier daring to block the way would be immediately sent to meet King Yama!
"I surrender!
At the moment before Ding Ling's sword was about to fall.
The Defender General knelt directly.
Loudly shouted:
"I am willing to surrender to the Grand General of the Realm just like Zhang Hex and others!"
The news that Ding Ling was the Great Wei Kingdom's Grand General, Divine General, Guardian God, National Preceptor, and more, had spread all over Jiuzhou by pigeon post.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling sheathed his sword, glanced towards the City Lord's Mansion of Ye City, casually asked:
"Name?"
"I, I am Lü Kuang!"
Lü Kuang, originally a general under Yuan Shao, later surrendered to Cao Mengde, and was ennobled as a Marquis.
This is the original history of Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Now, naturally, it is much different from the original.
Ding Ling glanced at Lü Kuang, a tall and burly man over eight chi, another figure renowned in history.
Ding Ling had encountered too many similar figures during this period.
At this moment, he felt no waves in his heart, just nodded and said:
"Organize your troops, Guan Yu will come to take over later. Just follow his orders."
"Yes, yes, yes."
Lü Kuang's forehead was sweating profusely, bowing humbly nonstop.

Ding Ling was accustomed to this, leaping into the air, akin to a floating Feiyan, crossing several hundred meters with a single bound, landing on the rooftop of a pavilion in Ye City, then 'kicking off the ground', darting across the void several hundred meters.
All the way like lightning straight towards the City Lord's Mansion of Ye City.
Countless people saw this scene along the way.
They were all dumbfounded in shock, unable to believe it!
Yuan Shao also saw it.
Though he was approaching middle age, he was still graceful and handsome.
However, at this moment, his handsome face was filled with fear, confusion, and disbelief.
"What Xun Chen said was actually true!"
"The messenger wasn't lying!"
"The so-called rumors and gossip, it wasn't three people making a tiger, spreading falsehoods in circles! But the truth was just as it is!"
Yuan Shao's face was ashen, as if struck by lightning.
He thought of the messenger he mistakenly killed.
Thought of Xun Chen's earnest advice.
He thought of Hann Fu's curse before death.
Thought of Pan Feng's unwilling warning...
"It was me who overestimated myself, a frog at the bottom of a well, underestimating the heroes of the world!"
Yuan Shao was annoyed, greatly regretting.
If he had known earlier that Ding Ling was truly as powerful as the rumors, like a deity.
He would certainly have thickened his face to go to Wan City to seek cooperation and forgiveness!
Anyway, the Yuan Family direct line was all dead.
And the one who gave the order was the Yuan Family Patriarch, not him, Yuan Shao!
If he were shameless and thick-skinned, perhaps Ding Ling might have chosen him, to ascend and become the emperor of a nation?
He thought of Cao Mengde's rise to power.
After being chosen by Ding Ling.
It was like a lucky streak, continuously rising as if blessed by the god of fortune! Now he had reached heights Yuan Shao could only dream of.
Watching Ding Ling, who was treading through the void, rapidly approaching him.
Yuan Shao felt a bit desperate.
"If I had known, why do it then!"
He knew even if time could flow backward.
Based on his character, he most likely wouldn't go to Wan City, and even if he did, he probably couldn't put down his pride and self-respect!
His defeat was destined.
Who made his enemy someone as powerful and terrifying as Ding Ling, akin to an Immortal?
If only the enemy were weaker.
He might have hope to turn the tables.
But unfortunately...
Ding Ling is no human!
He is a god!
Seeing with his own eyes the thousands of arrows he had arranged around the City Lord's Mansion descending simultaneously, finding Ding Ling unharmed.
Yuan Shao had to admit the so-called rumors were facts!
The anger at Zhang Hex and others' supposed betrayal vanished in an instant, replaced by unwillingness, fear, and a clinging to life.
He wanted to beg for mercy.
But under the watchful eyes of everyone, he couldn't put down his self-respect and dignity.
"Yuan Shao?"
Ding Ling looked at the man in front of him, expressionlessly uttering two words.
Yuan Shao didn't speak.
Ding Ling didn't ask again, just waved his hand.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword, carrying a blade glow several feet long, lightly swept across Yuan Shao and the others' necks.
Several death warriors shouted and charged up to protect Yuan Shao.
They were swept by the long sword qi, either cut in half at the waist, their necks flying, or limbs severed...
In the blink of an eye.
No fewer than dozens died.
Yuan Shao's head fell to the ground, rolling with a gurgling sound, stopped not far from Ding Ling's feet.

sentences.text: Ding Ling arrived at Ye City.
Behind him followed Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Juyi, and others.
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Juyi and others felt extremely awkward.
At the same time, each of their eyes was dull and shocked.
Juyi was slightly better off, after all, his relationship with Ding Ling was quite ordinary!
For Zhang Hex and Gao Lan, who could be described as 'both mentor and friend' to Ding Ling, they were so shocked that their souls trembled.
No one knew better than them about Ding Ling's previous combat power!
And how long has it been since then?
Ding Ling is now comparable to a Land God.
One person breaks hundreds of cities!
One person crushes tens of thousands of a great army!
As easily as eating and drinking!
Is this something a human can achieve?!
"Too incredible."
Zhang Hex sighed, dazed:
"If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I would have thought I was dreaming."
"Indeed."
Gao Lan lamented:
"I still remember a few months ago when Ding Ling was learning sword techniques from me, and now look at him.
If I wasn't sure it was the same person, I would have thought I got the wrong person!"
"There are all sorts of rumors and gossip about Ding Ling flying around.
We were skeptical, simply because some of the gossip was too absurd.
But now, it seems, we have a narrow vision!
Those rumors were true!
Some even downplayed Ding Ling's combat power.
Ding Ling is even more terrifying than some rumors suggest!"
Juyi couldn't help interjecting, his expression extremely complex:
"A few months ago, I could still spar with Ding Ling evenly.
Now I can't even withstand a single round from him, not to mention being effortlessly killed by him in one round.
Too strong."

Thinking of Ding Ling breaking through a pass alone, a single sword causing a bloody storm and limbs flying, moving through the crowd like lightning, seemingly leisurely yet as fast as thunder, unstoppable along the way!
Juyi's body couldn't help but tremble.
This is an exposure of extreme fear and awe!
"A bit hard to accept."
Zhang Hex admitted:
"I'm still standing in place, yet Ding Ling has soared high, making me unable to see his back.
To think I used to be his instructor!"
The term "instructor" came from players.
Having interacted with players a lot.
Zhang Hex and others naturally learned some trendy expressions.
They sighed endlessly in the rear.
Ding Ling had already soared like a Feiyan, gently landing on the city wall of Ye City.
In the panicked, furious shouts of the Defender General.
Ding Ling walked step by step towards him as if strolling through a courtyard.
With each step he took, the Giant Que Sword would swing once.
Any soldier daring to block the way would be immediately sent to meet King Yama!
"I surrender!
At the moment before Ding Ling's sword was about to fall.
The Defender General knelt directly.
Loudly shouted:
"I am willing to surrender to the Grand General of the Realm just like Zhang Hex and others!"
The news that Ding Ling was the Great Wei Kingdom's Grand General, Divine General, Guardian God, National Preceptor, and more, had spread all over Jiuzhou by pigeon post.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling sheathed his sword, glanced towards the City Lord's Mansion of Ye City, casually asked:
"Name?"
"I, I am Lü Kuang!"
Lü Kuang, originally a general under Yuan Shao, later surrendered to Cao Mengde, and was ennobled as a Marquis.
This is the original history of Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Now, naturally, it is much different from the original.
Ding Ling glanced at Lü Kuang, a tall and burly man over eight chi, another figure renowned in history.
Ding Ling had encountered too many similar figures during this period.
At this moment, he felt no waves in his heart, just nodded and said:
"Organize your troops, Guan Yu will come to take over later.
Just follow his orders."
"Yes, yes, yes."
Lü Kuang's forehead was sweating profusely, bowing humbly nonstop.

Ding Ling was accustomed to this, leaping into the air, akin to a floating Feiyan, crossing several hundred meters with a single bound, landing on the rooftop of a pavilion in Ye City, then 'kicking off the ground', darting across the void several hundred meters.
All the way like lightning straight towards the City Lord's Mansion of Ye City.
Countless people saw this scene along the way.
They were all dumbfounded in shock, unable to believe it!
Yuan Shao also saw it.
Though he was approaching middle age, he was still graceful and handsome.
However, at this moment, his handsome face was filled with fear, confusion, and disbelief.
"What Xun Chen said was actually true!"
"The messenger wasn't lying!"
"The so-called rumors and gossip, it wasn't three people making a tiger, spreading falsehoods in circles!
But the truth was just as it is!"
Yuan Shao's face was ashen, as if struck by lightning.
He thought of the messenger he mistakenly killed.
Thought of Xun Chen's earnest advice.
He thought of Hann Fu's curse before death.
Thought of Pan Feng's unwilling warning...
"It was me who overestimated myself, a frog at the bottom of a well, underestimating the heroes of the world!"
Yuan Shao was annoyed, greatly regretting.
If he had known earlier that Ding Ling was truly as powerful as the rumors, like a deity.
He would certainly have thickened his face to go to Wan City to seek cooperation and forgiveness!
Anyway, the Yuan Family direct line was all dead.
And the one who gave the order was the Yuan Family Patriarch, not him, Yuan Shao!
If he were shameless and thick-skinned, perhaps Ding Ling might have chosen him, to ascend and become the emperor of a nation?
He thought of Cao Mengde's rise to power.
After being chosen by Ding Ling.
It was like a lucky streak, continuously rising as if blessed by the god of fortune!
Now he had reached heights Yuan Shao could only dream of.
Watching Ding Ling, who was treading through the void, rapidly approaching him.
Yuan Shao felt a bit desperate.
"If I had known, why do it then!"
He knew even if time could flow backward.
Based on his character, he most likely wouldn't go to Wan City, and even if he did, he probably couldn't put down his pride and self-respect!
His defeat was destined.
Who made his enemy someone as powerful and terrifying as Ding Ling, akin to an Immortal?
If only the enemy were weaker.
He might have hope to turn the tables.
But unfortunately...
Ding Ling is no human!
He is a god!
Seeing with his own eyes the thousands of arrows he had arranged around the City Lord's Mansion descending simultaneously, finding Ding Ling unharmed.
Yuan Shao had to admit the so-called rumors were facts!
The anger at Zhang Hex and others' supposed betrayal vanished in an instant, replaced by unwillingness, fear, and a clinging to life.
He wanted to beg for mercy.
But under the watchful eyes of everyone, he couldn't put down his self-respect and dignity.
"Yuan Shao?"
Ding Ling looked at the man in front of him, expressionlessly uttering two words.
Yuan Shao didn't speak.
Ding Ling didn't ask again, just waved his hand.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword, carrying a blade glow several feet long, lightly swept across Yuan Shao and the others' necks.
Several death warriors shouted and charged up to protect Yuan Shao.
They were swept by the long sword qi, either cut in half at the waist, their necks flying, or limbs severed...
In the blink of an eye.
No fewer than dozens died.
Yuan Shao's head fell to the ground, rolling with a gurgling sound, stopped not far from Ding Ling's feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 247: The One Thing Cheng Huan Boasted About His Whole Life
paragraphs: The era of the great hero Yuan Shao has come to an end!
Jizhou now belongs to Cao!
Of course.
As a member of the Four Generations and Three Ministers, Yuan Shao still has many loyal subordinates in Jizhou, but they have no chance of revival.
Because no one can withstand Ding Ling's sword!
Aware of all this, Xun Chen and others sighed repeatedly and chose to submit to Cao Mengde.
Xun Chen listened to Ding Ling's advice.
After fruitlessly urging Yuan Shao, he retired home with Tian Feng and others.
And as he expected.
Yuan Shao suffered a crushing defeat under Ding Ling's sword alone!
Tian Feng, Jushou, and others were so shocked that their hands and feet were trembling; they questioned life:
"Can one person really defeat a nation?"
"Facing such a formidable opponent, do our wisdom and strategies still have any use?"
They despairingly and sadly discovered.
Against a divine being like Ding Ling.
All conspiracies, military strategies, and array tactics were utterly useless!
"No wonder Xun Chen's attitude changed drastically after returning from Wan City."
While they felt relieved, they also felt sorrow for Yuan Shao.
After all, he was their lord.
Dying so worthlessly.
So tragic.
But victory belongs to the kings, defeat to the bandits.
They had no reason to blame Ding Ling.
Simply because Ding Ling was extremely considerate, having informed Xun Chen in advance, and after capturing Jizhou Ye City, he treated them as usual, without any arrogance or divine disdain.
He made them feel comforted, while they secretly marveled:
With such terrifying power yet possessing such a stable mindset and kind attitude, it truly is remarkable.
"I knew for a long time that Ding Ling was no ordinary person."
Cheng Huan looked at Ding Ling excitedly, his emotions surging uncontrollably:
"I never imagined Ding Ling would come this far today. So powerful. Truly deserving of the title, a man who rivals the deities!"
Thanks to Tian Feng, Xun Chen, and others' protection, Cheng Huan avoided disaster.
But he was also thrown into the death row.
At any moment, he could be executed.
After defeating Yuan Shao, Ding Ling naturally rescued him immediately.
For Cheng Huan, Ding Ling was grateful.
Because he knew without Cheng Huan's wholehearted assistance, his path in the Martial Dao would surely have been full of hardships and challenges.
Beginnings are the hardest.
Many players exhaust every effort, risk their lives repeatedly, yet can't obtain a breathing technique as hoped.

However, Ding Ling managed to smoothly obtain the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique, not only due to critical cheats but also due to the guidance, support, and help from noble figures like Cheng Huan.
Therefore, Ding Ling often had thoughts of repaying favors.
He knew Cheng Huan, Pan Feng, and other loyal subordinates of Hann Fu wouldn't likely meet good endings.
So he sent pigeon post early to Jushou, Xun Chen, and others, asking them to lend a hand.
Xun Chen and others naturally had no reason to refuse such simple favors, as Ding Ling wasn't an ordinary person. Perhaps they might need his help in the future.
And facts proved.
Xun Chen and others bet correctly.
Thanks to Ding Ling, Cheng Huan soared, crowned with glory.
Years later, he often 'boasted' to juniors, colleagues, and comrades about his relationship with Ding Ling:

"You absolutely won't believe the National Preceptor, World's Number One Sword God, is someone I discovered. The first moment I laid eyes on the National Preceptor, I had a strong sense that he was not an ordinary person! At that time, I vowed to deeply bind with him and nurture him..."
While saying these words.
His face was radiant, eyes full of pride.
This was an extreme display of shared honor.
Clearly.
It was the only thing worth boasting of in his life.
Even in his old age, he boasted about it to his grandchildren.
Making his grandchildren speechless, but they also envied and admired their grandfather for betting on such an unrivaled hero, world's war god, supreme sword god, it truly was a huge gain!
The journey to Jizhou was extraordinarily smooth.
Upon returning to Chang'an after Ding Ling's trip.
No surprise.
He received batches of secret manuals and great medicines.
All from families, warriors, and the Yuan Family Treasury deeply bonded with Jizhou and Yuan Shao.
There were hundreds of low-tier martial arts secret manuals.
A few were high-tier.
More were statecraft and Confucian secret manuals.
Obviously.
Without the support of the Yuan Family's immediate descendants, Yuan Shao's treasury could only be considered first-class and not top-tier.
It couldn't compare to Dong Zhuo or the Yuan Family's immediate descendants' treasures.
After all, Yuan Shao hadn't been in Jizhou long enough, and to win people's hearts, his expenditures must have been substantial.
But even so.
He was ultimately a figure chosen from the Four Generations and Three Ministers, so the treasures were still first-class.
Ding Ling spent several hours reading all the secret manuals.
All martial arts secret manuals reached full level instantly.
The breathing technique only condensed a vague and elusive book, placing it on the bookshelf.
"The foundation has increased again."
"The control over power is becoming more and more effortless."
Ding Ling lightly clenched his fist, feeling the surging power increasingly unified.
Previously, the surging power was scattered, uncontrolled.
Because it was too strong!
It exceeded Ding Ling's imagination.
But now, this power is becoming more refined, showing signs of being completely mastered by him!
"Foundation increases, indeed extraordinary."
Ding Ling's heart was joyful.
His conjecture was correct.
Foundation is like a base; the more indestructible it is, the more stable the skyscrapers built upon it will be, rather than shaky and prone to collapse.
Just like the power of the Celestial Human Realm, comparable to Earth Immortal.
Ding Ling couldn't perfectly control it, always feeling on the verge of losing control.
But now, as the foundation continuously strengthens, his heart grows increasingly calm, and the surging power within him becomes more solid!
"Not bad. Continue."
Ding Ling finished reading the books related to Confucianism, Daoism, Medicine, Yin-Yang, Miscellaneous, Diplomacy, Mo Family, Names, Agriculture, Daoism, and other academic subjects.
Instantly full level.
[Wisdom +0.1]
[Charisma +0.4]
Many of these secret manuals repeated the ones Ding Ling had obtained earlier.
Some secret manuals weren't repeated, but parts of their content were.
So even though it seemed like many secret manuals.
The increase in wisdom and charisma wasn't much.
But even so.
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
After all, it was no different from picking them up.
The increase in wisdom made his sea of consciousness more transparent and clear, and his memory showed signs of improvement.
"Indeed, wisdom relates to memory. But to what extent does one need to reach for a photographic memory?"
Thinking of Diao Chan's memory.
Ding Ling felt a bit disheartened, it seemed he was overshadowed by Diao Chan in terms of wisdom?
But thinking about it, it's normal.
In the narrative, Diao Chan could simultaneously manipulate the cruel Dong Zhuo and the domineering Lü Bu within her grasp.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 248: Unifying Jiuzhou! Diao Chan Advances to Super-Elite
paragraphs: Without supreme wisdom to complement her unrivaled charm, this feat is absolutely impossible.
A fool, no matter how high their charm value, will ultimately become a plaything and not a manipulator of minds and a martial arts expert!
Ding Ling was at ease.
However, Diao Chan is now with him.
Dong Zhuo is dead.
Lü Bu surrendered, returning to Bingzhou's Northern Lands once again to be the Flying General, contending with the barbarians fiercely.
Diao Chan will no longer endure the trials and tragic fate as depicted in historical romances.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Achievement Medal Earned: Subduing Yuan Shao.]

[Note: Yuan Shao was strong-minded throughout his life, with a very strong sense of pride. Initially, he didn't believe the rumors about you at all, even frantically suppressing those spreading information about you, constantly belittling you across Jizhou, damaging your reputation!

He hoped to destroy you. However, you descended from the heavens like gods and demons, directly crushing everything he had, including his self-confidence and worldview! He trembled in despair, realizing he couldn't stop the deity!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Subduing Sui Yuanjin.]
A total of 5 achievement medals.
Excluding those consumed in exchange for strength.
Ding Ling currently has achievement medals of: 80 Ordinary, 18 E-level!
Very impressive!
"Very good."
Ding Ling nodded with satisfaction.
[3: You must make your name as War God resound throughout the entire plane world. 93%/100%.]
It rose from 89% to 93%.
The completion is not far off.
In the following months.
Ding Ling waged campaigns north and south.
With a spear and sword, he swept through Han Zhong, Yizhou, Jiaozhou, and the Western Regions' Kingdoms.
Striking terror and extreme fear into the various major warlords.
Ding Ling's fame and prestige grew stronger by the day!
His name as Sword God, Spear God resonated throughout the world! Famous across ten directions! No one dared defy! No one dared disrespect!
On this day, his name as War God reached 100% completion.
He chose to return to Chang'an City.
Leading a troop back.
The leaders of the troop were Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and Chen Dao, close allies.
Followed by a group of elite warriors.
After months of campaigning with Ding Ling.
Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng have transformed completely.
Plus, Ding Ling spared no effort in nurturing them, using various Great Medicine.
As of today.
Zhao Yun has already reached the Super-Elite Peak in strength, just one step away from Celestial Human Realm.
But he just cannot break through that single step.
Diao Chan, with supreme martial arts talent, and Ding Ling's high-level guidance and instruction, along with Great Medicine nurturing, naturally progressed to Super-Elite Fierce General!
Du Qingcheng and Da and Xiao Qiao slightly lag behind.
But with Ding Ling as their Land God mentor, all resources poured into them, nearly gathering all of Jiuzhou's strength to nurture them, even if they were pigs, they could fly to the sky.
Moreover, each of them possesses strong aptitude.
Du Qingcheng, though weaker compared to Diao Chan in martial arts talent, is significantly better than ordinary people.
And most importantly, her talent in Breathing Technique is extraordinarily high, with Ding Ling's guidance, complemented by medicinal baths, her progress is unparalleled.
She has now progressed to First-class Peak.
Da and Xiao Qiao have also reached First-class Initial Tier.
In just a few short months, they have been transformed from chrysalis to butterfly! Unbelievable to others, but very ordinary to Ding Ling.
With Ding Ling's 'tutelage' like guidance, medicinal baths, and more.
How could they not advance rapidly?
After all, Ding Ling's skill in medicinal baths is Full Level, and the concocted medicinal baths are top-notch!
Due to the cross-boundary enhancement in strength.

Da and Xiao Qiao now exude brilliance and aura, their charisma fundamentally transformed from before, each resembling heroic women, sitting on horseback, carrying sharp swords, holding long spears, valiant and spirited, highly impressive.
Naturally, they are deeply grateful to Ding Ling for all this.
Absolutely loyal to Ding Ling, if Ding Ling tells them to go east, they will never go west.
Sound of hooves!
Ding Ling and his group galloped to the southern gate of Chang'an Ancient City.
They saw a crowd.
Upon closer examination.
It turned out that Cao Mengde was leading a hundred officials in a welcoming procession.
"National Preceptor!"
Cao Mengde eagerly rushed forward.
Ding Ling did not act arrogantly, he leapt off the horse.
Cao Mengde immediately took several steps to Ding Ling's front, grasping Ding Ling's hand tightly, looking at Ding Ling with eyes full of admiration and awe, he said:

"Great Wei can so quickly establish dominance over Jiuzhou, all thanks to the National Preceptor! With the National Preceptor, it is a blessing for Great Wei, a blessing for the people, and moreso, a blessing for Mengde!
He proclaimed loudly:
"I, Cao Mengde, am thrice blessed to have met you, National Preceptor! Rest assured, the undertakings I promised you, are being carried out promptly. I will not disappoint you!"
Ding Ling nodded and smiled, then began chatting with Cao Mengde.
Needless to say.
Cao Mengde could truly be a legendary hero of the era.
Resolute and decisive.
Shrewd and perceptive!
He discovered talents among seemingly marginal ranks!
Top-tier talents like Guo Jia and Xi Zhicai have all risen to grace the halls of Great Wei! Beginning to excel!
This emerging empire of Great Wei is revealing its vibrant vitality and power!
But the pace is too hurried!
Easily strained!
If not for Ding Ling, singlehandedly suppressing the universe, stabilizing ten directions!
The territories would have long fallen into chaos.
Such incidents have happened more than once or twice.
The fleeing Yuan Shu once teamed up with Xianbei masters in the Liaodong region! Plundering Youzhou!
At that time, the border was in urgent danger!
Flying General Lü Bu led the Wolf Cavalry to suppress them and suffered a crushing defeat due to negligence!
The court was in turmoil!
The officials were horrified!
Faced with invasions of tens of thousands of borderland troops, everyone was at a loss.
The enemy only invaded, plundered quickly, and then escaped.
Trying to pursue them.
Often losing track amidst the vast grasslands, culminating in being stalked and slaughtered like prey!
Too dangerous.
Additionally, Ding Ling's strategy is too swift, too ferocious, too powerful!

Warriors like Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Huang Zhong, Wen Pin, Xiahou Yuan, Cao Ren, Le Jin, Li Dian, Sun Ce, Ma Chao, Yann Xing are all deployed to defend conquered lands, and train batches of surrendered soldiers!
Besides Lü Bu, Xuu Chu, Dian Wei, there was nearly no one left to utilize.
Initially, Cao Mengde thought with Lü Bu present, ordinary rebels would be no threat, but Lü Bu was defeated. This left not a single figure he could rely on!
Xuu Chu and Dian Wei could not be dispatched because Cao Mengde needed protectors!
Without Dian Wei guarding while he sleeps, Cao Mengde could not dare to sleep!
Assassins are everywhere, penetrating every corner.
There have been several times when Cao Mengde faced absolute peril! If not for Dian Wei and Xuu Chu, he would have been doomed!
The anxiety and crises surrounding Cao Mengde's reign as emperor are unprecedented!
Cao Mengde may very well be the first of such in history!

Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:

[Note: Yuan Shao was strong-minded throughout his life, with a very strong sense of pride.
Initially, he didn't believe the rumors about you at all, even frantically suppressing those spreading information about you, constantly belittling you across Jizhou, damaging your reputation!
He hoped to destroy you.
However, you descended from the heavens like gods and demons, directly crushing everything he had, including his self-confidence and worldview!
He trembled in despair, realizing he couldn't stop the deity!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Subduing Sui Yuanjin.]
A total of 5 achievement medals.
Excluding those consumed in exchange for strength.
Ding Ling currently has achievement medals of: 80 Ordinary, 18 E-level!
Very impressive!
"Very good."
Ding Ling nodded with satisfaction.
[3: You must make your name as War God resound throughout the entire plane world.
It rose from 89% to 93%.
The completion is not far off.
In the following months.
Ding Ling waged campaigns north and south.
With a spear and sword, he swept through Han Zhong, Yizhou, Jiaozhou, and the Western Regions' Kingdoms.
Striking terror and extreme fear into the various major warlords.
Ding Ling's fame and prestige grew stronger by the day!
His name as Sword God, Spear God resonated throughout the world!
Famous across ten directions!
No one dared defy!
No one dared disrespect!
On this day, his name as War God reached 100% completion.
He chose to return to Chang'an City.
Leading a troop back.
The leaders of the troop were Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and Chen Dao, close allies.
Followed by a group of elite warriors.
After months of campaigning with Ding Ling.
Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng have transformed completely.
Plus, Ding Ling spared no effort in nurturing them, using various Great Medicine.
As of today.
Zhao Yun has already reached the Super-Elite Peak in strength, just one step away from Celestial Human Realm.
But he just cannot break through that single step.
Diao Chan, with supreme martial arts talent, and Ding Ling's high-level guidance and instruction, along with Great Medicine nurturing, naturally progressed to Super-Elite Fierce General!
Du Qingcheng and Da and Xiao Qiao slightly lag behind.
But with Ding Ling as their Land God mentor, all resources poured into them, nearly gathering all of Jiuzhou's strength to nurture them, even if they were pigs, they could fly to the sky.
Moreover, each of them possesses strong aptitude.
Du Qingcheng, though weaker compared to Diao Chan in martial arts talent, is significantly better than ordinary people.
And most importantly, her talent in Breathing Technique is extraordinarily high, with Ding Ling's guidance, complemented by medicinal baths, her progress is unparalleled.
She has now progressed to First-class Peak.
Da and Xiao Qiao have also reached First-class Initial Tier.
In just a few short months, they have been transformed from chrysalis to butterfly!
Unbelievable to others, but very ordinary to Ding Ling.
With Ding Ling's 'tutelage' like guidance, medicinal baths, and more.
How could they not advance rapidly?
After all, Ding Ling's skill in medicinal baths is Full Level, and the concocted medicinal baths are top-notch!
Due to the cross-boundary enhancement in strength.

Da and Xiao Qiao now exude brilliance and aura, their charisma fundamentally transformed from before, each resembling heroic women, sitting on horseback, carrying sharp swords, holding long spears, valiant and spirited, highly impressive.
Naturally, they are deeply grateful to Ding Ling for all this.
Absolutely loyal to Ding Ling, if Ding Ling tells them to go east, they will never go west.
Sound of hooves!
Ding Ling and his group galloped to the southern gate of Chang'an Ancient City.
They saw a crowd.
Upon closer examination.
It turned out that Cao Mengde was leading a hundred officials in a welcoming procession.
"National Preceptor!"
Cao Mengde eagerly rushed forward.
Ding Ling did not act arrogantly, he leapt off the horse.
Cao Mengde immediately took several steps to Ding Ling's front, grasping Ding Ling's hand tightly, looking at Ding Ling with eyes full of admiration and awe, he said:
"Great Wei can so quickly establish dominance over Jiuzhou, all thanks to the National Preceptor!
With the National Preceptor, it is a blessing for Great Wei, a blessing for the people, and moreso, a blessing for Mengde!
He proclaimed loudly:
"I, Cao Mengde, am thrice blessed to have met you, National Preceptor!
Rest assured, the undertakings I promised you, are being carried out promptly.
I will not disappoint you!"
Ding Ling nodded and smiled, then began chatting with Cao Mengde.
Needless to say.
Cao Mengde could truly be a legendary hero of the era.
Resolute and decisive.
Shrewd and perceptive!
He discovered talents among seemingly marginal ranks!
Top-tier talents like Guo Jia and Xi Zhicai have all risen to grace the halls of Great Wei!
Beginning to excel!
This emerging empire of Great Wei is revealing its vibrant vitality and power!
But the pace is too hurried!
Easily strained!
If not for Ding Ling, singlehandedly suppressing the universe, stabilizing ten directions!
The territories would have long fallen into chaos.
Such incidents have happened more than once or twice.
The fleeing Yuan Shu once teamed up with Xianbei masters in the Liaodong region!
Plundering Youzhou!
At that time, the border was in urgent danger!
Flying General Lü Bu led the Wolf Cavalry to suppress them and suffered a crushing defeat due to negligence!
The court was in turmoil!
The officials were horrified!
Faced with invasions of tens of thousands of borderland troops, everyone was at a loss.
The enemy only invaded, plundered quickly, and then escaped.
Trying to pursue them.
Often losing track amidst the vast grasslands, culminating in being stalked and slaughtered like prey!
Too dangerous.
Additionally, Ding Ling's strategy is too swift, too ferocious, too powerful!

Warriors like Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Huang Zhong, Wen Pin, Xiahou Yuan, Cao Ren, Le Jin, Li Dian, Sun Ce, Ma Chao, Yann Xing are all deployed to defend conquered lands, and train batches of surrendered soldiers!
Besides Lü Bu, Xuu Chu, Dian Wei, there was nearly no one left to utilize.
Initially, Cao Mengde thought with Lü Bu present, ordinary rebels would be no threat, but Lü Bu was defeated.
This left not a single figure he could rely on!
Xuu Chu and Dian Wei could not be dispatched because Cao Mengde needed protectors!
Without Dian Wei guarding while he sleeps, Cao Mengde could not dare to sleep!
Assassins are everywhere, penetrating every corner.
There have been several times when Cao Mengde faced absolute peril!
If not for Dian Wei and Xuu Chu, he would have been doomed!
The anxiety and crises surrounding Cao Mengde's reign as emperor are unprecedented!
Cao Mengde may very well be the first of such in history!

chapters.title: Chapter 249 249: Cutting Through the Royal Court! First-Rank Prince (11/17)
paragraphs: Cao Mengde certainly knew why so many people wanted him dead!
And why so many didn't choose others, targeting him alone, trying to assassinate him!
It was really because they were helpless against Ding Ling, impenetrable and unyielding.
They could only choose the critical soft target to squeeze!
Without a doubt, in the eyes of many, compared to Ding Ling, Cao Mengde was undoubtedly that crucial soft target!
A burgeoning empire.
Seeking to rise up.
That inevitably meant moving the big cake of old powers!
How could they possibly allow Cao Mengde to do that?
Thus, the endless assassination attempts were understandable.

Cao Mengde narrowly escaped death many times, and beyond his fear was his rage; since then, he launched multiple Thunderbolt operations to sweep away batches of Conservative Parties supporting the Great Han!
These Conservative Parties were not at fault for being conservative, but they were complicit by colluding with external assassin forces, trying to overthrow Great Wei!
This was something Cao Mengde could not tolerate.
The only solace for Cao Mengde was that the Great Wei Kingdom had Ding Ling!
Without Ding Ling, he wouldn't dare to act with such boldness!
The border unrest.
Was resolved by Ding Ling alone, with a horse and a sword.
The heads of Yuan Shu, the Xianbei bandit chiefs, and others were all brought back by him.
It was said that the Xianbei Royal Court was pierced through by Ding Ling's sword!
Ding Ling even acquired the title of Celestial God among the Xianbei.
It was this battle.
The Xianbei dared not head south again to herd their horses!
They revered the Great Wei Empire as if it were a deity, to the utmost extent!
There were indeed many similar events!
Whenever the Great Wei Empire faced turmoil that they couldn't handle.
Ding Ling would step in, and success would soon follow, outcomes achieved with ease!
This was also why Cao Mengde, multiple times, led the officials to welcome Ding Ling in full view of the public.
One could say.
Without Ding Ling.
There would be no Great Wei as it exists today!
Just the internal rebellions would suffice to 'take down' Cao Mengde.
Let alone the constant external threats, with bloody events occurring frequently.
In such internal and external turmoil, it was typical for Cao Mengde to be in a sorry state, even losing his life was a strong possibility.
After all.
He tread a path too big and bold!
If it were a bit more cautious, it wouldn't be enough to 'take down' Cao Mengde like this, considering Cao Mengde's greatness; taking things slow, he could likely secure his domination.
History has proven his capabilities, which cannot be denied.
But Cao Mengde is not a god.
The results of being too eager for quick success could be ending in failure!
But now?
With Ding Ling around.
All those possibilities of being 'taken down' were nipped in the bud!
Although Cao Mengde often faced assassination, poisoning, and such, the development of the Great Wei Kingdom was getting better and smoother!
As of now.
The territory of the Great Wei Empire has already reached the far borders of the Western Regions' Kingdoms, almost hitting the Guishuang Kingdom!
And the person who facilitated all this!
Was Ding Ling!
As of now.
Ding Ling in the real world was known to virtually everyone.
Anyone who could get online.
Could find news about Ding Ling everywhere.
[Ding Ling shatters the Royal City with a single sword!]
[Ding Ling has captured Jiaozhou!]
[Ding Ling defeated a million troops!]
[Ding Ling broke through the Western Regions' Kingdoms!]
Such events that would leave anyone dumbfounded were rapidly accomplished by Ding Ling in a thunderous manner.
For ordinary people, achieving just one such great deed would be enough to boast about for a lifetime.
Ding Ling accomplished all of them!
Ding Ling's fame not only resonated throughout the Three Kingdoms World!
It also completely shook the real world's major nations.
Many people began to study why Ding Ling was so strong! And why so fearsomely powerful!
In the game, Ding Ling was this mighty.
In reality?
Is he just as strong?
Some people who originally wanted to make a move on Ding Ling all became fearful and retreated.
Because those who had played the game knew that as long as the Achievement Medals were sufficient, however strong one was in the game, they would be just as strong in the real world!
Was Ding Ling short of Achievement Medals?
Anyone with a brain would know he wasn't lacking.
That makes it almost certain that Ding Ling's in-game strength had fully transferred back to the real world!
Thinking about this.
Who would dare confront Ding Ling?
Unrivaled defense, peerless strength, traversing the void, killing without hesitation!
Going to kill Ding Ling, if one were counter-killed by him, whom could one complain to?
That's too much of a loss!
Those who persist knowingly in doing what's impossible are the biggest fools!
Many deemed themselves wise, withdrew from the plan to besiege Ding Ling.
In their view, unless nuclear bombs, missiles, and other weapons were deployed, quite likely Ding Ling's defense couldn't be breached!
If the defense couldn't be broken.
What's the point of fighting?!
Because of Ding Ling's glorious war history in the Three Kingdoms World!
He avoided many imminent ambushes and sieges he might have faced soon!
He was fully aware of this.
Only because he often kept an eye on the real world, to prevent unforeseen events.
He became more and more cautious.
Until he could withstand a nuclear bomb, he wouldn't be too high-profile in the real world.
Staying low, holding steady.
That is currently his most secure choice!
Three Kingdoms World.
Chang'an City.
Cao Mengde declared Ding Ling as the First-Rank Prince!
And delivered a passionate speech praising and lauding Ding Ling.
The overall meaning was simple:
Ding Ling was the pioneer of the creation of the Great Wei Empire, a Saint! A great man! A deity!
Ding Ling's words are as a Holy Decree, as heavenly law!
In the future, all people of the Great Wei Empire must heed Ding Ling's command, and not defy or oppose!
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: First-Rank Prince!]
[Note: Your power and influence in the Three Kingdoms World have reached their peak, with no further advancement possible!]
Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
And smiled slightly.
He had already maxed out his achievements in terms of power in the Three Kingdoms.
Achievements concerning the character aspect were also mostly completed.
Other achievements were much the same.
As for the Path of Glory.
Only the second path was left.
Defeat the strongest on the plane!
The reason Ding Ling returned to Chang'an City this time.
Was to hand over the elite to Cao Mengde and then head to Penglai Mountain to challenge Tong Yuan and Wang Yue.
That's right.
Wang Yue had already gone to Penglai Mountain.
Now he cultivates and philosophizes with Tong Yuan.
Some time later.
After the morning assembly ended.
The officials paid a grand courtesy to Ding Ling, then left in an orderly manner.
Ding Ling then told Cao Mengde about some things he intended to do.
Cao Mengde naturally offered strong support, and said:
"I will mobilize Jiuzhou's spies to do our utmost to find Zuo Ci, Nanhua Old Immortal, and the like. If found, Pigeon Post will notify you immediately!"
At Ding Ling's request, he changed his address, calling you instead. Otherwise, such formality from an emperor to Ding Ling felt a bit overly deferential.
That was secondary.
The main reason was that Ding Ling didn't really care about these verbal etiquettes.
"Thank you."
"I'm ashamed."
Cao Mengde blushed slightly, somewhat embarrassed:
"I can offer you but a little help! Yet you have accomplished the great unification of the Great Wei Empire for me. An unprecedentedly vast and magnificent empire!"

chapters.title: Chapter 250 250: Top-Tier Equipment! Arrival at Penglai Mountain
paragraphs: Cao Mengde's expression was somewhat excited:
"You have helped me too much. I've only done a little, so please don't thank me. I feel unworthy of it! I..."
He said many things.
His emotions were evidently at their extreme, rising and falling tumultuously!
Ding Ling just listened in.
When he finished, Ding Ling smiled slightly and nodded, which was considered as agreeing to his request.
Only then did Cao Mengde feel much relieved.
Facing Ding Ling.
He felt as if he were facing an insurmountable divine mountain!
A mighty pressure came rushing at him.
If he were not the emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom, he might not even be able to stand firm before Ding Ling!
As for Ding Ling.
Cao Mengde now held a mix of reverence, admiration, and awe towards him.
Extremely complex.
Were it not confirmed that Ding Ling was not interested in power and had no desire to be an official.
Cao Mengde would certainly be trembling with fear, unable to sleep.
Yet even so.
To keep Ding Ling steady, he poured all his support and assistance into helping him.
Though he admitted that his full support might not mean much to Ding Ling, after all, Ding Ling was already a Land God, how much could a mortal's help aid a deity?
However...
Ding Ling found Cao Mengde's assistance truly impressive!
Various Divine Weapons were freely available!
Top-notch horses were also at Ding Ling's disposal!
The Secret Manuals from all over Jiuzhou, whether high-tier or low-tier martial arts, Breathing Techniques, etc., were all delivered to his mansion immediately.
When Ding Ling returned to Chang'an Ancient City.
He would always find a pile of densely packed new books and secret manuals in his study.
These were what Ding Ling needed.
Cao Mengde could be said to be a divine assist, a top-tier teammate!
He was extremely satisfied naturally.
He had complimented Cao Mengde a few times.
Every compliment from him was like heavenly music to Cao Mengde, who would feel light and joyful for several days because of it.
This time returning to Chang'an City.
After ending his exchange with Cao Mengde.
Ding Ling still returned to his mansion, entering his study.
Indeed.
This time he saw another pile of secret manuals, academic books, and so on.
Ding Ling picked them up and began to read.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and others attended him by his side.
Fanning him, passing him books.
Every time he finished a book, Da and Xiao Qiao would immediately fetch a new one for him.
The service was very attentive.
Ding Ling said there was no need to be this way.
They just wouldn't listen, insisting on their way.
Ding Ling let them be.
But it must be said.
The days passed like this were just too delightful.
Sometimes Ding Ling almost forgot about the Path of Glory that still lay ahead.
But fortunately, his power was profound, far beyond the ordinary, able to awaken in time, and understand the path he had to take: to clear the game plane.
"The Three Kingdoms World should be ending soon."
Only one final task was left on the Path of Glory.
Ding Ling had a premonition.
After completing this final task.
He should be able to end the journey in the Three Kingdoms World.
He sighed inwardly.
He had been advancing with cheats and it still took him over a year, almost two years, to almost complete the task.
If it were someone else, wouldn't it take decades? A lifetime?
Perhaps even a lifetime might not suffice due to the high difficulty!
Swish, swish!
Ding Ling steadied his mind, stopped overthinking, and continued flipping and reading the books.
As each secret manual was read, he reached full level in an instant.
A total of over two thousand secret manuals were read.
[Wisdom +0.2]
[Charm +0.9]
This time most of the secret manuals came from the Western Regions' Kingdoms and other areas.
Many of the secret manuals were Ding Ling's first exposure to them.
Hence, the increase in Wisdom and Charm was quite substantial.
He was very satisfied with this.
All the way along.
The collected secret manuals were too many.
He could no longer remember exactly how many secret manuals he had read.
At least tens of thousands? Hundreds of thousands?
The attributes of Wisdom and Charm had been increasing ever weaker, and towards the end, reading hundreds of secret manuals made almost no difference.
Now being able to increase by so much at once.
Was entirely because these secret manuals were all new.
In addition.
The foundation once again went crazy with improvement by a huge margin.
Ding Ling now, in terms of using strength, could do it effortlessly.
Even the boundless power of the Celestial Human Realm.
Could no longer bind or control him.
This power could truly be used by him!
His four-dimensional attributes seemed not to have increased.
But with the continuous improvement of his foundation.
His strength now was more than doubled!

Even though a force of a thousand pounds was struck out previously, it used to scatter like flowers in the air, wasting a lot of power; now, it's like a steel needle piercing bone, able to concentrate power into one point, enhancing destructive power by so much more!
The same force.
But with different refinement degrees.
The effects are indeed very different!
Ten days later.
After resolving some of the Great Wei's predicaments.
In Cao Mengde's reluctant gaze, Ding Ling led Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and Chen Dao to Jizhou's Penglai Mountain.
Each was riding an unparalleled horse akin to a Ferghana Horse.
All were holding top-notch Divine Weapons.
Ding Ling was equipped with two swords.
The Giant Que Sword and the Heaven-Swaying Sword!
The swords were strapped on his back, one above the other, showcasing the peerless grandeur of a Sword God.
As for the Cyan Gang Sword, it was held by Xiao Qiao.
Du Qingcheng carried the Gan Jiang Sword.
Chen Dao wielded an Iron Blood Divine Spear treasured in Dong Zhuo's Meiwu;
Zhao Yun had both the Dragon Gall Silver Spear and the Shuoyue Sword.
Diao Chan held the Fish Guts Sword and a Meteor Iron Long Spear.
Da Qiao had an ancestral Mo Ye Sword.
As for their mounts and divine weapons, everything was top configuration!

Though the renditions of famous ancient swords such as Xuanyuan Sword, Zhanlu Sword, Tai'e Sword, and Chixiao Sword remained elusive, otherwise Ding Ling and his entourage's divine weapon setup would surely be even more lavish!
It was already considered lucky to have found the Gan Jiang Sword, among others.
Ding Ling naturally wouldn't ask for too much more.
Clatter, clatter!
They galloped ahead.
The speed was swift.
That day.
The group arrived at Penglai Mountain.
At the foot of the mountain.
Ding Ling saw from afar Wang Yue and Tong Yuan coming to welcome him.
No need to say.
It must have been the players' notification.
With Wang Yue and Tong Yuan at Penglai Mountain.
Crowds kept pouring into Penglai Mountain one after another.
Were it not for Wang Yue and Tong Yuan setting extremely stringent assessment criteria, the mountain might have been overcrowded already.
Yet even so.
A year and more later stepping into Penglai Mountain.
Ding Ling noticed the significant changes here.
There were a lot more people.
Everywhere on the mountain, bamboo houses were built, inside which shadowy figures could be seen, practicing sword, spear, meditation, and Pile Skill!
"These are the disciples we've taken in."
Tong Yuan and Wang Yue warmly greeted Ding Ling after meeting him, chatting on various topics; at this point, seeing Ding Ling looking up the mountain, Tong Yuan introduced proactively:

"These disciples are truly omnipotent, no matter where we hide, they can find us, clinging stubbornly, just to become our apprentices! With no choice, finding no escape or place to hide without being surrounded by a herd, we decided to stay here in Penglai Mountain."
